30246.s: The bill amends the Primary Education Act and the Expertise Centres Act so that annual price-indexation adjustments to the programmes of requirements and funding amounts for material provisions are made by a single ministerial regulation before 1 October, when the state treasury permits, instead of several regulations. It also allows mid-period amendments to be made by ministerial regulation without prior submission to parliament, simplifying procedures.
30246.j: The memorandum justifies removing prior parliamentary submission as a simplification of procedures, arguing that these technical adjustments do not undermine parliament's control and that parliament stays involved.
q: Given the nature of the subjects, this change does not impair the controlling role the House of Representatives has regarding cabinet policy.
Gezien de aard van de onderwerpen betekent deze wijziging geen aantasting van de controlerende rol die de Tweede Kamer heeft ten aanzien van het kabinetsbeleid.
d: annual adjustment of funding amounts for price indexation
amendments to programmes of requirements on treasury or educational grounds
annual adjustment of funding amounts and programme amendments for expertise centres
adjustment of total material-provision amounts by ministerial decision (beschikking)
adjustment and temporary increase of funding amount under lumpsum financing
p: Artikel I, 1 (Art. 113 lid 5-6 WPO); Artikel III, A (Art. 118 lid 5)

Removes the prior submission of ministerial regulations to parliament (voorhang) for funding adjustments and mid-period programme changes, though the minister remains bound to the treasury condition and the 1 January effective-date rule.

parties: Asks whether the government can guarantee that savings from price adjustment benefit education priorities rather than general funds, and whether parliament's budget rights remain intact.
What guarantee does the government give that a cut in price adjustment for primary education will actually benefit other education priorities?
Welke garantie geeft de regering dat een korting op de prijsbijstelling voor het primair onderwijs ook werkelijk ten goede komt aan andere onderwijsprioriteiten?
Objects that price adjustment depends on budgetary room rather than real price developments and asks for a guarantee of real price compensation.
The members ask the government for a guarantee that real price compensation will be provided for primary and secondary education.
De bovengenoemde leden vragen de regering de garantie dat er een reële prijscompensatie voor het primair onderwijs en het voortgezet onderwijs wordt gedaan.
Opposes the funding change, warning that dropping automatic price compensation abandons adequate funding and causes hidden damage to schools.
These members ask whether abolishing automatic price compensation abandons the principle of adequate, if sober, funding.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of met het afschaffen van de automatische prijscompensatie niet het uitgangspunt van de adequate, maar sobere bekostiging wordt verlaten.
Asks how the bill was prepared and whether education organisations were consulted, and asks the government to respond to their objections.
Has there been consultation with the school boards' organisations? If not, why not?
Is er overleg geweest met de besturenorganisaties? Zo neen, waarom niet?
Argues primary schools are more financially sensitive and already face lump-sum changes, and asks the government to reconsider the proposal for now.
All this is for the members of this faction reason to ask the government to reconsider the proposed amendment for now.
Dit alles is voor de leden van deze fractie aanleiding van de regering te vragen de voorgestelde wijziging voor dit moment te heroverwegen.

31425.s: The bill amends Book 8 of the Dutch Civil Code to align limitation of shipowner liability for maritime claims with the 1996 Protocol to the 1976 London Limitation Convention. It adjusts the liability limits for claims arising from salvage, passenger death or injury, and sets an administrative-order power to fix limits for small passenger vessels.
31425.j: The memorandum does not spell out a justification for the delegation to an administrative order; it treats the matter as technical alignment with the international protocol.
q: by general administrative order the amount is fixed to which liability under this title may be limited for vessels
bij algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt het bedrag vastgesteld waartoe de aansprakelijkheid uit hoofde van deze titel kan worden beperkt voor schepen
d: liability limit amounts for small passenger vessels under 300 tonnage

parties: Asks whether higher limits will raise insurance costs and claims, and how misuse will be prevented.
Misuse by citizens and businesses of the higher compensation limits must be prevented.
Voorkomen moet worden dat burgers en bedrijven misbruik gaan maken van de hogere schadevergoedingslimieten.
Asks whether the limits adequately protect victims and whether amendment should occur more regularly than every 30 years.
Questions the justification for limiting liability, whether stakeholders beyond business were consulted, and how parliament will be involved in future amendments of the amounts.

31452.s: The bill amends the Medical Research Involving Human Subjects Act (WMO) to allow electronic submission of documents by ministerial regulation, empower the central committee CCMO to suspend research, add term limits for committee members, and restore administrative appeal to the CCMO for drug research, correcting an incomplete EU directive implementation. It also lets the minister set further requirements on patient information and adds a requirement that the CCMO takes over pharmaceutical adverse-event notices.
31452.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial powers as needed to promote digitisation and to enforce standards on patient information, and the CCMO suspension power as correcting an incomplete EU directive implementation.
q: To promote digitisation of the document flow and eventually to be able to require it from submitters, it is desirable to provide in the statute that by ministerial regulation it may be determined that certain documents must be submitted electronically.

Om de digitalisering van de stukkenstroom te bevorderen en uiteindelijk ook van de indieners te kunnen verlangen, is het wenselijk in de wet op te nemen dat bij ministeriële regeling kan worden bepaald dat bepaalde stukken elektronisch moeten worden ingediend.
d: electronic submission of protocol requests and documents
further requirements on information given to subjects
electronic reporting and notification of research
p: Gives the central committee CCMO, or the minister for clinical drug trials, power to suspend research on grounds of unacceptable risk to subjects, with notification duties to the ethics committee and researchers.
Removes reporting of data to the College ter beoordeling van geneesmiddelen, which has no power to act on it.
Limits committee member terms to four years with at most two reappointments, a constraint on committee membership.

parties: Asks whether the CCMO's annulment power is proportionate and whether duplicated work with the METC can be avoided, and how the appeal function is separated from the METC's decisions.
The question remains whether the proposed annulment power is not disproportionate, as the Council of State believes.
Vraag blijft nog wel of de voorgestelde vernietigingsbevoegdheid niet disproportioneel is, zoals de Raad van State meent.
Asks why the annulment power was converted to suspension, whether the minister should hold the power, and who ensures definitive termination when the METC refuses to withdraw approval.

On what basis does the government conclude that the CCMO and METC will reach agreement together, and that an active role for the CCMO or the minister will not be needed to annul a positive opinion once given?

Waar maakt de regering uit op dat de CCMO en de METC er samen wel uit zullen komen en dat een actieve rol voor de CCMO of de minister niet nodig zal zijn om een eenmaal gegeven positief oordeel te vernietigen?

Criticizes the government for dropping the proposal to require publication of results as a criterion in article 3, and calls for more active supervision during implementation and periodic reporting duties.
The SP members do not understand this.
De leden van de SP-fractie begrijpen dit niet.
Supports electronic availability of protocols, the CCMO's power to halt ongoing research, and the proposed secretariat and assessment criteria changes.
The VVD members share the government's view to enforce the stated electronic availability, part B.
De leden van de VVD-fractie delen het oordeel van de regering om de genoemde elektronische beschikbaarheid af te dwingen, onderdeel B.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the CCMO should not be given power to annul positive opinions of ethics committees, and that the implementation of Directive 2001/20/EC was incomplete regarding CCMO suspension and objection powers, and that administrative appeal to the CCMO against committee opinions on drug trials should not be restored. The government's reply accepted the key points, granted the CCMO suspension powers for all research and dropped the annulment power, but kept the administrative appeal to the CCMO.
concerns: The Council objected that giving the CCMO, a zelfstandig bestuursorgaan, a spontaneous annulment power over other autonomous bodies' opinions is not justified and the minister should hold that power under the Kaderwet zbo's.
The Council found the proposed annulment power disproportionate given existing powers to suspend research and withdraw recognition of ethics committees.
The Council found articles 9 and 12 of Directive 2001/20/EC incorrectly implemented, as the CCMO lacked objection and suspension powers the competent authority should have.

The Council advised against restoring administrative appeal to the CCMO against ethics committee opinions on drug trials, as it conflicts with the CCMO's primary role there; the government did not follow this advice.

31515.s: The bill makes mostly technical corrections to the Waterschapswet, the Wet verontreiniging oppervlaktewateren and the Wet modernisering waterschapsbestel, including fixing cross-references and wording. It also adds a power for water boards' general boards (algemeen bestuur) to set detailed rules by regulation for the zuiveringsheffing and adjusts the levy amounts and related provisions.
31515.j: The memorandum justifies the new regulatory power as a clarification of competence and a fix for the missing corresponding provision in the Waterschapswet, given the need for detailed rules.
q: Because article 122g specifically concerns measurement, sampling and analysis, it is however cleaner to lay the basis for the water boards' competence to make further rules in this article.

Omdat artikel 122g specifiek ziet op meting, bemonstering en analyse is het echter zuiverder om de basis voor de bevoegdheid van de waterschapsbesturen tot nadere regelgeving in dit artikel te regelen.
d: ARTIKEL I G (art. 122g, lid 2) and ARTIKEL I M (new art. 122l)
detailed rules on zuiveringsheffing by water board general board regulation
p: ARTIKEL I L and M (arts. 122g and 122l)
Gives water board general boards power to set supplementary rules on the zuiveringsheffing by regulation, clarifying the division of competence with the amvb-legislator.

parties: Asks whether the actual distribution of water board charges matches the legislator's intent and whether the government will amend the law if practice deviates.
Is the result in line with the legislator's intent? Is the government considering amending the law if practice deviates?
Is het resultaat overeenkomstig de bedoeling van de wetgever? Overweegt de regering de wet aan te passen als blijkt dat de praktijk afwijkt?
Questions whether allowing water boards to set differing rules on purification levies will raise administrative burdens and whether such divergence is desirable.
The VVD members wonder whether this will lead to a heavier administrative burden for businesses established in different water boards.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af of dit zal leiden tot verzwaring van de administratieve lasten voor bedrijven die in verschillende waterschappen zijn gevestigd.
Criticises the uneven distribution of charges that will raise bills for residents and homeowners, questions the rijksheffing effects, and asks for transparency on tariffs and costs.
The SP members observe that in practice there appears to be an disproportionate distribution of water board charges.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat er in de praktijk sprake lijkt van een onevenredige verdeling van de waterschapslasten.
Asks the government to inventory unintended financial effects of the new Water Boards Act on unbuilt land and propose remedies, such as a national standard value.
The said members therefore ask the government to inventory at short notice the unintended financial effects of the new Water Boards Act and come up with proposals to prevent these effects.

De genoemde leden vragen de regering daarom om op korte termijn de onbedoelde financiële effecten van de nieuwe Waterschapswet te inventariseren en met voorstellen te komen waarmee deze effecten voorkomen kunnen worden.
Expresses approval of the government's response to the report without raising further points.
The PvdA members have noted with approval the memorandum in response to the report.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met instemming kennis genomen van de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag.

Asks whether the pollution levy's rationale and the proposed tariff increase have differing effects across discharging companies, and whether the cost-allocation key functions properly and matches stated goals.
The VVD members ask whether the government believes the current practice of cost allocation is in line with the stated objectives.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af of de regering van mening is dat de huidige praktijk van kostentoedeling in overeenstemming is met de doelstellingen.

31551.s: The bill simplifies administration of five Dutch war-victims benefit laws by abolishing the annual provisional-then-final income assessment and replacing it with fixed re-assessment points and automatic indexation via ministerial regulation. It also removes several unused delegation clauses that allowed deviation from statute.
31551.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the aim of reducing administrative burden on beneficiaries and the Pensioen- en Uitkeringsraad, and by removing delegation clauses that had become a dead letter.
q: it is desirable to reduce the administrative burden on the extraordinary pensioners and benefit recipients and on the Pension and Benefits Council
het wenselijk is de administratieve belasting van de buitengewoon gepensioneerden en uitkeringsgerechtigden en de Pensioen- en Uitkeringsraad te verminderen
d: Artikel I, A (Wbp art. 3a, tweede lid)
indexation of pensions and benefits via ministerial regulation instead of AMvB
automatic indexation of pensions by the Raad and by the Minister
indexation of benefits by the Raad and the Minister, including Indonesia-specific adjustment
indexation of periodic benefits by the Raad and the Minister
p: Artikel I, I (Wbp art. 42c) and Artikel IV, G (Wuv art. 59)

Re-assessment of benefits becomes event-triggered and ex officio, with the Raad deciding within 13 weeks and recovering overpayments in set instalments, while removing the earlier provisional-assessment safeguards for beneficiaries.
Artikel IV, H (Wuv art. 59a) and Artikel V, I (Wubo art. 60)
Benefit increases on request now require a 1% threshold and the hardship test is retained, limiting beneficiaries' ability to obtain upward revision.

31704.s: The bill amends several tax laws for 2009, including new income tax brackets, a car-benefit reduction for low-emission cars, changes to pension annuity rules, a corporate tax rate cut, VAT exemption changes for medical services, and packaging tax reforms. It also introduces tax exemptions for sports organisations and removes the first-day notification requirement for employers.
31704.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexible, sector-specific arrangements and quick adaptation to practice, with some safeguards such as binding decisions and Council of State advice.
q: To make this type of arrangement possible, a delegation power is created.
Om dit soort regelingen mogelijk te maken wordt een delegatiebevoegdheid gecreëerd.
d: packaging tax forfait and sector arrangements
designation of logistic aids excluded from packaging definition
designation of national sports organisations and conditions
adjustment of CO2 emission limits for company car privilege
special rules for packaging tax collection
transitional rules for annuity premium deduction
p: The inspector may set and revise packaging weight forfaits and retroactively amend decisions where information was incorrect or circumstances changed.
Inspector may retroactively amend forfait decisions and apply administrative penalties for missing notifications.

parties: Asks about the Belastingdienst's capacity to implement changes, simplification of forms and the first-day notification, without raising a check concern.
To begin with, the CDA members want certainty on whether the Tax Administration and Tax Administration/Allowances can implement all proposed measures and simplifications properly in its systems.

Om te beginnen willen de leden van de CDA-fractie zekerheid omtrent de vraag of de Belastingdienst en de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen alle voorgenomen maatregelen en vereenvoudigingen op deugdelijke wijze kan doorvoeren in haar systemen?
Asks about the effects of abolishing the hours criterion and the entrepreneur allowance on social security and small businesses.
What income effects does this have for entrepreneurs with profit income up to about 40,000 euro?
Welke inkomenseffecten heeft dit voor ondernemers met een winstinkomen tot ca. € 40 000?
Criticises unnecessarily complex measures that contradict the goal of simplification and asks about budgetary and purchasing power consequences.
These members notice that some measures are unnecessarily complex and, in their view, run counter to the goal of simplifying the tax system.
Het valt deze leden op dat sommige maatregelen onnodig complex zijn ingericht en dit volgens deze leden juist tegenover de doelstelling van vereenvoudiging van het belastingstelsel staat.
Criticises the lack of a coherent fiscal vision and the reversal of the planned VAT increase, and questions the financing of measures via the unrealised rentebox.
They also note, with the Council of State, that the cabinet takes no measures to structurally finance the purchasing power compensation measures.

Zij constateren overigens met de Raad van State in het advies voor de ontwerp-miljoenennota dat het kabinet geen maatregelen treft om de koopkrachtcompensatiemaatregelen ook structureel financieel te dekken.
Criticises weakened greening, regressive purchasing power effects and the lack of a total overview of effects, and asks for CPB calculations.
Welcomes the sustainability and entrepreneurship measures but raises questions on effects for small entrepreneurs and suggests alternatives.
Nevertheless, a number of questions remain open for the ChristenUnie members, which are included in this report.
Toch blijven er nog een aantal vragen openstaan voor de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie, die in dit verslag zijn opgenomen.
Asks how and when the first-day notification abolition will be given statutory form.
The D66 members would like to know how and by what deadline the government intends to give legal form to the announced abolition of the first-day notification.
De leden van de fractie van D66 willen graag weten hoe en op welke termijn de regering wettelijk vorm wil geven aan de aangekondigde afschaffing van de eerstedagsmelding?
Supports some proposals but questions the phased abolition of the entrepreneur allowance and the effects on starters and small entrepreneurs.
It contains proposals the SGP members can agree with, but also proposals about which they still have questions.
Daarin zitten voorstellen waar de leden van de SGP-fractie het mee eens kunnen zijn, maar ook voorstellen waarbij zij nog vragen over hebben.

Asks whether the ACTAL assessment of the loon-in/loon-over system will be delivered before the bill is treated, and insists the proposal be handled separately if no positive ACTAL advice is available.

If there is no positive quantitative ACTAL advice this Friday, the CDA members ask the government to treat this proposal as a separate bill and remove it from the other fiscal measures, in line with earlier commitments to the House.

Indien er geen kwantitatief ACTAL advies ligt aanstaande vrijdag dat positief is, verzoeken de leden van de fractie van het CDA de regering dit voorstel als een apart voorstel te behandelen en te verwijderen uit overige fiscale maatregelen, conform eerdere toezeggingen aan de Kamer.

Asks how the kilometre charge relates to the continued BPM, how the MKB profit exemption works for part-time and hybrid entrepreneurs, and why the automatic VAR extension cannot start on 1 January 2009.
The PVV members do not understand why this measure cannot take effect on 1 January 2009, after a VAR declaration has been issued for three years (with retroactive effect).](ts)
De leden van de fractie van de PVV begrijpen niet waarom deze maatregelen niet per 1 januari 2009 kan ingaan nadat 3 jaar (met terugwerkende kracht) een VAR verklaring is afgegeven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Belastingplan 2009 bill, raising objections on the houdbaarheidsbijdrage, doorwerkbonus, self-employed deduction and profit exemption, corporate tax rate, shipping tonnage regime, tax credits, car taxation, lijfrenten and packaging tax, and advised revision. The government's nader rapport responded point by point, accepting several remarks (e.g. on lijfrenten delegation, packaging tax algemeen tarief and forfait) and rejecting or explaining others (e.g. on fiscalisation, overall budget placement).
concerns: The Raad objected that a belastingplan should contain only measures with a substantial budgetary purpose and that far-reaching measures such as the houdbaarheidsbijdrage belong in separate bills; the government kept the houdbaarheidsbijdrage in the plan for coherence while clarifying its justification.

The Raad found the analysis of sustainability of public finances and the effectiveness of the doorwerkbonus and IACK insufficiently motivated, and asked for quantitative underpinning; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum.

The Raad objected to the packaging tax forfait, arguing it touches the legality principle, lasts five years and leaves gaps in correction; the government adjusted the regime with notification duties and ex officio correction powers while keeping the forfait.
The Raad advised adding a delegation possibility for transitional arrangements on lijfrente splitting, which the government adopted via a ministerial regulation power.

The Raad noted the tonnage regime change could trigger a race to the bottom and EU state aid concerns; the government addressed the race-to-the-bottom point in the explanation but did not change the proposal.

The Raad questioned the retroactive, one-year reduction of the middle corporate tax rate for 2008 and asked for reconsideration; the government kept it, citing available budget money and economic conditions.

31713.s: The bill amends the Ziektewet so that sickness benefit (ziekengeld) can be paid for Saturdays and Sundays for people who work on weekends, capped at five days per calendar week. It adds transitional rules so the new system does not apply to insured persons whose first sickness week lies entirely before entry into force.
31713.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a targeted extension of benefits to weekend workers without expecting abuse, and notes UWV will monitor implementation and report in its first annual report.
q: The UWV will monitor the feasibility of the scheme and report on it in its first annual report after the amendment takes effect.
Het UWV zal de uitvoerbaarheid van de regeling monitoren en hierover rapporteren in het eerste jaarverslag na inwerkingtreding van de wetswijziging.

parties: The CDA asks how UWV will guarantee good control and guidance of sick reports on weekends.
Good control and guidance of sick reports is very important, including on Saturdays and Sundays.
Een goede controle en begeleiding van ziekmeldingen is zeer belangrijk, ook op zaterdag en zondag.
The PVV asks about effects on part-timers and weekend workers, budget provision, and compensation for past cases.
Has this rising expenditure been taken into account in the budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment?
Is met deze stijgende uitgavenlasten rekening gehouden in de begroting van het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid?

31722.s: The bill simplifies and reorganises the statutory bases in the Woningwet so that technical and use rules for buildings, standplaatsen, open spaces and installations are set by a general administrative order (AMvB) under article 2 rather than by municipal building ordinances. It also drops several specific grounds, adds a definition of building that includes installations, and aligns cross-references in related articles.
31722.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the aim of reducing complexity and increasing uniformity of building regulation nationally, and transparency of integrated rules.
q: It is however preferable, in line with the original VNG proposal, to adjust the legal framework so that the power to issue the relevant rules is transferred from the municipal council to national level.

Het verdient echter de voorkeur om – conform het oorspronkelijke VNG-voorstel – het wettelijk kader zodanig aan te passen, dat de bevoegdheid tot het geven van de desbetreffende voorschriften wordt overgeheveld van de gemeenteraad naar rijksniveau.
d: technical rules on building, existing building condition and use of buildings
optional technical rules on standplaatsen and open spaces or terrains
non-technical rules on use, including notification and permit requirements and data availability
p: Rules on use of buildings move from municipal building ordinances, where the municipal council decides, to a national general administrative order, shifting regulatory power from municipalities to central government.
Limits the purposes for which rules may be made to safety, health, usability, energy efficiency or environment.

parties: Asks why the new AMvB uses a nahang rather than a voorhang procedure and whether municipal councils can still accept lower standards than the national decree.
However, these members wonder why this new AMvB has a nahang procedure instead of a voorhang procedure.
Wel vragen deze leden zich af waarom deze nieuwe AMvB een nahang- in plaats van een voorhangprocedure kent.
Worries that transferring procedural and technical rules from municipal building ordinances to the Housing Act limits local room for innovation and asks about categories excluded from the use decree.
Can the government explain what consequences this has for municipalities that want to take a local lead in building regulation.
Kan de regering uiteenzetten welke gevolgen dit heeft voor gemeenten die op het gebied van bouwregelgeving een lokale kop willen toepassen
Asks whether the bill substantively changes or extends existing rules or merely repackages them, and why technical rules on standplaatsen are kept despite planned abolition.
Or does the content of the relevant provisions remain exactly the same and do the provisions just get a different wrapper?
Of blijft de inhoud van de onderhavige voorschriften exact hetzelfde en krijgen de voorschriften alleen een ander jasje?
Supports the government's simplification ambitions and poses questions on the proposal.
These members support the government's ambitions to simplify regulation.
Deze leden ondersteunen de ambities van de regering om te komen tot vereenvoudiging van regelgeving.

31821.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act (WHW) to strengthen institutional governance through a separation of board and supervisory roles, changes to tuition fee rules and student legal protection, and new accreditation and quality procedures. It also introduces an experimentation clause allowing deviation from several chapters of the WHW by general administrative order for up to six years.
31821.j: The memorandum justifies the experiment clause as creating room for pilots aimed at improving quality, and the amvb-based tuition and designation rules as technical matters better handled outside the statute because the tuition system is set by general administrative order.
q: This creates room for pilots and experiments aimed at conducting innovative policy to strengthen quality.
Daarmee wordt onder meer ruimte gecreëerd voor pilots en experimenten die tot doel hebben innovatief beleid ter versterking van de kwaliteit te voeren.
d: designation of branch codes of good governance
amount and indexation of statutory tuition fee
extending categories liable for statutory tuition
ending or refusing enrolment for unsuitability for profession
procedural rules on tuition refunds and enrolment termination
p: Allows the minister, by general administrative order, to set aside large parts of the WHW for experiments up to six years, with only a reporting duty and a four-week consultation before adoption.
Shifts setting of tuition amounts and the scope of statutory tuition liability to general administrative order and institutional boards.
Lets institutions end or refuse a student's enrolment for conduct or statements showing unsuitability for a profession, with advice from the examination board and a proportionality test.

Replaces the earlier appeal route inside institutions with a complaints facility and channels disputes to the College van beroep voor het hoger onderwijs, with the General Administrative Law Act partly disapplied.

parties: Welcomes the statutory separation of board and supervision but asks whether universities lack supervisory boards and how the bill relates to the pending maatschappelijke onderneming bill; also questions the verhaalsrecht as risking excessive juridification.
The CDA members are positive about the statutory anchoring of the strict internal separation of board and supervision.
De leden van de CDA-fractie staan positief tegenover de wettelijke verankering van de strikte interne scheiding van het bestuur en toezicht.
Asks where the line lies between statutory anchoring and the governance code, who sets it, and how medezeggenschap can be substantively strengthened rather than only on paper.
These members ask where the line lies between statutory anchoring and the governance code.
De leden vragen waar hier de grens ligt tussen de wettelijke verankering en de gedragscode.
Objects to financial barriers for second degrees that may waste talent, and asks for stronger medezeggenschap rights, including consent over board pay and bonuses.
They see it as a problem that financial barriers are being erected for pursuing a second study.
Zij zien het als een probleem dat er financiële barrières worden opgeworpen voor het volgen van een tweede studie.

Asks for definitions of independent supervision, why bijzondere instellingen may combine board and supervision, the status of the branchecode and its comply-or-explain link, and the risk of juridification through the refund right and iudicium abeundi.
What is the definition of sound and independent supervision, these members ask.
Wat is de definitie van deugdelijk en onafhankelijk toezicht, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks for clear, testable criteria for the iudicium abeundi so that it does not endanger freedom of expression, and whether second-degree access is safeguarded for lower-income students.
These members are of the view that an iudicium abeundi is only acceptable if it is tied to very clear and testable criteria.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat een iudicium abeundi alleen acceptabel is als hieraan zeer duidelijke en toetsbare criteria zijn verbonden.
Asks the government to explain the pas-toe-of-leg-uit deviations for bijzondere instellingen and the effects of the tuition change on part-time provision and calculating student behaviour.
The members of this fraction request the government to clarify to which deviations the comply-or-explain principle applies.
De leden van voornoemde fractie verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten op welke afwijkingen het «pas toe of leg uit»-principe van toepassing is.

Asks how the rights of staff and students can be differentiated by function, whether smaller institutions can have a softer regime, and how the second-study tuition rule works for theology and ambtsopleidingen.
The SGP members want to know how the government defends the premise that new powers for staff and students are identical.
De leden van de SGP-fractie willen weten hoe de regering het uitgangspunt verdedigt dat nieuwe bevoegdheden voor personeel en studenten gelijkluidend zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Higher Education and Research Act on governance, tuition fees and student legal protection, raising objections on the branchecode definition, the 'pas toe of leg uit' principle, ministerial appointment powers, EU law on cross-border degrees, accreditation, student legal protection, iudicium abeundi and student council committees. The government's reply accepted several points (removing the minister's consent requirement and appointment role, clarifying EU and accreditation aspects) and rejected others such as the definition of branchecode, retaining the 'onherroepelijk' wording, and centralising appeals at the College van beroep voor het hoger onderwijs.
concerns: The Raad objected that the minister's power to hear on and appoint members of supervisory boards at special hogescholen conflicts with freedom of direction and organisation; the provision was removed.
The Raad advised that the designation of branchecodes be done by algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than ministerial regulation.
The Raad advised defining the term branchecode in the law; the government declined, arguing the term is established and definition is unnecessary.

The Raad objected that making branchecodes binding weakens the 'pas toe of leg uit' freedom under Article 23 of the Constitution; the government clarified the principle but did not change the statutory text.

The Raad asked for analysis of EU competition and internal market rules and cross-subsidisation risks for cross-border education; the government added an EU-law discussion to the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad advised retaining the word 'onherroepelijk' in accreditation decisions to avoid premature student withdrawal; the government rejected this advice.

The Raad objected that channelling all student disputes to the College van beroep voor het hoger onderwijs disregards the public/private law distinction and that the minister's consent requirement for special institutions is unnecessary; the government did not fully adopt this and kept centralised appeal with modified rules.
The Raad asked that the iudicium abeundi power be limited to serious misconduct; the government clarified that it is restricted to behaviour inappropriate in professional context.

The Raad advised that student council committees' disputes be routed through the relevant council rather than granting the committees direct access; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
Multiple redactional and technical corrections were recommended and largely incorporated.

31830.s: The bill amends the Wet giraal effectenverkeer to extend legal protection of intermediary clients to non-affiliated intermediaries and non-admitted securities, and to push further dematerialisation by requiring securities to be held via verzamelbewijzen or registered form, removing delivery-out options. It also shifts supervisory cost recovery to the central institute and replaces several approval requirements with instemming.
31830.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly by reducing intermediary and central institute costs and by practical problems with foreign custodians, rather than by any need for new executive discretion.
q: Abolishing a custody company therefore leads to an annual cost saving of EUR 22,000.
Het opheffen van een bewaarbedrijf leidt derhalve tot een jaarlijkse kostenbesparing € 22 000.
d: cost recovery for supervisor's work from central institute
rules of central institute requiring minister's consent
central institute decides which securities may be held in giro depot
p: Deletes the administrative appeal against refusal or withdrawal of admission as affiliated institution, removing a route of challenge for affected institutions.
Extends good-faith transfer protection and enforcement mechanics to intermediaries and central institute, altering property rights of underlying holders without a parallel review mechanism.

parties: Asks about the precise legal consequences for securities protection if the new central custodian or collective depot fails, and about IT disruption risks.
According to the CDA members, the starting point of the legislation must be that securities remain adequately protected.
Het uitgangspunt van de wetgeving moet volgens de leden van de fractie van het CDA zijn dat effecten adequaat beschermd blijven.
Asks about the share of securities covered, whether physical theft occurred, and whether cost savings will lower investor fees.
Reducing regulatory burden and compliance costs is a commendable goal, but the PvdA members have some questions about the current proposal for now.
Vermindering van regeldruk en nalevingkosten is een lovenswaardig doel, maar de leden van de fractie van de PvdA hebben vooralsnog enkele vragen bij het huidige voorstel.
Questions the postponement of full dematerialisation and the separate handling of shareholder identification and derivatives, asking why these were not included now.
The VVD members have question marks about the fact that the integral modernisation and simplification of the act has been postponed indefinitely.
De leden van de fractie van de VVD hebben vraagtekens bij het feit dat de integrale modernisering en vereenvoudiging van de wet op de lange baan is geschoven.

Asks whether investors are adequately informed about safety of their money, whether securities can be transferred without holder consent, and about risks during delivery and control loss from dematerialisation.
Can securities be transferred to another manager without the holder of the securities having given consent for that?
Kunnen effecten worden overgeheveld naar een andere beheerder zonder dat de houder van effecten daar toestemming voor heeft gegeven?

32037.s: The bill transfers the implementation of supplementary social assistance (aanvullende inkomensvoorziening ouderen) for persons aged 65 and over from municipalities to the Sociale verzekeringsbank (SVB), with the SVB taking over the powers, financing and oversight arrangements. It also extends the equal treatment of former foster and step-children with own children across several social security acts, and makes minor AOW adjustments.
32037.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer by reducing non-take-up of supplementary benefits and noting that the SVB already administers the AOW, while stating the SVB receives the same discretionary powers municipalities had.
q: The government realises that, by assigning implementation of WWB65+ to the SVB, municipalities lose their freedom to implement it themselves or outsource it, but the government places reducing citizens' non-take-up above municipal freedom of choice.

De regering beseft dat, met het beleggen van de uitvoering van WWB65+ bij de SVB, de keuzevrijheid van gemeenten om de uitvoering zelf te doen of uit te besteden vervalt, maar de regering laat het belang van het terugdringen van niet-gebruik door de burger prevaleren boven de keuzevrijheid van gemeenten.
d: SVB sets policy rules on reducing benefits and sanctions
Artikel XIII (Art. 9 Wet SUWI reference via explanatory memorandum)
Further rules on alignment of SVB and municipal policy
Artikel IIIA (Art. 51 Wet structuur uitvoeringsorganisatie werk en inkomen, para 4)
Rules for calculating the SVB financing amount and required data
p: Removes municipalities' discretion over supplementary benefits for over-65s and centralises implementation in the SVB, a national executive body under ministerial steering with IWI oversight.
Gives the SVB the power to reduce benefits for non-compliance, with a three-month reconsideration deadline and a no-fault exception.

parties: Asks how re-integration duties of younger partners will be enforced once administration moves to the SVB, since municipalities lose their budget and re-integration incentive, and questions the SVB's discretion on recovery of overpayments.
The municipality bears budget responsibility for the Work and Assistance Act. Against that budget responsibility stands the duty to assist with re-integration.
De gemeente draagt budgetverantwoordelijkheid voor de Wet Werk en Bijstand. Tegenover die budgetverantwoordelijkheid staat de plicht tot hulp bij re-integratie.
Asks for conditions and uniform standards for proving family situations regarding foster or stepchildren, to avoid divergent evidentiary standards.
How will it be prevented that different standards for this burden of proof arise?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat er verschillende maatstaven voor deze bewijslast ontstaan?

Supports the transfer to reduce non-take-up but questions the choice of the WWB regime over the AOW regime, asks who has the final judgement on household situations, and asks about SVB discretion and home ownership rules.
The government writes that the SVB will receive the same policy discretion as municipalities have under the WWB. Can the government elaborate on this?
De regering schrijft dat de SVB dezelfde beleidsvrijheid krijgen als gemeenten hebben in de WWB. Kan de regering dit nader omschrijven?

Not convinced that mandatory transfer of all municipalities is necessary and desirable, given the Raad van State advice; asks who has the final judgement on household situations and whether the effects will be evaluated.
in view of the Council of State's advice, not convinced that it is desirable and necessary to oblige all municipalities to transfer the implementation of WWB65+ to the SVB.
gezien het advies van de Raad van State niet overtuigd te zijn dat het wenselijk en noodzakelijk is om alle gemeenten te verplichten de uitvoering van de WWB65+ aan de SVB over te dragen
Asks about confusion for beneficiaries when partners deal with the SVB and the municipality separately, and about effects on municipal minimum-income policy.
Is the government of the view that confusion can arise once the older partner must report to the SVB and the younger partner must report to the municipality?
Is de regering van mening dat er onduidelijkheid kan ontstaan zodra de oudste partner zich moet melden bij de SVB en de jongste partner zich moet melden bij de gemeente?

v.summary: The Council of State advises that the transfer of the general assistance (WWB65+) execution for people aged 65 and over from municipalities to the Social Insurance Bank should be reconsidered, because the mandatory nature breaks with decentralised execution and the dual structure with municipal special assistance undermines the single-counter goal. The government reply defends the mandatory transfer on grounds of reducing non-take-up and clarifies the reasoning, while making only limited textual changes.
concerns: The Council questions whether mandatory transfer of all municipalities is necessary given less far-reaching instruments, and asks for a substantive justification for breaking with the decentralised system; the government justifies the choice but expands the explanatory memorandum.

The dual structure of municipal special assistance and SVB general assistance may undermine the one-counter goal, and the Council asks for reconsideration; the government responds that cooperation under the SUWI Act will handle household assessment differences but does not change the bill.
A redactional remark on the wording of article 47b WWB is incorporated into the bill.

32127.s: The bill (Crisis- en herstelwet) creates temporary special rules to speed up spatial and infrastructure projects deemed urgent for combating the economic crisis, including limits on appeals by decentral authorities, faster court procedures, and a lex silencio positivo for listed permits. It also amends the Elektriciteitswet, Gaswet, Natuurbeschermingswet, onteigeningswet and other laws, and allows the executive to extend the project lists and experiment via general administrative orders.
32127.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the urgency of combating the economic crisis and the need to accelerate projects while preserving careful decision-making.
q: The social urgency of the projects covered by the proposed Crisis and Recovery Act requires measures that accelerate both government decision-making and court procedures without sacrificing the desired care.

De maatschappelijke urgentie van de projecten die onder de voorgestelde Crisis- en herstelwet vallen vergt maatregelen die bijdragen aan een versnelling van zowel de besluitvorming door de overheid als de procedures bij de rechter zonder af te doen aan de gewenste zorgvuldigheid.
d: adding project categories and legal provisions to annexes
designating development areas as experiments, allowing exemption from environmental statutes
experiments deviating from environmental and planning statutes
radar disturbance zones and building height limits by Defence minister
minister decides which procedures apply to gas transport projects
rules on assessing effects, nitrogen deposition and reporting obligations
p: Removes the right of decentral authorities to appeal to courts against decisions not addressed to them.
Allows administrative bodies and courts to let flawed decisions stand where no beneficiary is harmed, limiting remedies.
Shortens court deadlines, bars protective pro forma appeals, and limits review of norms not protecting the appellant.
Municipal project decisions replace permits and displace most statutory requirements except the Flora- en faunawet.
Lex silencio positivo: applicants obtain permits by silence, bypassing decision-making safeguards.
Expropriation can proceed before planning decisions are final, weakening due-process sequencing.

parties: Asks how the wider crisis package relates to the bill, and warns that faster court procedures may trigger prejudicial questions to the European Court of Justice that delay cases.
There is a risk that the proposed measures to speed up court procedures will raise complex legal questions whose handling takes more time.
Er bestaat een risico dat de nu voorgestelde maatregelen ter versnelling van rechterlijke procedures allerlei complexe juridische vragen oproepen waarvan de behandeling juist meer tijd neemt.

Supports speeding up sustainable projects but questions the broad scope, the ministerial power to add projects, the absence of parliamentary involvement, and whether the law conflicts with EU directives and the Natuurbeschermingswet.
The PvdA members believe the bill gives a great deal of latitude if it applies to all projects listed in the annexes.
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA zijn van mening dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel erg veel ruimte geeft als deze van toepassing is op alle projecten die genoemd worden in de bijlagen.
Welcomes the bill's sustainability elements but questions the open-ended power to extend annexes by ministerial decree and the move to permanent structural changes under a temporary law.
On top of that, the number of rules that apply to it can also be extended without limit.
Daarbovenop kan het aantal regels dat hierop van toepassing is ook onbeperkt worden uitgebreid.
Asks how the Chamber will be involved in implementing and executing the law and how it relates to the Elverding advice.
These members ask how the House of Representatives will be involved in the implementation and execution of this law.
Deze leden vragen hoe de Kamer bij de implementatie en uitvoering van deze wet betrokken zal zijn.

Argues the bill bundles many legal changes without adequate assessment of their coherence and effects, making proper parliamentary scrutiny nearly impossible, and questions whether it will create jobs or speed up anything.
According to the SP members, the sheer number of legal amendments in this Crisis and Recovery Act makes a proper substantive assessment of each amendment nearly impossible.

De veelheid aan wetswijzigingen die deze Crisis- en herstelwet bevat, maakt het volgens de leden van de SP-fractie bijna onmogelijk om een goede inhoudelijke beoordeling per wetswijziging uit te voeren.

Fears the bill weakens nature and environmental protection, the position of environmental organisations, legal certainty and citizens' legal protection, and that it serves 'grey' projects over 'green' ones.
These members are concerned about the erosion of procedural care and legal protection for citizens.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen over de aantasting van de zorgvuldigheid van procedures en de rechtsbescherming voor burgers.

Questions the economic rationale and quantified effects of the bill and notes that the Council of State's critique and the Elverding findings point to other problems, while accepting some specific speed-ups.
The D66 members believe the positive effect the proposed Crisis and Recovery Act should have on combating the economic crisis has not been sufficiently demonstrated.
De leden van de fractie van D66 menen dat de positieve invloed, die de beoogde Crisis- en herstelwet zou moeten hebben op het bestrijden van de economische crisis, onvoldoende is aangetoond.
Presses the government on the Council of State's harsh criticism that some proposals conflict with higher law and general principles of good governance, and asks why these were not revised.
The SGP members noticed that the Council of State is very critical of this bill.
Het is de leden van de SGP-fractie opgevallen dat de Raad van State zeer kritisch is over dit wetsvoorstel.
Rejects the bill, arguing it creates legal uncertainty, breaches EU law (Aarhus Convention, EIA and habitat directives), will not deliver economic or ecological recovery, and will spawn litigation.
Taking everything into account, the Party for the Animals members reject the Crisis and Recovery Act.
Alles overziende, wijzen de leden van de fractie van de Partij voor de Dieren de Crisis- en herstelwet af.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Crisis- and herstelwet, which aims to accelerate spatial and infrastructure projects to counter the economic crisis, concluding that several measures are ineffective or legally problematic and suggesting a Deltawet-style alternative. The government's nader rapport largely rejects the objections, accepting some points (e.g. Deltawet-style procedure for municipal housing projects, clarifications) while defending most measures as legally sound and necessary.
concerns: Limiting the onteigening procedure by decoupling the expropriation judgment from the planning procedure weakens the owner's legal certainty and is considered undesirable as expropriation should be an ultimum remedium.
Amendments to the Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 (nitrogen deposition, saldering, bestaand gebruik) risk gaps in implementation of Habitat Directive article 6 and should be dropped from the bill.
Procedural changes (passing defects, relativiteitsvereiste, time limits, limits on appeal) may reduce legal protection and are doubtful in effectiveness; the government partly adjusted the text.
Restricting the appeal rights of decentralised governments does not fit the system of internal government relations and may lead to duplicate procedures.

Doubts that the bill as a whole effectively and quickly contributes to economic recovery; the Afdeling advised a Deltawet grote rivieren-style alternative, which the government partly embraced for municipal housing projects.

32145.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the 2008 income and capital gains tax treaty with the United Kingdom, including its protocol and mutual agreement. It has no delegation of rule-making power and only a single article of approval and entry into force.
q: The Treaty concluded in London on 26 September 2008 ... is approved for the Netherlands.
Het op 26 september 2008 te Londen totstandgekomen Verdrag ... wordt goedgekeurd voor Nederland.

parties: Objects to the new dual-residence rule for companies because it lacks a result obligation for competent authorities and creates legal uncertainty for businesses.
The CDA members have great difficulty with this new provision because no obligation of result is included for the competent authorities.
De leden van de fractie van het CDA hebben grote moeite met deze nieuwe bepaling omdat er geen resultaatsverplichting is opgenomen voor de bevoegde autoriteiten.
Asks whether a standard tie-breaker rule would be preferable and whether existing residence determinations remain valid, and asks about arbitration exclusion for company cases.
Dependence on consultation between the competent authorities is experienced as unworkable, all the more so since the arbitration rule does not apply to these cases.
Het afhankelijk zijn van het overleg tussen de bevoegde autoriteiten wordt als onwerkbaar ervaren, te meer daar de arbitrageregeling niet op deze gevallen van toepassing is.
Asks for justification of the dual-listed company arrangements and the scope of the treaty for Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
The SP members lack a justification for the dual listed company arrangements.
De leden van de SP-fractie missen een onderbouwing voor de «dual listed company arrangements».

Worries the new residence article creates uncertainty for international business, questions how often companies may be left without treaty protection, and asks how the enhanced-relationship compliance convenants interact with anti-abuse rules.
The new residence article creates uncertainty for international business, according to the VVD members.
Het nieuwe woonplaatsartikel schept onzekerheid voor het internationale bedrijfsleven, aldus de leden van de VVD-fractie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises approval of the tax treaty with the United Kingdom but raises remarks on the explanatory memorandum, including residence of entities, emigration and return rules, trusts and estates, hybrid entities, mutual agreement procedures and the authentic Dutch and English texts. The government's reply accepts the remarks and states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented on each point.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must be self-contained and not refer to other documents for key explanations of the treaty's application, including hybrid entities.
Mutual agreement procedures to combat abuse of treaty provisions must be explained, since they are not defined and their judicial reviewability is unclear.
Remarks on the treatment of dual residence of entities and changes in residence, including unrealised gains, need to be explained.
Remarks on the emigration/return rule, trusts and estate distributions, and the authentic English and Dutch texts are to be addressed in the explanatory memorandum.

32154.s: The bill tightens the rules for claiming long-term care abroad under the AWBZ, limiting cross-border care benefits to EU/EEA/Switzerland for home-based care and allowing general administrative measures to set conditions and exceptions. It also restricts foreign nationals' access to AWBZ care in the Netherlands and transitions existing foreign contracts for one year.
32154.j: The memorandum justifies the restrictions by the difficulty of controlling and monitoring foreign care, fraud risks and rising costs, and says the detailed rules will be set by general administrative measure.
q: By general administrative measure it may be determined in which cases and under which conditions an insured person seeking to enforce an entitlement to care under article 6 may turn to a provider with whom the health insurer has no contract.

in welke gevallen en onder welke voorwaarden een verzekerde die een aanspraak op zorg als bedoeld bij en krachtens artikel 6 van deze wet, tot gelding wil brengen, zich voor deze zorg kan wenden tot een zorgaanbieder met wie de zorgverzekeraar geen overeenkomst heeft gesloten;
d: conditions for care abroad and use of non-contracted providers
p: Lets an AMvB determine in which cases and under which conditions insured persons may claim care from non-contracted providers or abroad, or receive reimbursement instead of care, narrowing entitlements.
Deletes article 11 of the AWBZ, removing a prior entitlement provision for care abroad.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill tightening rules on long-term care abroad under the AWBZ but objects that the proposed financing link via the contracting-space instruction sidesteps parliamentary involvement and weakens individual insurers' financial responsibility, so cost control cannot be fully achieved. The government's reply explains it prefers this practical interim measure over legislation because changing AWBZ governance now would conflict with pending modernisation decisions, while accepting the cost-control concern and adding clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The financing procedure bypasses parliamentary involvement and the Council asks the government to address this in the explanatory memorandum, which the government did, while still declining to legislate.

The chosen financing structure does not optimally contribute to individual insurers' financial responsibility, so the cost-control goal may not be fully achieved; the government acknowledges this but does not change the structure.
The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to address the consequences for care office regions if costs abroad rise, and the government adds clarifications.

32190.s: This bill establishes the customs and excise law (Douane- en Accijnswet BES) for the Caribbean public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, covering import duties, excise, and the formal customs procedures, aircraft and vessel formalities, declarations, controls and bonded warehouses. It largely sets framework rules and delegates detailed procedures to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders.
32190.j: The memorandum justifies the framework structure by saying principled rules belong in the statute while technical detail suited to frequent change goes to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
q: Provisions of a principled nature, such as the rights and obligations of persons, the powers and obligations of customs, the structure of the formalities and supervision system, the regulation of objection and appeal, and administrative fines and criminal sanctions, belong at the level of the statute.

Bepalingen van principiële aard, zoals de rechten en verplichtingen van personen, de bevoegdheden en verplichtingen van de douane, de inrichting van het stelsel van formaliteiten en toezicht, de regeling van bezwaar en beroep en die inzake bestuursrechtelijke boeten en strafrechtelijke sancties, kortom de bepalingen die vooral de rechtsorde betreffen, horen thuis op het niveau van de wet.
d: cases for binding information on customs treatment
data submission rules and exemptions for vessels and aircraft
prohibitions and restrictions on goods crossing borders
criteria and conditions for authorised economic operator status
p: Gives the inspector power to guard goods and vehicles and to bar persons from premises, with the state not liable for loss except for intent or gross negligence.
Allows officials to use force during controls when justified and when no other means achieves the aim, with a warning required beforehand where possible.
Obliges persons to provide information and records on request and removes confidentiality grounds for refusing, including statutory secrecy duties.

parties: Asks the government to explain the abolition of import duties, the distinction between the islands, and which rules are set in the act versus lower regulation (AMvB or ministerial regulation).
Can the government make clear to the CDA members which arrangements are regulated in the act, which in a general administrative order, and which by ministerial regulation?
Kan de regering duidelijk maken aan de leden van de CDA-fractie welke regelingen in de wet worden geregeld, welke in een algemene maatregel van bestuur, en welke bij ministeriële regeling?
Asks about the path toward integration of excise policy and the economic value of alcohol and tobacco trade on Saba and Sint Eustatius.
These members would like to hear the government's view on the path of integration that should be pursued.](Note: integration path questions)
Graag vernemen deze leden de visie van de regering op het pad van integratie dat ingezet zou moeten worden.
Criticises the continuation of special economic zones under the trade and services depot and demands objective criteria, investment conditions and clarity on the minister of Finance's new powers.
Their criticism focuses in particular on the fact that under the heading trade and services depot the special economic zones continue to exist and may even be expanded.
Hun kritiek richt zich in het bijzonder op het feit dat onder de noemer «handels- en dienstenentrepot» de speciale economische zones blijven voortbestaan en mogelijk zelfs worden uitgebreid.

Requests a comparative overview with existing rules and Dutch law, the outcome of the free port study, and justification for deviations from Dutch regulation; questions the thin justification for the wine excise threshold.
These members consider the absence of an explanation where existing arrangements are continued unsatisfactory.
Deze leden achten het ontbreken van een toelichting als sprake is van voortzetting van bestaande regelingen onbevredigend.
Disagrees with the government's reasoning for not levying excise on spirits, wine, beer and tobacco on Saba and Sint Eustatius and considers maintaining the free port status unnecessary.
The PVV members do not follow the reasons the government gives for not levying excise on spirits, wine, beer and tobacco products on Saba and Sint Eustatius.
De leden van de PVV-fractie volgen niet de redenen die de regering aandraagt om geen accijns te heffen op gedistilleerd, wijn, bier en tabaksproducten op Saba en Sint Eustatius.
Asks about the share of indirect taxes, the timetable for removing differences between islands, and which rules go in the law versus lower regulations.
Can the government clarify to what extent, how and within what timeframe it intends to remove these differences in the long term?
Kan de regering nader duiden in hoeverre, op welke wijze en binnen welk tijdsbestek zij voornemens is deze verschillen op termijn weg te nemen?
Asks about effects of higher prices on low-income households and whether a uniform excise regime will eventually apply to the three islands.
To what extent is this expected to affect the purchasing power of the lowest income groups on the islands?
In hoeverre beïnvloedt dit naar verwachting de koopkracht van vooral de laagste inkomensgroepen op de eilanden?
Questions the lack of data on goods flows and cost estimates for the new fiscal system, and whether the tax-free port approach is a success.
These members find it incomprehensible that no estimate has yet been made of this.
Deze leden vinden het onbegrijpelijk dat daar nog geen inschatting van is gemaakt.
Asks for a roadmap for removing differences between islands, a comparative overview of rates and revenues, and questions the high structural administration costs.
These members do, however, ask to make clear when that distinction should be lifted.
Deze leden vragen echter wel duidelijk te maken wanneer dat onderscheid dient te zijn opgeheven.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the Douane- en Accijnswet BES but advises revising the customs-duty chapter (merging or restructuring with the BelBES) and extending excise to all BES islands, since differentiated excise lacks sufficient objective justification. The government's nader rapport keeps the customs chapter for practical reasons, rejects uniform excise on Saba and Sint Eustatius in favour of their free-port status, and adopts the remarks on references to the BelBES and on fully written-out article commentary.
concerns: The Raad advises removing Chapter III on customs duties and merging the customs value rules into the BelBES; the government keeps Chapter III for practical reasons.

The Raad finds the justification for excluding excise on alcohol and tobacco from Saba and Sint Eustatius insufficient and advises levying all excise across the BES islands; the government retains the free-port exemption.

The Raad asks to reconsider which BelBES provisions apply to the excise law, including the criminal provision on failure to declare; the government adjusts the reference and applies the relevant title.
The Raad asks for a fully written-out article-by-article commentary so the regime is self-contained; the government rewrote the commentary accordingly.
The Raad makes redactional remarks on the title and on article 2.32(3) regarding language; the government adopts them.

32208.s: The bill amends the Dutch International Crimes Act to criminalise enforced disappearance as a standalone offence, with aggravated penalties for serious circumstances, and extends extradition law to cover these offences in line with the 2006 UN Convention. It makes no broad delegation of rule-making power to the executive and does not alter oversight or judicial review.
32208.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as implementing the UN Convention on enforced disappearance and as a necessary complement to existing criminal and penitentiary law.
q: This bill aims to implement the International Convention for the Protection of All Persons from Enforced Disappearance, adopted in New York on 20 December 2006.
Dit voorstel van wet strekt tot uitvoering van het op 20 december 2006 te New York tot stand gekomen Internationaal Verdrag inzake de bescherming van alle personen tegen gedwongen verdwijning.

parties: Asks about the difficulty of prosecution in practice and whether the magistrature can manage this legally sensitive field, given few other states have ratified.
The judiciary must find its way through a legally and politically sensitive field.
De magistratuur moet zich door een juridisch en beleidsmatig gevoelig terrein een weg zien te banen.
Asks how evidence and burden of proof work when a state refuses to disclose information, and whether the presumption of innocence applies.
How, for example, can it be proven that a government refuses to provide information about an enforced disappearance?
Hoe kan bijvoorbeeld worden bewezen dat een overheid weigert informatie te verstrekken over een gedwongen verdwijning?
Asks about the continuing nature of the offence, retroactivity, prosecution policy and capacity of police, prosecutors and courts, and the wording of the intent element.
Because it is a continuing offence, cases can be prosecuted where the disappearance took place long ago.
Doordat er sprake is van een doorlopend delict kunnen ook zaken vervolgd worden waar de verdwijning lang geleden heeft plaatsgevonden.

32217.s: The bill sets the monetary system of the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba: the US dollar becomes the currency, with rules on legal tender, the central bank's payment-system role, counterfeit and damaged notes, and conversion from the Netherlands Antillean guilder. It includes transitional rules converting guilder balances and references to dollars at a fixed rate, and penalties for failing to withdraw counterfeit money.
32217.j: The memorandum justifies the general implementing rules by saying they are needed for proper execution of the act across the many areas where guilder references must change.
q: Article 14 makes it possible to set further rules by or under a general administrative order for proper execution of the act.
Artikel 14 Dit artikel maakt het mogelijk om bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels te stellen voor een goede uitvoering van de wet.
d: further rules on central bank payment-system task
further rules for proper implementation of the act
designation of body receiving counterfeit notes by ministerial decision

parties: Asks how medium- and long-term exchange-rate risks are covered and requests that necessary amendments to the Bankwet 1998 be placed in a second tranche rather than a nota van wijziging, enabling parliamentary scrutiny.
These members request the government to include the necessary amendments to the Bankwet 1998 in a second tranche of the ABES and not in a nota van wijziging to the ABES.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering om de noodzakelijke wijzigingen in de Bankwet 1998 op te nemen in een tweede tranche van de ABES en niet in een nota van wijziging op de ABES.

Asks for further argumentation on Dutch assumption of exchange-rate risk, estimates of its size under scenarios, and clarity on what counts as excessive price increases and how they will be prevented.
They do however ask to make clear which measures are being considered to prevent 'excessive price increases'.
Zij vragen echter wel om duidelijk te maken aan welke maatregelen wordt gedacht om «excessieve prijsstijgingen» te voorkomen.
Opposes integration of the islands into the Dutch state and argues they should adopt the euro, while doubting the economic disadvantages of the euro.

If the integration of the BES islands into the Dutch state structure, which these members consider undesirable, goes ahead, then the BES islands must adapt to the European part and not the other way round.

Als de volgens de leden van de PVV-fractie ongewenste integratie van de BES-eilanden in het Nederlandse staatsbestel doorgaat, dan moeten de BES-eilanden zich aan het Europese deel aanpassen en niet andersom.

Asks how monetary stability and price stability can be controlled given no DNB monetary powers over the dollar, and whether the islands become dependent on US policy; asks about cost to the Dutch state and whether the evaluation will cover the dollar's consequences.
How can there still be control over the stability and value of the currency, ask the members of the ChristenUnie faction.
Hoe kan er dan nog wel grip gehouden worden op de waardevastheid en stabiliteit van de munt, zo vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie.

32226.s: The bill creates a one-off legal procedure for allocating an extra Dutch seat in the European Parliament during the current term, after the Lisbon Treaty increased Dutch representation from 25 to 26 seats. It sets out how the central electoral board determines which list receives the seat and which candidate is declared elected, and the law expires on 1 September 2014.
32226.j: The memorandum justifies the procedure as a one-off necessity arising from the Lisbon Treaty, and justifies excluding appeal by analogy with existing Kieswet rules on vacancies.
d: entry into force date set by royal decree
start date of membership set by royal decree
p: Excludes administrative appeal against the central electoral board's determination of the list receiving the seat and the declaration of the elected candidate.
Allows membership start date, departing from the normal Kieswet rule, to be fixed by royal decree.

parties: Questions whether legislating after the elections is consistent with Article 3 of the First Protocol to the ECHR and asks the government to justify its choice against the logic of the Kieswet.
The CDA members invite the government to respond to these questions.</br>
De leden van de CDA-fractie nodigen de regering uit om op deze vragen in te gaan.
Supports treating the seat as a residual seat allocated under the Kieswet, and wants to know the timing of the European Council decision and the central polling board session.
The VVD members support the state secretary's efforts to aim for timely appointment and admission of the extra Dutch member to the European Parliament.
De leden van de VVD-fractie steunen de inzet van de staatssecretaris om te streven naar tijdige benoeming en toelating van het extra Nederlandse lid tot het Europees Parlement.

Argues the government gave the Chamber an incomplete account of the Kiesraad advice, so the Chamber itself must make a political decision on maximal proportionality rather than delegate or accept the government's choice.
The PvdD members ask the government, setting aside party interests, to still choose maximal proportionality in line with the Kiesraad's first advice.
De leden van de PvdD-fractie vragen de regering, met voorbijzien aan partijbelangen, alsnog te kiezen voor maximale evenredigheid, overeenkomstig het eerste advies van de Kiesraad.
Asks why the bill was not submitted earlier, whether post-election legislation is compatible with ECtHR case law, and why the Kiesraad's 75% threshold recommendation was not adopted.
Can the government still provide the underlying motivation for why this is considered undesirable?
Kan de regering alsnog de onderliggende motivering verschaffen waarom dit niet wenselijk wordt geacht?

32244.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Lith and Oss into a new municipality named Oss, with the new municipality taking over the territory of both and related legal references being updated. It also sets transitional rules for a by-election and for the timing of regular council elections, and amends the judicial and police district lists and a safety-regions bill reference.
32244.j: The explanatory memorandum notes that the municipalities themselves proposed the name and that the merger advice was adopted unanimously by the councils and given a positive opinion by the provincial executive.
q: The merger advice was unanimously adopted by the councils concerned on 23 April 2009 and received a positive opinion from the provincial executive of North Brabant.
Het herindelingsadvies is op 23 april 2009 unaniem vastgesteld door de onderhavige gemeenteraden en is voorzien van een positieve zienswijze van gedeputeerde staten van Noord-Brabant.

parties: Asks whether decentralised services will mean a branch office in Lith and what services it will include.
The CDA members wonder whether Oss's decentralised service policy will result in a branch of the town hall in Lith.

De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn benieuwd of het beleid van decentrale dienstverlening in wijken en dorpen van de huidige gemeente Oss tot gevolg zal hebben dat er in het dorp Lith straks een dependance van het gemeentehuis komt.
Asks about the expected effect on internal coherence and how village councils can function in a large cluster.

The PvdA members want to know what effect the government expects on the internal coherence of the new municipality of Oss and what the disadvantages would be of merging these villages with 's-Hertogenbosch.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie willen graag van de regering weten welke invloed zij verwacht op de interne samenhang van de nieuwe gemeente Oss en wat de nadelen zouden zijn van herindeling van deze dorpen bij ’s-Hertogenbosch.
Stresses that local public support is the primary criterion and asks how many residents took part in the survey.

Important criteria for judging the necessity of a merger are for these members the administrative strength of municipalities, internal coherence and, first and foremost, public support among the population.

Belangrijke criteria ter beoordeling van de noodzaak van herindeling zijn voor deze leden de bestuurskracht van gemeenten, de interne samenhang en, in de eerste plaats, het draagvlak onder de bevolking.
Welcomes the bill and has no written questions.
The bill gives these members no reason to ask questions in the written preparation of the parliamentary debate.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen in de schriftelijke voorbereiding van de parlementaire behandeling.
Argues that merger should be binding on residents via binding referenda and not imposed on the population.
In the view of the PVV members, binding referenda should always be held in municipal mergers.
In de visie van de leden van de PVV-fractie dienen er bij gemeentelijke herindelingen altijd bindende referenda te worden gehouden.
Questions the absence of a administrative-strength assessment for Oss and whether the government actually investigated it.
Why was no administrative strength measurement carried out or described in the explanatory notes for the municipality of Oss?
Waarom is er geen bestuurskrachtmeting gehouden of verwoord in de toelichting met betrekking tot de gemeente Oss?

32253.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act to let the minister, on institutional request, approve selection of students and higher tuition (up to five times statutory tuition) for small-scale intensive programmes, subject to accreditation advice and a one-off practice review. It also allows selection for advanced tracks, tightens master admission requirements with a hardship clause, and removes the requirement that half of places be allotted by lottery.
32253.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the experiments showing that selection improves matching in specialised programmes and by the need to end the special regime later.
q: The minister may, on request of the institutional board, grant permission to select applicants for a programme according to criteria set by the board.

Onze minister kan op aanvraag van het instellingsbestuur toestemming verlenen gegadigden bij de inschrijving voor een opleiding te selecteren volgens door het instellingsbestuur vast te stellen criteria
d: approval of specific selection criteria and higher tuition for programmes
rules on applications and required documents
alternative timing or waiver of practice review
institutional rules on selection for advanced tracks
p: The minister receives discretionary power to approve selection and tuition up to five times the statutory fee, limited by conditions of small-scale intensive teaching and no harm to quality or accessibility.
The minister may withdraw approval on listed grounds, a discretionary power whose exercise depends on specific circumstances.
Institutions may select students for advanced tracks within three months of programme start, with rules set by the institution itself.
Institutional boards may refuse master admission on request, with the earlier condition replaced by a hardship exception of overriding unfairness.
Institutions may allocate a percentage of places to candidates they select as having special qualifications, removing the lottery requirement.

parties: Accepts higher tuition for residential intensive programmes but wants limits such as a two percent cap and a three-times rather than five-times tuition ceiling.
At the same time these members insist that such programmes may only be exceptions to the total higher education offer, at most two percent of enrolled bachelor students.
