Tegelijkertijd hechten deze leden er aan dat het in hun ogen om uitzonderingen van het totale onderwijsaanbod in het hoger onderwijs mag gaan, maximaal twee procent van het totale aantal ingeschreven bachelorstudenten.
Asks for clearer definition of residential education and how the government will limit the scope of the term, and questions the role of the NVAO and inspectorate in permission decisions.
Can the government indicate more clearly for which kinds of programmes the term residential precisely applies?
Kan de regering duidelijker aangeven voor welke soort opleidingen de omschrijving «residentieel» precies opgaat?
Fears a two-tier higher education system and reduced access, and questions the lack of mandatory review and student say in tuition use and permission decisions.
The members fear a two-tier system in higher education.
De leden vrezen voor een tweedeling in het hoger onderwijs.
Supports differentiation and selection, but asks how arbitrariness is prevented in NVAO and ministerial decisions and how dispensation is kept from becoming income policy.
How is it prevented that institutions use this possibility for income policy?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat instellingen via deze mogelijkheid «inkomenspolitiek» bedrijven?
Supports matching and differentiation but asks for clarification of intensive education criteria and how objective selection criteria are ensured.
The members ask the government to further explain what is meant by education that is considerably more intensive.
De leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te liggen wat wordt verstaan onder onderwijs dat aanzienlijk intensiever is.
Supports selection and higher tuition if access is guaranteed and asks for evaluation after ten years and research on effects of the hard gate.
In any case these members say the plan must include an evaluation after ten years.
In ieder geval moet volgens deze leden in het plan een evaluatie na tien jaar worden opgenomen.
Asks why selection and higher tuition are not also available for excellence-focused programmes and on what calculation the five-times ceiling is based.
The SGP members ask on what calculation the maximum of five times the statutory tuition is based.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen op welke berekening het maximum van vijf maal het wettelijke collegegeld berust.

32271.s: The bill replaces the Huisvestingswet with a new housing allocation law that lets municipal councils, by ordinance, require allocation permits for cheap housing, set priority and urgency criteria, impose binding requirements, and regulate conversions and splits of housing stock with fines. It also keeps national instruments such as the duty to house residence-permit holders, with national and provincial enforcement powers, and removes most provincial and national ex ante oversight of municipal ordinances.
32271.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers by the need to address scarcity of cheap housing and liveability problems, and to decentralise tasks and reduce provincial and national oversight.
q: Using the powers of the new housing act on the allocation of housing infringes the freedom of settlement and property rights.
Het gebruik van de bevoegdheden van de Huisvestingswet 20.. omtrent de verdeling van woonruimte maakt inbreuk op het recht op vrijheid van vestiging en het eigendomsrecht.
d: municipal council designates categories of cheap housing requiring permits
municipal council gives priority to socially defined applicants in designated streets or complexes
mayor and aldermen assign applicants to urgency categories and may delegate this
minister designates categories of applicants needing special state support in housing
municipal council sets administrative fine amounts in the housing ordinance
general administrative order sets data reporting duties to the minister
p: Municipal officials may enter a home without the resident's consent to check compliance with the housing ordinance.
Municipal council may use powers only if necessary, suitable, subsidiary and proportionate, a constraint on local executive action.
Fixes the formula for the national allocation of residence-permit holders to municipalities.
If municipalities fail to house residence-permit holders, provinces act on their behalf at municipal expense, with consultation and a deadline first.
Establishes a national information right over municipal enforcement bodies, which the memorandum says will be removed later.

parties: Asks whether the bill's undefined scarcity concept, absence of fixed price limits and open-ended ordinance powers respect property rights, freedom of settlement and the ECHR.
In their view this could mean owners of homes are in effect 'outlawed' and the right to free settlement is heavily restricted.
Dit kan er naar hun mening toe leiden, dat eigenaren van woningen in feite «vogelvrij» zijn en het recht op vrije vestiging vergaand wordt ingeperkt.
Supports government steering of housing for residence-permit holders and asks for clarification of definitions in the allocation quota.
In the PvdA faction's view the new act gives municipalities instruments to intervene in housing allocation and the composition of the housing stock.
In de ogen van de PvdA-fractie biedt de nieuwe wet gemeenten een instrumentarium om in te grijpen in de woonruimteverdeling en de samenstelling van de woonruimtevoorraad.
Worried that the act is too narrowly focused on cheap rentals and that municipalities could use removal permits against second-home owners; wants protections for owners.
The PVV members are of the view that the consequences of tightness in the rental market must not be shifted onto owners of a second owner-occupied home.
de leden van de PVV-fractie zijn van mening dat de gevolgen van krapte op de huurwoningenmarkt niet op eigenaren van een tweede koopwoning mag worden afgewenteld
Accepts that free settlement can be overridden for serious reasons but questions the narrow definition of liveability and asks the government to tighten the bill.
At the same time these members note with the government that there may be weighty reasons for the local authority to infringe on this starting point.
Tegelijkertijd stellen deze leden met de regering vast dat er voor de lokale overheid zwaarwegende redenen kunnen zijn om op dit uitgangspunt een inbreuk te maken.
Has mixed feelings; wants a fair distribution of scarcity with local discretion, a national framework for emergency allocation, and protection of local residents.
The Housing Act must create the framework for a fair distribution of that scarcity, with room for local customisation.
De Huisvestingswet moet de kaders creëren voor een eerlijke verdeling van die schaarste, met ruimte voor lokaal maatwerk.
Sees the bill as only a partial fix that does not address structural market problems; asks why urgency can apply without scarcity and how proportionality is met.
Can the government explain at length why it considers it justifiable that this infringement is made?
Kan de regering uitgebreid toelichten waarom zij het te rechtvaardigen vindt dat deze inbreuk wordt gemaakt?
Welcomes the improved justification requirement for local policy but questions whether liveability steering is too narrow and whether criteria allow timely action.
These members see in the bill an important improvement regarding the justification requirement for this local policy.
Deze leden zien in het wetsvoorstel een belangrijke verbetering als het gaat om de motiveringseis van dit lokale beleid.
Asks whether the lifestyle criterion could in practice exclude people of a certain ethnic background, i.e. (in)direct discrimination, and about limiting interventions to single complexes or streets.
ask whether the government wants to prevent the lifestyle criterion being applied such that in practice only citizens of a certain ethnic background are excluded.
vragen of de regering wil voorkomen dat het criterium leefstijl dusdanig wordt ingevuld dat de facto alleen burgers met een bepaalde etnische achtergrond worden uitgesloten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Huisvestingswet 20.. (new rules on housing allocation and housing stock), supporting its aim but raising objections on the leefbaarheid criterion, urgency schemes, allocation ranking, lex silencio positivo permits and information provision. The minister's nader rapport largely followed the advice, though it kept lex silencio positivo and rejected the urgency-scheme restriction.
concerns: Leefbaarheid should be limited to combating overlast that threatens liveability, to keep restrictions on freedom of settlement proportionate and objectifiable.
Social-characteristic selection risks indirect discrimination contrary to Article 1 Constitution; the explanation should be supplemented and criteria clarified.
Urgency schemes for housing not in scarcity areas may unjustifiably restrict freedom of settlement and should be limited to necessary, proportionate cases.
Granting permits by operation of law without formal decision-making raises legal uncertainty; the Afdeling advised deleting the provision.
Explanatory memorandum should address legal protection of applicants when allocation ranking criteria are unclear or incorrectly applied.
The legal basis for information provision rules should be an AMvB rather than a ministerial regulation, given Gemeentewet and Provinciewet requirements.
Several redactional and cross-reference corrections were recommended and incorporated.

32280.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Bussum, Muiden, Naarden and Weesp into a new municipality called Naardermeer from the date of reorganisation, and updates related legal references such as district, police and safety-region lists. It also sets transitional rules for council elections, designates Naarden to prepare the election, and assigns the new municipality for specific provisions of the general reorganisation law.
32280.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by reference to the Raad van State advice and the Commissie van Wijzen findings that cooperation alternatives lack sufficient mutual trust, so reorganisation is preferred for transparency and local democracy.
q: The Council of State also indicates that, with a view to transparency of government and the functioning of local democracy, it prefers reorganisation over cooperation in certain cases.
De Raad van State geeft tevens aan dat zij met het oog op de transparantie van het bestuur en het functioneren van de lokale democratie herindeling in bepaalde gevallen verkiezen boven samenwerking.
d: designation of new municipality for application of reorganisation-law provisions on taxes, joint arrangements and utilities

parties: Seeks broader local support and asks how financial risks around the KNSF site and a boundary correction for Weesp should be handled, without raising a clear check concern.
They conclude that almost everyone holds a different view on how this reorganisation can be brought to a successful conclusion.
Zij komen tot de conclusie dat vrijwel iedereen een afwijkende opvatting heeft over de vraag hoe deze herindeling tot een goed einde kan worden gebracht.
Asks the government to justify its position against the Commission of Wise Men's conclusions and to explain how a boundary correction addresses the bestuurskracht shortcomings found.
These members would like to hear how the government views the conclusion of the report of this Commission of Wise Men.
Graag horen deze leden hoe de regering aankijkt tegen de conclusie uit het rapport van deze Commissie van Wijzen.
Opposes the merger because municipal councils and residents should have their own responsibility and say over municipal reorganisation.
They are of the opinion that municipal governments and their residents should themselves have responsibility and say over municipal reorganisation.
Zij zijn van mening dat de gemeentebesturen en haar inwoners zelf verantwoordelijkheid en zeggenschap moeten hebben inzake gemeentelijke herindeling.
Asks the minister to justify the chosen variant against the new policy framework and to explain the Commission of Wise Men's findings and a second opinion.
The CDA members invite the minister to test his preferred variant of this reorganisation against the new reorganisation policy framework of this minister.
De leden van de CDA-fractie nodigen de minister uit om zijn voorkeursvariant van deze herindeling te toetsen aan het nieuwe beleidskader herindeling van deze minister.
Criticises the lack of citizen support, the flawed process, and the failure to examine alternatives such as cooperation, and asks the minister to respond to a second opinion.
Residents have not been able to express themselves sufficiently on the provincial proposal.
Inwoners hebben zich onvoldoende kunnen uitspre ken over het provinciale voorstel.
Asks why the government submits a bill it does not support and whether it will send an amendment note, and questions the breadth of support for the revised variant.
Why does the government submit to the House a bill that it actually is not in favour of?
Waarom legt de regering de Kamer een wetsvoor stel voor waar zij eigenlijk geen voorstander van is?
Asks whether the Raad van State's finding that no alternatives exist is still valid and why the government did not examine an improved advice as was requested for another reorganisation.
Seeks clarity on the revised proposal, the boundary correction, the financial position of Weesp and Muiden, and the views of surrounding municipalities.
They would like more clarity on a number of points.
Zij willen graag op een aantal punten meer duidelijkheid.

v.summary: The Raad van State finds the bill merging Bussum, Muiden, Naarden and Weesp into Naardermeer procedurally sound and sees no better alternative, despite Bussum lacking administrative support; it advises to proceed. The government's reply accepts the Raad's view, drops the Naarden-Huizen boundary correction for lack of support in Huizen, and makes minor redactional and text changes.
concerns: The Raad finds no samenwerkings- or herindelingsalternatief that matches the Beleidskader criteria as well as the proposed merger and addresses the bestuurlijke knelpunten.
A redactional remark on the samenloopbepaling in article 9 was incorporated into the bill.

32316.s: The bill introduces a competence-based qualification structure for vocational education (mbo) in the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs, replacing the experimental regime with permanent rules on qualification dossiers, learning domains and an entry qualification. It also adds a general experimentation article allowing ministerial order-in-council deviation from parts of the WEB for up to six years.
32316.j: The memorandum justifies the experimentation article as a way to improve quality, accessibility and efficiency of vocational education while the competence-based structure is developed, with an evaluation before the experiment ends.
q: With a view to improving the quality, accessibility or efficiency of vocational education, an general order in council may, by way of experiment, deviate from
Met het oog op verbetering van de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid of doelmatigheid van het beroepsonderwijs kan bij wijze van experiment bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden afgeweken van
d: I, A.9 (art. 1.1.1 WEB, definitions) and art. 7.2.4 WEB
qualification dossiers and qualifications for vocational education
conditions for funding of qualification-based programmes
termination of registrations in the Central register
further rules on content of qualification dossiers
designation of advisory body and establishment of learning domains
maximum percentage of students enrolling in learning domains
experiments deviating from chapters 2, 6 and 7 of the WEB
content and security of mbo diplomas
p: Allows the minister, by general order in council after a four-week pre-submission period, to deviate from core parts of the WEB in experiments lasting up to six years, with a report to parliament before expiry.

parties: Asks for further explanation on several points, including the number of institutions ready for introduction and the effect of dropping partial qualifications.
The VVD members still need further explanation on several points.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben op verschillende punten nog de behoefte hebben aan een nadere toelichting.
Worries that competency-based education could lower supervision by qualified teachers and asks whether recommendations of advisory commissions are adopted.
They ask whether the government adopts these recommendations.
Zij vragen of de regering deze aanbevelingen overneemt.
Asks whether the bill is mature enough to be enacted now, and whether recent reports require changes to the bill.
Critical that the law dictates how teaching must occur, risking teachers being forced into a competency didactic and subject knowledge being crowded out.
By emphasizing competencies, the law regulates not only what must be learned but to a large extent how it must be learned.
Door de nadruk op competenties, regelt de wet niet alleen wát geleerd moet worden, maar ook in grote mate hoe dat moet gebeuren.
Asks about administrative burden, licence withdrawal at qualification level affecting multi-site programmes, and maximum shares of students in education domains.
These members note that the government wants to be able to withdraw licences at the qualification (Crebo) level.
Deze leden constateren dat de regering op het niveau van de kwalificatie (Crebo) licenties wil kunnen intrekken.
Asks how the conditions set by a parliamentary motion were met and how teachers' position in drafting qualification requirements can be secured.
However, these members ask the government to further examine how teachers can claim their position in developing the qualification requirements.
Wel verzoeken deze leden de regering nader toe te zien op welke wijze docenten hun positie bij de ontwikkeling van de kwalificatie-eisen kunnen claimen.
Questions the coherence of mixing differentiation with centralised uniformity and the lack of a clear concept of competences.
They ask whether this approach is sufficiently coherent and gives a clear signal to the sector.
Zij vragen of deze aanpak voldoende coherent is en een eenduidig signaal geeft naar de sector.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill introducing a competency-based qualification structure in vocational education but raises concerns about teacher support, alignment with reference levels, transition to higher vocational education, and the definition of certificates, advising revision. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most points, adding clarifications, a separate section on teacher and student involvement, a reference to reference levels, a restored transition provision, and a definition of certifiable units.
concerns: The Afdeling finds insufficient evidence of teacher support for competency-based education and asks that this be demonstrated, while the government adds clarifications on teacher involvement without fully proving broad support.
The Afdeling asks that the link between competencies and reference levels for language and arithmetic be explained, and the government addresses this in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling argues that transition from the highest vocational levels to higher vocational education must be safeguarded in the statute itself, and the government restores the relevant provision in the Act.
The Afdeling asks for a statutory definition of certificate, and the government clarifies the concept in the explanatory memorandum and revises the certifiable unit definition.
The Afdeling suggests using the term kwalificatiedossier consistently, and the government makes technical changes but does not adopt the suggested term kwalificatiedossierprogramma.

32343.s: The bill amends the Mining Act to implement EU Directive 2009/31/EC on geological storage of carbon dioxide and OSPAR Decision 2007/2, adding permits for exploring CO2 storage complexes and a dedicated regime for permanent CO2 storage permits, including monitoring, reporting, closure, post-closure liability and third-party access. It also sets transitional rules for existing permits and entry into force by royal decree.
32343.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegations as necessary because the directive's operational detail is still experimental and not yet understood, so general rules will be set by ministerial regulation and algemene maatregel van bestuur.
q: Because the current projects are at an early and still experimental stage, there is no clear insight into how much third-party access matters in practice
Vanwege het prille stadium en het nog experimentele karakter van de huidige projecten bestaat nog geen duidelijk inzicht in de vraag welk belang in de praktijk aan toegang voor derden toekomt
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A/H (artikel 26b, 31a-31n framework, artikel 31a second paragraph)
rules on characterisation, monitoring, reporting and register of CO2 storage
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 31d, derde lid)
further rules on contents of permanent CO2 storage permits
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 31e, tweede lid referenced; artikel 31f tweede lid)
rules on the structure of the register of CO2 flows
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 31g tweede lid)
data to be reported on CO2 storage and timing of reporting
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 31j derde lid)
rules on withdrawal of storage permits
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 31k zesde lid)
rules on monitoring and corrective measures after permit withdrawal
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 31i)/Q (artikel 32 vierde lid)
further rules on third-party access to CO2 transport and storage
p: The minister may amend or withdraw a permanent storage permit on several grounds, including new scientific findings, with review only after five years and then every ten years.
After permit withdrawal the minister takes over monitoring, corrective measures and liability, with cost recovery from the former permit holder.
The minister decides permit applications within ten months, extendable by up to six months, with advice from the European Commission and publication in the Staatscourant.

parties: Asks whether the implementing rules follow the directive without additions, requests the AMvB on third-party access be submitted to parliament, and asks for clarity on the permit procedure and the opsporing permit.
These members explicitly ask to indicate whether this transposition follows the directive in all parts of the bill and whether there are no 'add-ons' to the directive.
Deze leden vragen daarbij expliciet aan te geven of deze omzetting op alle onderdelen van het wetsvoorstel de richtlijn volgt en er geen sprake is van «koppen» op de richtlijn.

Sceptical of CCS as climate policy, asks for an efficiency threshold, and asks how citizens and interest groups can object to projects and whether legal protection gaps arise between the two CCS bills.
How does the government intend to prevent a gap in legal protection arising between the moments the two CCS laws take effect?
Hoe denkt de regering te voorkomen dat er een gat valt in de rechtsbescherming tussen de momenten van invoering van de beide CCS-wetten?

Asks detailed questions on liability for CO2 leakage, criminal enforcement, the role of the Nea and SodM, the European Commission advisory role, and whether the Rijkscoordinatie procedure and removal of appeal rights for local authorities weaken review.
The bill provides in Article 31c a decision period of ten months on a permit application.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet middels artikel 31 c in een beslistermijn op een vergunningsaanvraag van tien maanden.

Worried about transfer of liability to the State after storage and wants certainty about safe permanent storage before injection, plus exploration in aquifers; also asks whether permit procedures must restart.
These members believe CO2 may only be stored if there is no doubt beforehand about safe and permanent storage.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat alleen CO 2 opgeslagen mag worden als reeds vooraf geen enkele twijfel bestaat over veilige en permanente opslag.
Asks about liability for leakage, open third-party access costs, the 20-year period before the State takes over, supervision by SodM, and effects on the Barendrecht and Sittard-Geleen projects.
The ChristenUnie members ask about the choice of 20 years before the State takes over responsibility.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen naar de keuze voor 20 jaar als termijn, voordat de Staat de verantwoordelijkheid overneemt.
Asks about consequences for EU funding timelines and the speed of AMvB adoption for demonstration projects.
However, the proposed amendments raise several concrete questions for these members regarding consequences for possible European funding and realisation of the CO2 storage demonstration projects.

Wel roepen de voorgestelde wijzigingen bij deze leden een aantal concrete vragen op in verband met consequenties voor de eventuele Europese financiering en de realisatie van de demonstratieprojecten voor CO 2 -opslag.

32360-IIB.s: This slotwet amends the 2009 budget statements of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the Governors' cabinets of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba, setting final realised figures for the year. The bill's operative articles only set the unit (thousands of euros) and entry into force, with the budget tables attached.
q: The budget statement of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, the Nationale ombudsman, the Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, the Cabinet of the Governor of the Netherlands Antilles and the Cabinet of the Governor of Aruba (IIB) for 2009 is amended.

De begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman, de Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, het Kabinet van de Gouverneur van de Nederlandse Antillen en het Kabinet van de Gouverneur van Aruba (IIB) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd

32424.s: The bill amends the Wet personenvervoer 2000 to introduce a dedicated taxi chapter, tighten the definition of taxi transport, and give municipalities new powers by ordinance to set quality rules for street taxi services, including a model of mandatory groups of taxi operators in designated areas. It also drops the professional competence requirement for the operator licence and adds related enforcement and penal provisions.
32424.j: The memorandum justifies the municipal powers by local taxi quality problems, the need for proportionate and tailored measures, and the weak position of the national law, and it promises an evaluation of the group model.
d: definition of passenger car by ministerial regulation
rules on equipment, inspection, tariffs display, minimum availability and operator requirements for taxi transport
minister may exempt from requirements of reliability and professional competence
taxi tariff structure and maximum tariff
municipal ordinance rules on quality of street taxi services
municipal ordinance on vehicle recognisability, driver requirements, complaints and fees
further rules on municipal quality powers
municipal ordinance making certain streets reserved to organisational groups of taxi operators
Besluit personenvervoer 2000 and tariff regulation rest on new articles
p: Municipalities may restrict use of public streets to members of organisational groups of taxi operators, with independent third-party controls and an evaluation requirement as safeguards.
Municipal mayor and aldermen may impose an order under administrative coercion, departing from the general rule of art. 93 for enforcement of municipal taxi rules.
Minister may grant exemption from the professional competence requirement for taxi operators.

parties: Asks why enforcement of mandatory service areas is assigned to the Inspectie rather than municipalities, and how exclusion and concentration of market power will be prevented.
The VVD members ask the government to justify why this enforcement is not a task for the municipalities.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering om te onderbouwen waarom deze handhaving niet een taak wordt van de gemeenten.
Asks whether split enforcement under two laws weakens enforcement and what municipal powers the articles 82-82b actually cover.
The PvdA members ask whether the enforcement instruments thereby lose their strength.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of het handhavinginstrumentarium hiermee niet aan kracht verliest.
Objects to municipal power to set both the number and size of taxi groups, which it sees as unrelated to passenger quality and as giving municipalities too much influence over market entry.
The PVV members object to limiting the number of groups per municipality, because they too find the bill unclear on this point.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben bezwaar tegen het beperken van het aantal groepen per gemeente, omdat ook zij het wetvoorstel op dit punt onduidelijk vinden.

Objects to ministerial power to exempt drivers from the national competence exam, demands clear measurable qualifications and clear complaint, sanction and oversight procedures, and asks why only the G4 may use grouping.

These members ask whether the stated possibility of exemption applies only to drivers belonging to a group in a municipality that introduces grouping, or whether the minister can also grant exemptions to other drivers.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de genoemde mogelijkheid tot vrijstelling alleen geldt voor chauffeurs die behoren tot een groep binnen een gemeente die groepsvorming invoert, of dat de minister ook vrijstelling kan verlenen aan andere chauffeurs.

Asks how concentration of power in one group can be avoided, asks for justification of limiting grouping to the G4, and asks whether municipalities can set a maximum number of groups in a legally sound way.
These members ask how it can be prevented that too much power ends up with a single group.
Genoemde leden vragen hoe daarbij kan worden voorkomen dat er teveel macht bij één groep komt te liggen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet personenvervoer 2000 to improve taxi quality, mainly questioning the effectiveness of group formation (groepsvorming) and its compatibility with competition, free movement of services and freedom of association, and advising limiting it to the G4 cities. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, narrowing group formation to designated municipalities (G4), adding a minimum-number-of-groups norm and clarifying the relationship between national and municipal rules.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that group formation will sufficiently correct market power of taxi drivers and that municipal supervision is secured; government explains internal supervision and adds a minimum-group norm but keeps the model.
The Afdeling flags possible conflicts with EU competition rules, the nuttig effect rule and free movement of services, asking for justification and consultation with the Commission and NMa.
The Afdeling advises restricting group formation geographically to designated municipalities (G4) given proportionality and necessity.
The Afdeling notes a possible restriction of freedom of association under Article 11 ECHR from group formation, which the government addresses in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling advises deleting the Minister's power to set rules on the exercise of municipal powers, given the aim of less detailed medebewind; government turns the obligation into a discretionary power.

The Afdeling asks for clarity on how municipal regulations relate to the Besluit personenvervoer 2000 and whether additional rules such as a municipal taxi exam are permissible under articles 121 and 122 Gemeentewet; the explanatory memorandum is supplemented.
Editorial remarks on wording and cross-references are adopted.

32433.s: The bill modernises heritage conservation by removing the fifty-year age threshold for monuments, abolishing applications for protection of post-1939 and archaeological monuments, and letting the minister subsidise reuse of immovable monuments via ministerial regulation. It also simplifies permit requirements for minor interventions on protected monuments and makes related technical amendments to the Wabo and the Wet kenbaarheid.
32433.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as modernisation that reduces administrative burden on the Rijksdienst and municipalities and avoids damage to monuments, with technical details left to ministerial regulation.
q: This amendment results in a reduction of burdens for both the Cultural Heritage Agency and the municipalities.
Deze wetswijziging resulteert in een lastenvermindering voor zowel de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed als de gemeenten.
d: rules for reuse subsidies for immovable monuments
p: Competent authority must consult, and for decisions affecting religious interests must agree with, the owner of a church monument before deciding.
Reduces the cases in which the monument-specific consultation procedure applies, limiting it to substantial interventions where advice is requested under article 2.26(3).
Pending applications for designation and permit applications are handled under the old law, preserving or ending existing procedural rights depending on filing date.

parties: Asks how arbitrariness in ambtshalve designations will be guarded against now that third parties can no longer request designation, and what the verbeteracties entail.
How will arbitrariness in designations be guarded against, now that third parties can no longer submit requests for designation, the members ask.
Op welke wijze zal worden gewaakt voor willekeur in de aanwijzingen, nu derden geen verzoeken tot aanwijzing meer kunnen indienen, zo vragen de leden.
Supports dropping the 50-year limit but asks what role citizens and advocacy groups keep, what instruments they have for timely protection, and how the 10-year bestemmingsplan cycle fits.
Can the government indicate which instruments citizens and advocacy groups have to protect a building or complex with urgency?
Kan de regering aangeven welke instrumenten burgers en belangengroeperingen in handen hebben om een gebouw of complex met zekere spoed te beschermen?
Asks about handles against owners who prefer demolition over reuse and about the registration and handling of archaeological findings and soil research.
The members also ask whether there is a central overview of what is done with the outcomes and finds of soil investigations and whether it is centrally registered where soil research has taken place.

Verder vragen de leden of er een centraal overzicht is wat er allemaal wordt gedaan met de uikomsten en vondsten van de bodemonderzoeken en of centraal wordt geregistreerd waar bodemonderzoek is gedaan?
Fears loosening of rules weakens monument protection and asks how citizens can express involvement in spatial planning and whether municipalities have sufficient heritage expertise.
In what way can citizens express their involvement? Is there, for example, citizen participation regulated in spatial planning?
Op welke wijze kunnen burgers hun betrokkenheid uiten? Is er bijvoorbeeld in de ruimtelijke ordening inspraak van burgers geregeld?
Argues that a later check by civil society is needed because heritage can escape government attention early on, and asks the government to justify scrapping citizen nomination after 1940.
Is the government not of the opinion that in these cases an additional, later 'check' by societal forces could be a desirable element?
Is de regering niet van mening dat in deze gevallen een extra, latere «check» van maatschappelijke krachten een wenselijk element kan zijn?
Stresses that citizens and advocacy groups should keep influence over safeguarding heritage interests and asks whether participation remains possible after bestemmingsplannen are adopted.
Are there still possibilities for participation in already adopted zoning plans that are not yet due for revision?
Zijn er nog mogelijkheden voor inspraak bij al vastgestelde bestemmingsplannen, die voorlopig nog niet aan herziening toe zijn?
Asks what safeguards ensure that small municipalities deploy the necessary heritage expertise and whether transparency of designation policy remains once citizen requests and formal decisions lapse.

The members ask to what extent the transparency of designation policy remains guaranteed when the possibility of a designation request lapses and the minister's decisions are no longer issued as formal decisions.

De leden vragen in hoeverre de transparantie van het aanwijzingsbeleid gegarandeerd blijft wanneer de mogelijkheid van aanvraag tot aanwijzing vervalt en beslissingen van de minister niet meer in de vorm van een beschikking worden gegeven.

32451.s: The bill adds a title to the Environmental Management Act creating a cost-equalisation system for CO2 emissions above a set collective ceiling for greenhouse horticulture, with the level or calculation method set by general administrative order. It lets the minister requisition a trade body (bedrijfslichaam) to implement the system via a regulation subject to ministerial approval, with disciplinary enforcement and no double sanctioning under the Environmental Management Act.
32451.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the sector's knowledge and fit with business operations, the aim of avoiding double sanctioning, and the need for ministerial control over the climate-policy implementation.
q: It is desirable to give the Minister of VROM the power to requisition cooperation from a trade body for implementing a cost-equalisation system.
Het is wenselijk om de Minister van VROM de bevoegdheid toe te kennen medewerking te vorderen van een bedrijfslichaam voor de uitvoering van een systeem van kostenverevening.
d: Artikel I A, artikel 15.51, derde lid
setting the permitted CO2 emission quantity for greenhouse horticulture
level or calculation method of the equalisation fee
Artikel I A, artikel 15.53, eerste lid
requisitioning cooperation of a trade body for implementation
Artikel I A, artikel 15.53, tweede lid
detailed rules by regulation of the trade body, requiring ministerial approval
Artikel I A, artikel 15.53, derde lid
designating regulation violations punishable by disciplinary measures
Artikel I A, artikel 15.53, vijfde lid
appointment of supervisors and ministerial instructions to the trade body
p: Enforcement is shifted to a sectoral trade body under disciplinary law, with the minister holding approval and instruction powers over it.

parties: Asks about the broader national and European context of the bill and the policy background.
These members understand that this bill is part of broader agreements, both at national and European level and with the greenhouse horticulture sector.
Achtergrond Deze leden van de VVD-fractie begrijpen dat dit wetsvoorstel onderdeel is van bredere afspraken, zowel op nationaal en Europees niveau, als met de glastuinbouwsector.
Supports the aim but asks whether the Productschap Tuinbouw, rather than the ministry, should run the system and how individual overshoot penalties and exemptions work.
Would it not be better to have the implementation fully placed with the Ministry of VROM?
Is het niet beter om de uitvoering geheel bij het ministerie van VROM te leggen?
Opposes the bill because it rejects the Kyoto protocol and doubts that CO2 warms the planet.
Since these members reject the Kyoto Protocol and it is not certain to them that CO2 has a warming effect on the earth, these members are strongly opposed to introducing this bill.

Aangezien deze leden het Kyoto-verdrag verwerpen en het voor hen niet zeker is dat CO 2 een opwarmend effect op de aarde heeft, zijn deze leden een groot tegenstander van de invoering van dit wetsvoorstel.
Supports cost-equalisation but asks how overshoot penalties are calculated, whether the system is only a grandfathering, and why proceeds go to general funds rather than linked to emission trading.

In the system, is there in fact grandfathering, whereby front-runners in energy efficiency and effectiveness are not rewarded and laggards can in principle keep producing in outdated greenhouses with broken panes, as long as they stay within the ceiling once agreed?

Is er in het systeem feitelijk sprake van «grandfathering», waarbij voorlopers in energie-efficiëntie en effectiviteit niet worden beloond en/of achterblijvers in principe tot in lengte van dagen in verouderde kassen met kapotte ruiten producten kunnen telen, mits ze maar binnen het ooit afgesproken plafond blijven?
Asks what instruments and sanctions the government has if the sector fails, how free-riders are handled, and whether the implementing body is sufficiently independent.
According to these members, it certainly appears that the butcher is inspecting his own meat in this way.
Het heeft er volgens deze leden immers alle schijn van dat op deze manier de slager zijn eigen vlees keurt.

Supports the emission goal but questions the justification from a 2006 study, the choice of disciplinary law for enforcement, the verification of energy data, and the procedure for setting the emission ceiling.
Supports the goal but asks whether the ceiling-setting is open to publication, objection and appeal under the Aarhus Convention, and whether the system truly delivers additional reductions.
These members ask whether this data is public and whether the proposed procedure fits within Article 7 of the Aarhus Convention.
Deze leden vragen of deze gegevens openbaar zijn en of de voorgestelde procedure past binnen artikel 7 van het Verdrag van Arhus.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill creating a cost-equalisation system for CO2 emissions should be limited to the greenhouse horticulture sector, that its core elements should be set out in law, and that the expected effectiveness in the initial phase to 2013 was doubtful. The minister's reply adopted the sector limitation and core elements in the law but did not follow the advice on cost-efficiency criteria, prior consultation or the early-phase justification.
concerns: The broad delegation in article 15.51 to regulate by general administrative order was criticised; the core elements were moved into the law but the delegation in the third paragraph was retained in some form.

Doubt that the cost-equalisation system will have a substantial emission-reducing effect before 2013, given the expected non-binding emissions ceiling; the advice to justify early introduction was not followed.
Recommendation to add cost-efficiency criteria to article 15.51 was not followed because the bill was limited to one concrete system.
Recommendation for prior consultation with the sector before designation was not followed because the sector had already been consulted.
Editorial remark in the annex was not adopted because the article had been changed so that the remark no longer applied.
Scope was limited to greenhouse horticulture so that other sectors cannot be subjected to the system without a specific statutory basis, as the Raad advised.

32460.s: The bill repeals the Wet stedelijke vernieuwing (urban renewal act) and reassigns the responsibility for urban renewal to municipal and provincial executives and the minister, while adding a new section to the Woningwet. It also sets transitional rules for ongoing investment budgets and existing regulations, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2011.
32460.j: The memorandum justifies the repeal by pointing to the decentralisation of the investment budget and the already-agreed programmes, with horizontal accountability between council and executive replacing national oversight.
q: The national government no longer imposes procedural requirements. Furthermore, accountability to the national government is dropped.
Het Rijk stelt daarbij geen procesvereisten meer. Verder vervalt de verantwoording aan het Rijk.
d: continuation of ministerial regulations under repealed act
p: Replaces the statutory urban renewal framework and programme requirements with executive responsibility of college and gedeputeerde staten, removing the prior federal procedural requirements and accountability to the national government.

parties: Asks how local councils and local audit offices will be prepared to exercise horizontal accountability and whether a fog of administrative responsibility could weaken real accountability to the municipal council.
Can the government clearly explain that this will remove central government involvement from the neighbourhood?
Kan de regering helder uiteenzetten dat daarmee de bemoeienis van het Rijk uit de wijk verdwijnt?
Worries that dropping ex-ante performance indicators could blur the purpose of funds and make spending hard to measure and monitor.
The PvdA members further ask to what extent a clear course on the urban renewal objective is set when performance indicators are no longer drawn up in advance.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen zich voorts af in hoeverre er een duidelijke koers op de doelstelling van stedelijke vernieuwing wordt uitgezet wanneer prestatie-indicatoren niet langer vooraf opgesteld worden.
Asks for a guarantee that funds remain earmarked for urban renewal and whether the new arrangement will be evaluated for undesirable developments.
Can the government guarantee that under the new arrangement the urban renewal funds are earmarked and cannot be spent on purposes other than urban renewal?
Kan de regering garanderen dat met de nieuwe regeling de middelen voor stedelijke vernieuwing geoormerkt zijn en dus niet kunnen worden uitgegeven aan andere doelen dan de stedelijke vernieuwing?

Asks how the unchanged allocation key squares with the provincial task in new Woningwet article 80a and whether all municipalities should be treated alike after 2015; also asks whether ISV decentralisation is open-ended given budget lines only to 2014.
These members ask whether it is recorded in this that this decentralisation is for an indefinite period.
Deze leden vragen of hierin is vastgelegd dat deze decentralisatie voor onbepaalde tijd is.

32505.s: The bill amends multiple Dutch tax statutes (income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, dividend tax, inheritance tax, excise, VAT, environmental tax, tax collection and benefits) for fiscal year 2011, including partner definitions, new reduction schemes for MKB investments, travel agency VAT rules and removal of several statutory provisions. It also restructures the Waarderingskamer as a zelfstandig bestuursorgaan under the Kaderwet ZBO and extends the tax-data collection regime.
32505.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly on technical grounds, such as the need for detailed rules on implementation, feasibility and enforceability, and the EU law requirements of the MKB and travel-agency schemes.
q: The obligation for insurers not resident or established in the Netherlands to appoint a Dutch fiscal representative for insurance tax in certain situations is abolished.

De verplichting voor niet in Nederland wonende of gevestigde verzekeraars om in bepaalde situaties in Nederland een fiscaal vertegenwoordiger aan te stellen voor het voldoen van assurantiebelasting, vervalt.
d: rules for partners in care homes
designating premiums and allowances not counted as wages
ARTIKEL XIII (art. 71e Wet op de accijns)
detailed rules on excise refund for horticulture
rules on designation and revocation of MKB emissions and funds
rules for MKB investment premium clawback
choice and transition rules for travel agency margin scheme
further rules on travel agency scheme
ARTIKEL XIV, B (art. 71h lid 2 Wet op de accijns)
sustainability criteria and control for E85
cases where benefits are revised in beneficiary's favour
Waarderingskamer adopts personnel regulation and governance rules
rules for optional partner status of unmarried cohabitants
p: Allows the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen to revise benefits in the beneficiary's favour in cases set by ministerial regulation, a limited expansion of administrative discretion.
Restructures the Waarderingskamer under the Kaderwet ZBO, removing some statutory governance provisions while keeping municipalities and water boards represented on its board.

Bars objections to collection costs on the ground of non-receipt of the dwangbevel unless the taxpayer shows receipt is reasonably doubtful, narrowing citizens' grounds for challenge while retaining a route to rebut.
Similar limitation on contesting collection costs for non-receipt of a notice, subject to a reasonable-doubt exception.
ARTIKEL XXVII, B (art. 19 Wet op de huurtoeslag, partner)
Replaces the partner definition for benefits with a broader term, extending the administrative reach over household status.

parties: Asks for the government's response to Actal's advice to limit the extension of the payroll data request to one year.
Can the government respond to Actal's advice to limit the continuation of the temporary payroll data request regime to only one year, the VVD members ask.
Kan de regering een reactie geven op het advies van Actal om de voorzetting van de tijdelijke regeling uitvraag loongegevens tot slechts één jaar te bepreken, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Raises concerns about high administrative burden and oversight costs of the SME investment scheme and questions whether simpler alternatives exist, echoing the Raad van State.
Is it true that this scheme involves both high administrative burdens for businesses and high costs for supervising correct implementation?
Is het waar dat deze regeling met zowel hoge administratieve lasten voor het bedrijfsleven gepaard gaat als met hoge kosten voor toezicht op een juiste uitvoering?
Questions how the notification procedure agreement with the amendment's sponsors came about and asks about consultation with the amendment's authors, raising transparency of the legislative process.
The SP members wonder how the agreement on the notification procedure with the main sponsor of the amendment came about exactly.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen zich af hoe de afspraak inzake de notificatieprocedure met de hoofdindiener van het amendement precies tot stand is gekomen.
Points to the Raad van State advice that the government should show why fiscal instruments were chosen over other policy instruments for non-fiscal goals.
Can the government elaborate on the considerations for not choosing other policy instruments?
Kan de regering nader in gaan op de afwegingen om niet te kiezen voor andere beleidsinstrumenten?
Asks the government to justify the extension of the payroll data request to a limited group and why it set aside Actal's advice for a one-year period.
And can the government further substantiate why it disregarded Actal's advice to apply this extension for only one year?
En kan de regering nader onderbouwen waarom zij het advies van Actal om deze uitbreiding pas voor één jaar te laten gelden naast zich neer heeft gelegd?
Asks when the promised transitional policy decision for the Successiewet article 10 situation will come, protecting citizens' legal position in existing cases.
The ChristenUnie members ask when this policy decision will come.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen wanneer dit beleidsbesluit komt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Overige fiscale maatregelen 2011 bill, mainly questioning whether the MKB investment facilities (box-3 exemption and one-off tax credit) can achieve their goal given their complexity and lack of justified effectiveness. The minister's nader rapport accepted the need for further research, deferred the entry-into-force date, and followed or partly followed several drafting remarks while not adopting others.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the MKB investment facilities will achieve their goal and asks for better justification of effectiveness; the government defers entry into force and promises further research and consultation but adds no new effectiveness analysis.
The Afdeling notes that fiscal subsidies should be used sparingly and that the trade-off with other policy instruments should be made explicit, which the government did not substantively address.

Several redactional remarks on the Wet IB 2001, Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting and Wet OB 1968 were largely taken over, with some (e.g. the Gemeenschap/Unie term and the globalisation scheme) not followed.

32532.s: The bill amends the Dutch Excise Act to implement EU Directive 2010/12/EU, redefining cigars and small cigars and removing article 35a. It also changes how excise rates on cigarettes and fine-cut tobacco are adjusted, shifting the annual adjustment mechanism to 1 April and fixing one-off tariff changes from 1 July 2011.
32532.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementing the amended directive and using national policy scope to set the specific excise share at 70% for cigarettes and 60% for fine-cut tobacco.
q: By ministerial regulation the tariffs listed in article 35, first paragraph, parts b and c are changed when the weighted average retail price of cigarettes or fine-cut tobacco changes.

Bij ministeriële regeling worden de in artikel 35, eerste lid, onderdelen b en c, vermelde tarieven gewijzigd bij wijziging van de gewogen gemiddelde kleinhandelsprijs van sigaretten onderscheidenlijk rooktabak.
d: Artikel I, D (art. 36 Wet op de accijns)
adjustment of excise tariffs on cigarettes and fine-cut tobacco
changing cigarette excise tariffs from 1 July 2011
changing fine-cut tobacco excise tariffs from 1 July 2011
p: Artikel I, D (art. 36 Wet op de accijns)
Tariff changes on cigarettes and fine-cut tobacco are made by ministerial regulation tied to the weighted average retail price, with percentage floors set in the statute.

parties: Asks whether the directive implementation will in practice raise excise for about 55% of the market on top of the 2011 increase, and whether it undermines a level playing field.
However, these members receive signals from the tobacco industry that implementation in practice is not budget-neutral and undermines the level playing field.
Vanuit de tabaksbranche ontvangen deze leden echter signalen dat de implementatie in de praktijk niet budgetneutraal is en daarbij het level playing field ondermijnt.

Questions why the directive's minimum rates and specific-component room are not fully used, why cigarettes and fine-cut tobacco are treated differently, and whether budget neutrality holds for the market.
The Directive sets the minimum excise for cigarettes at 60 percent of the weighted average retail price, and that for fine-cut tobacco at 52 percent of that.
De Richtlijn zet de minimumaccijns voor sigaretten vast op 60 procent van de gewogen gemiddelde kleinhandelsprijs, en die voor rooktabak op 52 procent daarvan.

Asks the government to confirm that nothing more than necessary is implemented, to explain the use of national policy space on articles 35 and 36, and to identify where the bill departs from the directive text.
Can the government confirm that - except regarding articles 35 and 36 of the Excise Act - nothing more and nothing less is implemented than necessary, ask the members of the CDA faction.

Kan de regering bevestigen dat er – behalve ten aanzien van de artikelen 35 en 36 van de Wet op de accijns – niets meer en niets minder wordt geïmplementeerd dan noodzakelijk, zo vragen de leden van de fractie van het CDA.

32613.s: The bill authorises the Minister of Finance to set up a foundation (stichting administratiekantoor) that will privately manage the state's shareholdings in ABN AMRO, ASR and related entities, issuing depositary certificates and advising on exit strategy. It requires the minister's prior approval for principal decisions, allows binding voting instructions and information demands, and keeps the Algemene Rekenkamer's audit powers over the foundation.
32613.j: The memorandum justifies the statutory authorisation by the reduced shareholder influence of the minister after the foundation is set up and by the need to secure the Algemene Rekenkamer's existing powers.
q: Moreover, the cabinet considers a specific statutory authorisation appropriate alongside the statutory task, given the limitation of the minister's shareholder influence resulting from establishing the foundation.
Daarenboven acht het kabinet naast het geven van een wettelijke taak een specifieke wettelijke machtiging passend gelet op de beperking van de aandeelhoudersinvloed voor de minister
d: establishing the stichting administratiekantoor on behalf of the state
binding voting instructions and approval of principal decisions by the minister
ministerial directions to the foundation to meet international obligations or audit recommendations
setting costs chargeable to listed firms and approval of budget and accounts
p: Minister may give binding voting instructions and must approve principal decisions, while the foundation's own management is shielded from direct parliamentary control.
Minister may demand all business records reasonably needed for his task, but confidential information may be withheld.
Minister may issue directions to the foundation for international obligations or audit recommendations.

parties: Asks how the foundation's independence from the minister is safeguarded, what requirements apply to board members, and on what grounds they can be dismissed.
The VVD members ask whether the minister sets additional requirements for the board members to guarantee their independence.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de minister aanvullende eisen stelt aan de bestuursleden om de onafhankelijkheid ervan te waarborgen.
Asks on what grounds board remuneration was set and wants the minister to appoint only board members approved by both DNB and AFM.
These members would like the minister, ahead of legislation, to appoint only board members who receive an approving statement from both DNB and AFM.
Deze leden zouden graag zien dat, vooruitlopend op wetgeving, de minister alleen bestuursleden aanstelt die van zowel DNB als AFM een goedkeurende verklaring krijgen.

Supports the private-law structure but argues the minister should be a statutory organ of the foundation and that parliamentary control requires statutory rules on budget, annual reports and board appointment.
These members place this specifically in the light of parliamentary control.
Deze leden plaatsen dat specifiek in het licht van de parlementaire controle.

Welcomes limiting shareholder influence and preserving Court of Audit powers via a statutory route, but asks how the foundation's powers, statutes, board appointment and minister's budget approval are justified.
Among other things, a statutory route was chosen rather than an authorisation, because this secures the powers of the Court of Audit, the CDA members note.
Er is onder meer gekozen voor een wettelijk traject boven een machtiging, omdat op die manier de bevoegdheden van de Algemene Rekenkamer worden geborgd, zo merken de leden van de CDA-fractie op.
Views the bill as solving a non-existent problem and questions whether the minister's prior-consent list is exhaustive and what happens if the foundation departs from voting instructions.
According to these members, this law creates a solution to a non-existent problem, since the holdings in the financial sector are already well managed at present.
Volgens deze leden wordt met deze wet een oplossing gecreëerd voor een niet-bestaand probleem, daar de deelnemingen in de financiële sector op dit moment al goed beheerd worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill establishing a foundation (stichting administratiekantoor) to hold the state's shares in ABN AMRO and ASR, reducing the finance minister's shareholder influence, and urged clarifying in the law itself the minister's powers and the foundation's divergent roles. The government reply adopted the core points, added binding voting instructions and share-sale consent in the bill, and restructured the foundation's objectives with editorial corrections.
concerns: Essential relationship between the minister and the foundation (binding voting instructions, directive power, information duties) should be set out in the statute rather than only in articles of association.
The law should expressly state that the foundation may dispose of shares only with the minister's consent.

Objectives of the foundation in article 3(2) should distinguish activities with a high degree of independence from those involving advice and execution of the sale strategy, which require closer ministerial involvement.
Various editorial and terminological remarks in the annex were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

32622.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2009/65/EC (UCITS IV) in the Dutch Wft, simplifying the notification procedure for cross-border marketing of collective investment schemes, creating master-feeder structures, cross-border mergers, and supervisory information exchange between national regulators. It mainly reorganises administrative procedures between the AFM and foreign supervisors and grants few discretionary powers to the executive.
32622.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers as necessary to implement the directive's requirements and to simplify cross-border notification procedures.
q: Furthermore, the notification procedure a manager must follow to offer participation rights in a UCITS based in one Member State in another Member State has been simplified.
Verder is de notificatieprocedure die een beheerder moet doorlopen om deelnemingsrechten in een icbe met zetel in de ene lidstaat in een andere lidstaat aan te mogen bieden vereenvoudigd.
d: rules on order execution and best-execution policy for collective investment schemes
rules on conflict-of-interest policy for fund managers
procedure for obtaining consent for feeder fund liquidation options
content and language of merger notification to the AFM
p: The AFM gains power to prohibit a foreign-based manager from managing a Dutch fund, after notifying the home supervisor and publishing the decision, with a review path via appeal.

parties: Welcomes better consumer information and cross-border trade, and considers the subsidiarity and proportionality test positive.
These members are positive about policy aimed at better information for and protection of consumers, less bureaucracy and stimulating cross-border trade.
Deze leden staan positief tegenover beleid dat gericht is op betere informatie voor en bescherming van consumenten, minder bureaucratie en stimulering van grensoverschrijdende handel
Asks whether the government added national initiatives and requests an overview of UCITS active in the Netherlands, including hedge funds and pension administrators.
The PvdA members ask whether the Dutch government has added its own initiatives to the legislation or whether this is only implementation of the European directive?
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de Nederlandse regering nog eigen initiatieven heeft toegevoegd aan de wetgeving of dat er alleen sprake is van implementatie van de Europese richtlijn?
Asks whether risk management is adequately addressed, whether supervision is on a level playing field, and whether the AFM's supervisory workload changes.
Is sufficient attention being paid to risk management aspects?
Wordt er voldoende aandacht besteed aan aspecten van risicomanagement?

Criticises the directive for prioritising financial sector expansion over stability and investor protection, and asks about concentration risk and how the AFM can still prevent problematic advertising.

According to these members, this directive is clearly still part of a series of directives launched before the crisis, where priority lay more with expanding the financial sector than with stability of the financial system and consumer protection.

Deze richtlijn maakt volgens deze leden duidelijk nog deel uit van een reeks richtlijnen die vóór de crisis in gang is gezet waarbij de prioriteit eerder lag bij expansie van de financiële sector dan bij stabiliteit van het financiële stelsel en bescherming van consumenten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports a bill implementing the revised UCITS directive on collective investment schemes but raises several objections, including the licensing of ICBEs managed from another member state, the scope of cross-border provisions, and host/home-country control of managers. The government's reply states that the bill and explanatory memorandum were amended to address the advice and the redactional comments.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clarification of how to avoid duplicate requirements in home and host states for a manager with seat in another member state managing a Dutch ICBE; the bill was amended so that the requirements concern the licence application for the specific ICBE.

Article 2:121c did not cover a manager providing services to manage an ICBE seated in another member state, and was too similar to article 2:123; the government clarified the scope and renumbered the provision as 2:122a.

Articles 4:8, 4:12 and 4:38 did not distinguish between managers operating through a branch (host-country control) and through services (home-country control), contrary to articles 17 and 18 of the directive; the articles were amended accordingly.
A series of redactional comments on terminology and cross-references in several articles was adopted.

32640.s: The bill amends the Dutch primary, special and secondary education acts to require at least 1,000 hours of instruction per year (700 in the final year) and to harmonise school holiday rules by ministerial regulation. It also obliges secondary schools to record and report realised teaching time and to give the parent and pupil part of the works council a separate consent right over the instructional programme.
32640.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to set holiday start and end dates differently per school, and to shorten summer holidays while preserving school-level choice.
q: By ministerial regulation, the start and end of holidays may be set that need not be the same for all schools.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen begin en eind van vakanties worden vastgesteld die niet voor alle scholen gelijk behoeven te zijn.
d: Artikel I (Wet op het primair onderwijs, art. 15, lid 2)
school holiday rules and start and end dates of holidays
Artikel II (Wet op de expertisecentra, art. 26, lid 2)
school holiday rules for special secondary education
Artikel III, G (Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs, art. 22, lid 2)
holiday and non-teaching day rules for secondary schools
Artikel III, G (Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs, art. 22, lid 2)
start and end dates of holidays, differing between schools
Artikel III, A (Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs, art. 6f, lid 3)
further rules on data about hours and activities in a teaching programme
p: Artikel III, A (art. 6f, lid 4) and Artikel III, G
Individual school boards decide the non-teaching days and the holiday arrangements within statutory limits, and schools must keep and report data on realised hours.
Artikel IV, D (Wet medezeggenschap op scholen, art. 14, lid 4)
Parents and pupils in the works council gain a separate consent right over the instructional programme and dropped lessons policy.

parties: Asks whether the broadened definition of instructional time is meaningful and whether the government's stated quality aim is credible, and raises concern about parental oversight of how time is filled.
The members would like to hear the government's reaction to this.
Graag horen de leden wat de reactie van de regering hierop is.
Asks how the horizontal dialogue with school councils will be made effective and whether schools' substitution of lesson time with supervised waiting hours is acceptable.
What is the government doing to prevent the reference to horizontal dialogue from remaining a dead letter, the members ask.
Wat onderneemt de regering om te voorkómen dat de verwijzing naar de horizontale dialoog blijft steken bij een dode letter, zo vragen de leden.
Asks for clearer criteria on which activities count as instructional time, and questions whether parents on school councils can make informed judgments on quality.
Would it not be logical, the members ask, to go into this issue in more depth than the explanatory memorandum currently does?
Ligt het niet voor de hand, zo vragen de leden, om meer uitgebreid in te gaan op deze problematiek dan nu in de memorie van toelichting is gedaan?
Argues the bill will worsen teacher working conditions and workload, and questions shifting supervision of instructional time from the Inspectorate to school council volunteers.

Given these serious findings of the Council of State, why is now the right moment to shift supervision of instructional time from external (Inspectorate) to internal (school council), the members ask.

Waarom is het gezien deze zware constateringen van de Raad van State nu het juiste moment om het toezicht op de invulling van de onderwijstijd te verschuiven van extern (inspectie) naar intern (MR), zo vragen de leden.
Fears the 1000-hour norm is reached by stretching the definition rather than improving lessons, and asks how creative use of the concept will be prevented and whether the Inspectorate judges content.
What measures does the government intend to take to prevent 'creative' use of the concept of instructional time by schools?
Welke maatregelen denkt de regering te nemen om «creatief» gebruik van het begrip onderwijstijd door scholen te voorkomen?
Critical of cutting teachers' free days and doubts that the norms can be met with existing funding; asks whether the norms are enforceable rights for parents and pupils.
The members ask the government whether it sees the norms as rights, whether these rights are enforceable by parents and pupils, or as practical guidelines.
De leden vragen de regering of zij de normen ziet als rechten, of deze rechten door ouders en leerlingen afdwingbaar zijn, of als praktische richtsnoeren.
Warns against excessive state interference in lesson times and asks whether flexibility or a bandwidth of hours should be allowed, leaving responsibility with schools.
The said members wish to guard against excessive government interference in matters such as lesson times and how these hours are filled.
De genoemde leden willen waken voor een al te grote inmenging van de overheid in zaken als lestijden en invulling van deze uren.
Questions whether the practical implementation achieves its aim, notes the holiday-day arithmetic may cancel out the claimed workload relief, and asks why some matters are left to lower regulation.
They endorse the thrust of the bill but ask whether the practical elaboration leads to the intended result.
Zij onderschrijven de strekking van het wetsvoor stel, maar vragen of de praktische uitwerking tot het beoogde resultaat leidt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill on lesson time in secondary education but raises objections on horizontal accountability for the qualitative content of lesson time, on guaranteeing time for basic skills after lowering the hours norm to 1000, and on centrally fixed school holidays leaving schools no room for local free days. The minister's reply largely rejects the holiday point by pointing to existing rules in the Inrichtingsbesluit, and otherwise adds explanation, a new article on informing the works council, and clarifications.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether sufficient time is guaranteed for teaching basic skills after the hours norm is cut to 1000, and asks for clarification and possible amendment.

The Afdeling doubts whether horizontal accountability on qualitative lesson content is workable and whether teachers keep control over content, and asks for the explanatory memorandum to be supplemented.
The Afdeling asks for the bill to create room for schools to set local non-teaching days, but the government says the Inrichtingsbesluit already allows this and no amendment is needed.

32712.s: The bill amends the Soil Protection Act to allow an area-based approach to clean up contamination of deeper groundwater across a designated area, by inserting new articles 55c to 55i. Provincial executives may designate such an area on request or of their own motion, and the authority that adopts the plan carries out the remediation, with provincial executives approving the plan and taking over public-law responsibility for listed contamination.
32712.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the powers by the difficulty of separating mixed groundwater contamination and by the need to meet EU groundwater targets efficiently and cost-effectively.
q: The power in the first paragraph may be used if cases of groundwater contamination in an area are or may become so mixed that, in the view of provincial executives, they cannot be distinguished and delineated from each other for the purposes of this Act.

Van de in het eerste lid bedoelde bevoegdheid kan gebruik worden gemaakt indien gevallen van verontreiniging in het diepere grondwater in een gebied zodanig gemengd zijn of gemengd kunnen raken dat deze gevallen voor de toepassing van deze wet naar het oordeel van gedeputeerde staten niet ten opzichte van elkaar zijn te onderscheiden en af te bakenen
d: rules on data for requests, soil investigation, plan contents, monitoring and evaluation
p: Provincial executives may designate an area for an area-based approach where contamination is mixed and certain development or remediation conditions apply, displacing the normal remediation rules for those sites.

The authority carrying out the plan takes over, irrevocably, the public-law remediation responsibility from the polluter for listed contamination, and may add contamination later without the normal approval steps.

parties: Asks why a further amendment is needed after this bill and questions whether the state aid notification implies the law may be sent back by the European Commission.
Asks whether a local authority can be compelled to pursue an area-based approach and questions the risk that voluntary participation fails, citing the Raad van State's doubts about effectiveness.
They also ask what the government thinks of the Council of State's criticism on this point, which says it is not convinced of effectiveness with a voluntary approach.
Zij vragen tevens wat de regering vindt van de kritiek op dit punt van de Raad van State, die stelt dat zij niet overtuigd is van de effectiviteit bij een vrijwillige aanpak.
Seeks clarification on the calculation of financial contributions and on the risk of inadequate contributions clashing with EU state aid rules.

The PVV members would like the government to explain how the amount of the financial contribution for participating companies is determined and how the risk of an inadequate contribution is countered so as not to clash with EU state aid rules.

De leden van de PVV-fractie zouden graag van de regering een toelichting willen op de wijze waarop hoogte van de financiële bijdrage voor meewerkende bedrijven wordt bepaald en hoe risico's van een tekortschietende bijdrage worden tegengegaan teneinde niet te botsen met staatssteunregels uit Brussel.

Asks for clarity on which municipalities are competent authorities and how the coalition agreement on decentralisation affects authority allocation, and questions whether de minimis state aid is the right route.
First they ask whether the government can indicate which municipalities are the competent authority municipalities.
Allereerst vragen ze of de regering kan aangeven wat de bevoegdgezaggemeenten zijn.
Sceptical that shifting from remediation to management leaves contamination in place, that vague terms invite arbitrariness among competent authorities, and that monitoring obligations are unclear.
For the SP members this is rather vague and, in their view, invites arbitrariness between competent authorities.
Dit is voor de leden van de SP-fractie wat vaag en lokt volgens deze leden willekeur tussen bevoegd gezagen uit.
Asks about the risks for the competent authority if long-term contamination turns out worse than expected and whether restrictions can be included, and asks why a mandatory element is deferred.
These members ask why this option is not already built in now as a last resort.
Genoemde leden vragen waarom deze optie dan niet nu al als ultimum remedium wordt ingebouwd.
Worried about low remediation numbers, the lack of binding rules for source remediation, the competent authority also being the area manager removing external pressure, and vague management plans.
These members ask why it has not been chosen to include in the legal framework for the area-based approach a binding arrangement for remediation of sources in the area.

Ten slotte vragen zij waarom er niet voor gekozen wordt om in het wettelijk kader voor de gebiedsgerichte aanpak een regeling op te nemen voor sanering van bronnen in het gebied met een bindend karakter.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet bodembescherming for area-based remediation of mobile groundwater contamination, raising concerns about vague scope terms, competence allocation, EU aspects, legal character of decisions, and voluntary participation. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, amending the bill on competence, scope wording, and legal character, while declining to impose mandatory participation or financing duties.
concerns: Undefined terms ('mobiele verontreinigingen', 'diepere grondwater') create legal uncertainty; the government removed the word 'mobiele' and clarified the terms in the explanatory memorandum.
Competence allocation between gedeputeerde staten and municipalities risks misalignment with ruimtelijke planning; the bill was amended so municipalities can initiate and adopt the plan.
Provincie-crossing contamination requires a coordination regime; a coordination provision was added.
The explanatory memorandum needed to explain implementation of the Groundwater Directive and Water Framework Directive and state aid risks; these were supplemented.
The legal character of the area designation and the management plan (as administrative decisions under the Awb) was unclear; the explanatory memorandum was expanded accordingly.

The Afdeling advised a statutory duty for polluters to cooperate and finance area-based remediation; the government declined, leaving this to a future revision of the Wbb and voluntary private agreements.

32721.s: The bill amends the Dutch Weapons and Ammunition Act to implement EU Directive 2008/51/EC, extending the validity of the European firearms pass from one to five years and requiring firearms and ammunition to carry specified markings. It adds an offence with a maximum of four years' imprisonment or a fifth-category fine for violating the new marking rules.
32721.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to implement the EU directive and frames the delegated rules as technical detail; it gives no separate justification for the ministerial delegations.
q: By ministerial regulation, rules may be set on the parts to be marked and the data to be applied.
Bij regeling van Onze Minister kunnen regels worden gesteld over de te markeren onderdelen en de aan te brengen gegevens.
d: which firearm parts must be marked and what data to apply
further rules on data to be applied to ammunition packaging

parties: Asks detailed questions on whether national implementation goes beyond the directive, marking effects on collectors and safety, and the cost of marking.
These members would like to know whether it is true that the directive is not separately implemented in those countries.
