The minister's reply addresses each point, largely by adding justification and clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, while keeping the private-law zbo form and the private activities, rejecting detailed statutory supervision, and not adopting several proposed changes to the bill text beyond the subsidy provision.
concerns: The Council questioned whether a private-law zbo is adequately justified and advised a supporting motivation or adjustment, which the minister addressed by adding reasons in the explanatory memorandum while keeping the private-law form.

The Council doubted the claimed reduction in administrative burden and the expected savings of €60 million and asked for better substantiation; the minister added explanation but the savings figures were largely defended rather than revised.
The Council asked for substantiation that qualification dossiers need little change after 2015; the minister added justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Council questioned whether risk- and demand-based support and reliance on institutions' signals for controlling learning companies would work; the minister clarified that four-yearly assessment remains mandatory.

The Council objected to combining public and private activities in the Stichting SBB and to unfair competition risks; the minister kept private activities but added a condition that they must not harm statutory tasks and will be supervised by the Inspectorate.

The Council advised that the subsidy request for additional activities be made in consultation with the relevant sector chambers; the minister added this to the WEB article 9.2.1 and explanatory note.

The Council saw detailed ministerial approval of statutes and by-laws as interference in internal organisation; the minister disagreed and stated the approval concerns only sector involvement and quality assurance.

The Council asked for clarity on whether Inspectorate supervision of quality could impose additional requirements; the minister clarified that supervision covers only statutory tasks and no additional requirements can be imposed.

34035.s: The bill reforms Dutch student finance by replacing the basic grant for higher education with a loan, abolishing the partner allowance and the work-income limit for higher-education students, and introducing a lifelong learning loan for students aged 30 and over. It also adjusts repayment rules and transition provisions, and delegates many details to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
34035.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as needed for good implementation, feasibility and adjustment to ICT and DUO processes.
q: By general administrative order, grounds may be set on which an application can be refused in view of repayment risks.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen gronden worden vastgesteld op basis waarvan een aanvraag gelet op terugbetalingsrisico's kan worden geweigerd.
d: lifelong learning loan terms and performance-based funding criteria
grounds for refusing lifelong learning loan on repayment risk
application, award and payment rules for lifelong learning loan
detailed repayment rules for lifelong learning loan
form, value, application and obligations for study-fee vouchers
rules for applying partial debt forgiveness for students with disability or chronic illness
further rules on transition cohort guarantee and implementation
indexation of statutory amounts by the minister
p: Statutory amounts are set and indexed by ministerial action, shifting amount-setting from parliament to the minister.
Discretion on loan and grant conditions is widened for the Minister and implementing bodies.
An AMvB may set grounds on which a lifelong learning loan application is refused based on repayment risk, giving the executive discretion over access to finance.

parties: Welcomes the bill as investment in quality and lifelong learning, asking about coherence with other reforms such as the Ad programme.
The VVD members have noted the bill with approval.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Supports additional investment in higher education and accessibility for motivated students.
They attach great value to high-quality higher education that is accessible to every motivated student.
Zij hechten grote waarde aan kwalitatief (zeer) goed hoger onderwijs dat toegankelijk is voor iedere gemotiveerde student.
Opposes replacing the grant with loans, arguing it undermines accessibility and contradicts lessons of the financial crisis on debt.
Studying should be encouraged rather than hindered.
Studeren zou gestimuleerd moeten worden in plaats van belemmerd.

Cites the Raad van State critique that the burden increase is insufficiently justified and questions the evidence base; also raises the Raad's objection to the open statutory basis for quality funding.
With the Council of State's Advisory Division, we consider that the proposed increase in students' burdens is insufficiently justified.

De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn met de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State van mening dat de in het wetsvoorstel voorgestelde verzwaring van lasten van studenten, die volgens de regering, berust op een sterker toenemend persoonlijk profijt in vergelijking met het maatschappelijk profijt niet voldoende is gemotiveerd.
Asks how accessibility is guaranteed given limited information on the loan system and whether institutional spending is transparent.
Does the government share the members' view that institutions' spending should be transparent before new policy is made with students' borrowed money?
Deelt de regering de visie van de leden dat het uitgavenpatroon van de besturen transparant zou moeten zijn, voordat er nieuw beleid wordt gemaakt met geleend geld van de studenten?
Welcomes the bill and the student co-decision right (instemmingsrecht) over budget main lines as a participatory check on spending.
With the consent right over the main lines of the budget, students can co-decide on the spending of these extra funds.
Met het instemmingsrecht op de hoofdlijnen van de begroting kunnen studenten meebeslissen in de besteding van deze extra middelen.
Positive about the bill and asks additional questions, including on effects on child benefit for minor students.
These members are positive about the bill.
Deze leden zijn positief over het wetsvoorstel.
Opposes abolishing the basic grant, warning of higher debts and a higher threshold to higher education; criticises confusing communication to students.
The members oppose abolishing the basic grant, because a loan system will lead to a sharp increase in debts among graduates and raise the threshold to higher education.
De leden zijn tegen afschaffing van de basisbeurs, omdat een leenstelsel zal leiden tot een forse toename van schulden onder afgestudeerden en de drempel tot hoger onderwijs zal verhogen.
Regrets the government's withdrawal of the master loan proposal, worries about middle incomes, and about institutions becoming dependent on political majorities.
Furthermore, these members are concerned that, while the proposed quality improvements remain vague, institutions are increasingly made dependent on the arbitrariness of political majorities.

Voorts tonen deze leden zich bezorgd over het feit dat – terwijl de voorgestelde kwaliteitsverbeteringen mistig blijven – instellingen door het voorstel in toenemende mate afhankelijk worden van de willekeur van politieke meerderheden.
Asks how the quality funds will concretely be deployed.
It is unclear, however, how the available funds will later be deployed for actual quality improvements.
Onduidelijk is echter hoe straks de beschikbare middelen ingezet worden voor daadwerkelijke kwaliteitsimpulsen.
Questions how the government justifies removing the basic grant as improving access, and warns of rising debt, weak information and inadequate research on the effects of the loan system.
The members ask the government whether it finds it reasonable to keep someone in debt for 35 years while labour market uncertainty continues.
De genoemde leden vragen de regering of zij het redelijk vindt om iemand 35 jaar aan een schuld vast te laten zitten, terwijl de onzekerheid op de arbeidsmarkt nog steeds op blijft lopen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet studievoorschot hoger onderwijs, which replaces the basisbeurs with a loan, raises private contributions, creates a statutory basis for quality-linked funding and gives student and staff councils consent rights over budget outlines, raising concerns about rationale, premature quality-funding basis, consent rights, transitional law and fiscal leakage. The government reply accepts some points (essential indicators, DUO cost analysis, fiscal leakage motivation, drafting) and rejects others (dropping quality funding basis, transitional law, consent right, 5-year voucher wait), maintaining its policy choices.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of the shift from generic basisbeurs to a loan given the balance of private and social returns; the government explains the rationale but disputes that it is a paradigm shift.

The Afdeling advised against a transitional regime that would withdraw the basisbeurs from students in the master phase who began a bachelor, arguing their expectation was unjustly frustrated; the government keeps the cohort guarantee within each phase.

The Afdeling found the open statutory basis for quality-linked funding too broad and advised deleting it or setting main lines, indicators and scope in the Act; the government adopts the essential indicators in law but keeps the basis.

The Afdeling advised dropping the consent right of student and staff councils over the main lines of the budget as an unjustified intrusion on the board's management prerogative; the government keeps the consent right.
The Afdeling asked for an analysis of cumulative effects on mortgage access and of the budgetary risks from migration of graduates; the government explains the assumptions and adds clarifications.
The Afdeling asked for a separate analysis of DUO implementation costs and alignment of the fiscal leakage presentation; the government added the analysis and adjusted the tables.
The Afdeling advised removing the five-year waiting period for the lifelong learning voucher; the government keeps it to ensure graduates first gain labour-market experience.
The Afdeling made redactional comments and asked for grounds for refusing lifelong learning credit to be written into the statute itself; these were largely incorporated.

34053.s: The bill introduces statutory rules and municipal supervision for privately funded youth residences (jeugdverblijven) housing at least four minors for long periods, requiring a quality framework, a certificate of conduct for staff, an independent confidant, and a notification duty. Municipal mayors and colleges gain inspection, warning, penalty and closure powers, with general rules to be set by general administrative order.
34053.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the state's duty of care for children living outside parental view and the lack of formal oversight of privately funded boarding schools, and says entry powers are proportionate and safeguarded.
q: The bill aims to safeguard as far as possible the safety, undisturbed development and pedagogical climate of children staying in a youth residence.

Doelstelling van de wet Dit wetsvoorstel heeft tot doel de veiligheid en de ongestoorde ontwikkeling van en het pedagogisch klimaat voor kinderen die verblijven in een jeugdverblijf zo veel mogelijk te waarborgen.
d: quality requirements for youth residences and further rules on notification and confidant
technical or administrative requirements, delegated from the general administrative order
p: Inspectors may enter a home used by a youth residence without the occupant's consent, subject to a mayoral authorisation for residential parts and an annual visit requirement.
The mayor may close an entire youth residence on a reasonable suspicion of offences affecting minors' safety, with the closure duration set in the decision and appeal open.
The college may issue binding directions and impose periodic penalty payments where a residence fails to comply with the Act.

parties: Asks whether municipal supervision is optional or a duty, and whether municipalities have an obligation to enforce the quality rules.

These members ask whether this is not too non-committal. Do municipalities (in the context of supervision) not have a duty to carry out their responsibilities and hold youth residences to account for the rules, they wish to know.

Deze leden vragen of dit niet te vrijblijvend geformuleerd is. Hebben gemeenten (in het kader van toezicht) niet de plicht hun verantwoordelijkheden te effectueren en jeugdverblijven aan te spreken met betrekking tot de voorschriften, zo willen deze leden weten.
Asks for justification of the statutory framework over voluntary participation and how to respect parents' freedom of upbringing, while building support in the Turkish-Dutch community.
The members share the government's view that the freedom of parents to choose how they raise their children should be interfered with as little as possible.](Note: see following)
De genoemde leden delen de mening van de regering dat zo min mogelijk getreden moet worden in de keuzevrijheid van ouders over de wijze hoe zij hun kinderen willen laten opgroeien.
Asks the government to justify the necessity, the concrete safety problem and the proportionality of the statutory regime, and what the consequences are for municipalities.
Why has the government chosen to convert the voluntary arrangements and self-regulation into a statutory framework, these members wish to know.
Waarom heeft de regering er voor gekozen om de vrijwillige afspraken en zelfregulering om te zetten in een wettelijk kader, zo willen deze leden weten.
Asks what considerations justified extra control over privately run youth residences and how it affects parallel societies and exposure to anti-democratic ideas.
Does the government have examples of this, they ask.](Note: see following)
Heeft de regering hier voorbeelden van, zo informeren zij.
Notes the Council of State's view that the problem analysis is lacking and asks why closure is not a notification duty and how many institutions are covered.
Furthermore, these members note that the Council of State is of the view that an analysis of the problems in the youth residences is lacking.](Note: see following)
Voorts merken deze leden op dat de Raad van State van mening is dat het ontbreekt aan een analyse van de problematiek in de jeugdverblijven.
Asks for an evaluation of the current voluntary supervision before it is codified, and notes municipalities expect higher costs than estimated.
Also in this context, the members ask the government whether an evaluation of the current voluntary arrangement could provide more clarity on this point.](Note: see following)
Ook in dit verband vragen de leden aan de regering of een evaluatie van de huidige vrijwillige regeling op dit punt meer helderheid kan verschaffen.

Argues for restraint given the status of parental authority, says the bill lacks clarity on the division between parental responsibility and state competence, and questions the criteria for undisturbed child development.
These members, however, consider a restrained approach to be called for, given the status that parental authority holds.](Note: see following)
Deze leden achten daarbij echter een terughoudende opstelling geboden, gelet op de status die het ouderlijk gezag inneemt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill regulating private youth residential institutions (Wet op de jeugdverblijven) lacks a problem analysis, a reasoned weighing of parental freedom against state duties, consideration of existing instruments, and substantive quality norms, and should be reconsidered. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, expands the explanatory memorandum, moves the quality standards to a general administrative order, but declines one drafting suggestion on article 7(2).
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity and opportunity of the bill insufficiently demonstrated because no problem analysis was given; the government sharpened the problem definition and explanation but did not add a deeper empirical analysis.

The Afdeling found no reasoned weighing of parental authority against state duty to intervene; the government added justification in the explanatory memorandum stating the interference is limited and proportionate.
The Afdeling noted existing child-protection instruments (ondertoezichtstelling, AMHK) were not analysed; the government added an explanation that these are individual-level and complementary.
The Afdeling held that without substantive quality norms the quality framework cannot be enforced; the government moved the substantive norms to an algemene maatregel van bestuur.
The Afdeling held that substantive norms belong at the level of an algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than a ministeriële regeling; the government adjusted article 5 accordingly.

The Afdeling's redactional annex proposed several drafting changes; all were adopted except the proposed rewording of article 7(2), which the government declined to avoid obliging the college to transfer all supervisory tasks to regional GGD officials.

34062.s: The bill amends the Animal Experiments Act to implement EU Directive 2010/63/EU, changing the conditions under which permits may be granted for animal experiments using wild-caught animals so that they must show the purpose cannot be reached with bred animals. It also provides that a related article of the Verzamelwet Veiligheid en Justitie 2013 lapses and that the act takes effect together with the parent amendment.
34062.j: The memorandum justifies the revised article 10f by the EU directive's requirement and by the Eerste Kamer's concerns, without invoking any new executive powers.
q: Under the second paragraph of article 9 of the directive, the competent authorities may allow deviations from this prohibition if a scientific justification shows that the purpose of the animal experiment cannot be achieved with an animal bred for use in animal experiments.

Ingevolge het tweede lid van artikel 9 van de richtlijn kunnen de bevoegde instanties afwijkingen van dit verbod toestaan als door middel van een wetenschappelijke motivering wordt aangetoond dat het doel van de dierproef niet kan worden bereikt met een dier dat voor het gebruik in dierproeven is gefokt.

34071.s: The bill clarifies the scope of the Dutch consumer sales rules by allowing consumers to invoke the consumer protection rules against an intermediary acting for or on behalf of the trader, and extends these rules to digital content not supplied on a material medium. It makes conforming amendments to the Civil Code (Books 6 and 7) and to the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming so that the ACM can enforce them.
34071.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as implementing the EU consumer rights directive and clarifying scope, without invoking new executive powers.
q: The directive only requires ensuring that the consumer, where it concerns compliance with the consumer rules in the directive, can hold both the principal and the intermediary acting in the course of their trade, business, craft or profession liable.

De richtlijn verplicht slechts ervoor te zorgen dat de consument alleen waar het de nakoming van de in de richtlijn opgenomen consumentenregels betreft zowel de achterman als tussenpersoon, die handelt in het kader van zijn handels-, bedrijfs-, ambachts- of beroepsactiviteit, kan aanspreken.

parties: Asks whether a clear definition of a streaming agreement is possible and whether hybrid forms exist, and whether sales rules apply to services like Spotify and Netflix.
They do ask, however, whether it would not be advisable to use a clear definition when it comes to a streaming agreement.
Wel vragen zij of het geen aanbeveling verdient een heldere definitie te hanteren als het gaat om een streaming-overeenkomst.
Questions why consumer protection should not apply to streaming agreements and asks the government to ensure full coverage by consumer rules, including product conformity.
Can the government ensure that streaming agreements also fully fall under the consumer rules?
Kan de regering ervoor zorgen dat ook streaming-overeenkomsten volledig onder de consumentenregels vallen?
Asks about the consequences of overlapping claims under title 7.1 BW and the Directive for consumer legal protection, and whether mere possibility of downloading suffices.
What consequences can this overlap have for, for example, the legal protection of consumers?
Welke gevolgen kan deze samenloop hebben voor bijvoorbeeld de rechtsbescherming van consumenten?
Asks the government to clarify what a streaming agreement is and asks whether removing wording from the agency provisions reduces legal protection for consumers.
They ask whether, and if so which form of legal protection for the consumer would thereby lapse, and whether the government can give some concrete examples.
Zij vragen of en zo ja, welke wijze van rechtsbescherming hiermee voor de consument komt te vervallen en of de regering daar ook enkele concrete voorbeelden van kan geven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending Books 6 and 7 of the Civil Code to clarify the scope of sales rules for streaming contracts and agent liability, raising concerns about the ambiguity of streaming versus downloading and incomplete implementation of the Consumer Rights Directive. The government's reply accepted the advice, clarifying the explanatory memorandum and amending the provisions so that the directive's digital content protection still applies to streaming.
concerns: Excluding streaming from title 7.1 would leave the Consumer Rights Directive only partly implemented, so article 7:7(2) BW was amended to cover streaming as well.
The explanatory memorandum needed supplementing to clarify when a streaming contract that also allows downloading falls within title 7.1 BW.

34116.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the EU-Euratom-Ukraine Association Agreement, including its Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area, signed in Brussels on 27 June 2014. It establishes the agreement's binding status under Dutch law after parliamentary approval under article 91(1) of the Constitution.
34116.j: The memorandum justifies approval by noting the agreement's importance for relations with Ukraine and the harmonisation of Ukrainian technical standards with EU rules, and states that citizens cannot derive direct rights from it and that it creates no obligations enforceable before courts.
q: The AA also contains no obligations that can be invoked before judicial bodies of the Union or the member states.
Het AA bevat ook geen verplichtingen waarop bij rechterlijke instanties van de Unie of de lidstaten beroep kan worden gedaan

parties: Asks about the legal position of Russia, the timing of provisional application, compatibility with the Eurasian Economic Union, and why Article 483 lacks Crimea-specific arrangements, and whether the Association Council could suspend application there.
On the basis of which considerations was it decided to do so?
Op basis van welke overwegingen is hiertoe besloten?

Asks whether the agreements allow raising fundamental European values such as human rights, democracy and the rule of law, including minority language rights, and whether ratification should be completed before the Riga summit.
In this context these members ask to what extent the Association Agreements offer opportunities to raise precisely these important issues.
In dat kader vragen deze leden in hoeverre de Associatieakkoorden mogelijkheden bieden om juist deze belangrijke kwesties aan de orde te stellen.

Questions the agreement's social effects, Ukrainian political division, whether the conditions on selective justice were met, and whether human rights and corruption are conditions for implementation and grounds for suspension.
The SP members ask the government to indicate to what extent these are currently being met, against the background of the civil war in the east of the country.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven in hoeverre op dit moment, tegen de achtergrond van de burgeroorlog in het oosten van het land, hieraan wordt voldaan.

Supports the agreement's aims but worries about rule of law and democracy conditions, geopolitical risk, unfair competition on agricultural products, and asks for monitoring, evaluation and stronger inspection.
Trade alone is not enough; values such as democracy and the rule of law are also at stake.
Handel alleen is niet genoeg, het gaat ook om waarden als democratie en rechtsstaat.

Opposes the agreement as premature given the Crimea annexation and eastern conflict, doubts Ukraine meets rule-of-law and anti-corruption conditions, and warns of migration and criminality risks from visa facilitation.
Can the government indicate what effects the war in Ukraine has on the stricter 2012 conditions: free and fair elections, tackling selective justice, and broad reforms?

Kan de regering aangeven welke effecten de oorlog in Oekraïne heeft op de verscherpte voorwaarden van 2012: vrije en eerlijke verkiezingen, de aanpak van selectieve rechtspraak, en het doorvoeren van brede hervormingen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill approving the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, asking only that the explanatory memorandum address the current situation in Ukraine. The government's reply explains that the current situation was deliberately placed in the reply rather than the explanatory memorandum, and describes recent developments.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum address the current situation in Ukraine given the agreement's objectives; the government instead added this description to the nader rapport, arguing the memorandum is a timeless document.

34143.s: The bill amends the Metrologiewet to implement EU Directives 2014/32/EU and 2014/31/EU on measuring instruments and non-automatic weighing instruments, updating definitions, introducing obligations for importers and distributors, and adding a basis for an EU declaration of conformity. It also allows the Minister to set rules on transfer of files from withdrawn designated bodies and creates a basis for setting requirements on internal bodies performing conformity assessment.
34143.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as implementing EU directives that leave no room for policy choices, with technical details left to an amvb and ministerial regulation.
q: These are obligations from the European directives that leave no room for policy choices.
Het gaat om verplichtingen uit de Europese richtlijnen die geen ruimte laten voor het maken van keuzen van beleidsinhoudelijke aard.
d: conformity assessment rules, CE marking, obligations of market operators
content of EU declaration of conformity
transfer of files from designated body whose designation is withdrawn
requirements for internal bodies performing conformity assessment
p: Designation of bodies may now be withdrawn temporarily and the Minister may set rules on transfer of their files.

parties: Asks the government to commit that any extra rules adopted by general administrative order under article 5(1) will not undermine a level playing field for Dutch firms.
Can the government commit that it will always take as its starting point that no additional rule may be added that undermines the level playing field for Dutch companies?
Kan de regering toezeggen dat zij daarbij altijd als uitgangspunt zal hanteren dat er geen enkele extra regel bij mag komen die het gelijke speelveld voor Nederlandse bedrijven aantast?
Asks where responsibility for market surveillance is allocated and questions why the government judges the regulatory burden effects as negligible despite possible AmvB-based increases.

Looking at the bill as a whole, the PvdA members ask why the government concludes there is no increase in administrative burden, while the (elaboration in) AmvBs does give cause for it.](Note: the sentence is copied verbatim; translation provided.)

Het wetsvoorstel overziend vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie waarom de regering de conclusie trekt dat er geen toename van de administratieve lasten plaatsvindt, terwijl de (uitwerking in) AmvB’s daar wel aanleiding toe geeft.
Has no questions on the bill.
Sees no reason for questions at this time.
At this moment they see no reason for questions.
Op het ogenblik zien zij geen aanleiding voor vragen.
Questions the necessity of new obligations on market participants and the EU-driven burden on Dutch entrepreneurs, and asks for an analysis of the costs.
They are not yet convinced of the usefulness and necessity of this bill and find it undesirable that Dutch entrepreneurs unnecessarily fall victim to the unbridled regulatory zeal of the EU.
Zij zijn namelijk nog niet overtuigd van nut en noodzaak van dit wetsvoorstel en vinden het onwenselijk als Nederlandse ondernemers onnodig de dupe worden van de ongebreidelde regelzucht van de EU.

34210-X.s: The bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (Article X) by adjusting expenditure and commitment figures across policy and non-policy articles, effective from 1 June 2015. It is a supplementary budget adjustment with no new substantive delegations of rule-making power.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have deemed fit and resolved, as We hereby deem fit and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

34224.s: The bill amends Book 4 of the Civil Code so that an heir who has accepted an estate purely, and then discovers an unexpected debt, can ask the district court within three months to be allowed to accept benefically or to be released from paying that debt from private assets. It also drops the requirement to publish certain notices in designated newspapers for estate administrators.
34224.j: The memorandum justifies the new heir protection by pointing to earlier case law granting case-by-case relief on grounds of reasonableness and fairness, which it seeks to codify.
q: The exception clause gives heirs who, after this law takes effect, have accepted an estate purely and face an unexpected debt the possibility of turning to the judge to protect their private assets.

De uitzonderingsclausule geeft erfgenamen die na inwerkingtreding van deze wet een nalatenschap zuiver hebben aanvaard en zijn geconfronteerd met een onverwachte schuld, de mogelijkheid om zich tot de rechter te wenden teneinde hun privévermogen te beschermen.
p: Gives heirs a judicial route, via the district court, to protect private assets against unexpected estate debts, expanding citizens' legal protection against creditors rather than the executive.

parties: Asks whether the rule on acts showing acceptance and the sentimental-value exception will be left to case law, creating legal uncertainty and procedures.
Asks why heirs cannot refuse the estate after three months, and how far the duty to investigate debts and creditors extends.
Why is the heir not given the option to refuse the estate after those three months instead of beneficiary acceptance?
Waarom wordt de erfgenaam niet de mogelijkheid geboden na die drie maanden de erfenis te weigeren in plaats van een beneficiaire aanvaarding?
Asks how a judge can establish whether a positive estate remains when assets are commingled, and about limits on acts that count as acceptance.
Questions whether the proposal goes far enough, whether the double recourse principle should be kept, and whether heirs face added costs and procedures.
These members do ask whether the proposed statutory regulation goes far enough or could or should have been arranged differently.
Deze leden vragen echter wel of de voorgestelde wettelijk regeling ver genoeg gaat en niet anders ingericht had kunnen/moeten worden.
Asks whether inheritance debts from an earlier deceased parent fall under the bill and whether an exception clause is needed.
These members ask whether, for that reason, the over-distribution debt from the estate of an earlier deceased parent also falls under this bill?
Deze leden vragen of om die reden de overbedelingsschuld op grond van de nalatenschap van een eerder overleden ouder ook onder de werking van dit wetsvoorstel valt?
Asks the government about the social and private functions of inheritance and the aims of inheritance law, and about the effect on transparency.
These members want to ask the government what it sees as the societal and private functions of inheritances.
Zo willen deze leden de regering vragen wat in haar ogen de maatschappelijke en private functies zijn van erfenissen.
Asks about transitional law and whether heirs can invoke the new rules for debts discovered shortly before entry into force.
They would like to know whether the new rules apply in full to estates that already became available before this bill takes effect.
Graag vernemen zij of ook voor nalatenschappen die reeds voor inwerkingtreding van dit wetsvoorstel zijn vrijgevallen de nieuwe regeling onverkort geldt.

34233.s: The bill inserts a new article 13a into the Health Insurance Act requiring insurers to include a personal care budget (Zvw-pgb) in their model contracts for people needing nursing and care not tied to hospital stay. It lets the government set by general administrative order the eligibility conditions, exclusions, covered care and maximum reimbursement levels.
34233.j: The memorandum justifies the decree power as a legal basis needed to set eligibility conditions and maximum allowances for professionals and non-professionals, which the rejected bill 33 362 would otherwise have lacked.
q: Nor is there a basis to set further rules by general administrative order on the conditions under which the insured person qualifies for a Zvw-pgb.
Evenmin is er een grondslag om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels te stellen over de voorwaarden waaronder de verzekerde in aanmerking komt voor een Zvw-pgb
d: conditions for eligibility, exclusions, covered care, reimbursement levels for Zvw-pgb
p: The government may set eligibility, exclusions, covered services and maximum reimbursement by decree, with the enumerated subject matter in subparagraphs a to d as the only limit and no parliamentary approval required.

parties: Asks whether insurers' conditions and tariff-setting undermine the personal budget and whether the government will intervene if insurers fail to follow agreements.
Questions why key eligibility and tariff matters are left to AMvB rather than the statute, and who monitors insurers' compliance with agreements.
The SP members note that the bill has given health insurers a great deal of power.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat door het wetsvoorstel de zorgverzekeraars veel macht hebben gekregen.
Finds it unclear when insurers may set rules versus when government will impose AMvB rules, and questions the vagueness of the criteria.
Can the government create more clarity on when this falls under insurers' freedom and when it will move to setting further rules?
Kan de regering meer duidelijkheid scheppen over wanneer het nu onder de vrijheid van zorgverzekeraars valt en wanneer er overgegaan zal worden tot het stellen van nadere regels?
Asks why the government does not set conditions directly, and objects to insurer-level differences and to quality supervision by the NZa.
Why was it not chosen for the government to directly set further conditions, ask the PVV members.
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen om direct vanuit de regering nadere voorwaarden in te vullen, zo vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie.
Asks for the draft AMvB to be shared and for confirmation that the pgb is an equal alternative to care in kind, with concerns about materially worse outcomes for insured persons.
Can the Chamber receive the draft AMvB so it can be considered in the treatment of this bill?
Kan de Kamer de concept-amvb ontvangen zodat deze kan worden betrokken bij de behandeling van onderhavig wetsvoorstel?
Asks for clarification of insurer-set criteria, the role of the SVB, and the monitoring of how insurers implement the Zvw-pgb.
These members would like an explanation of how the implementation of the Zvw-pgb by insurers is monitored.
Deze leden zouden graag een toelichting willen op de wijze waarop de invulling van het Zvw-pgb door zorgverzekeraars wordt gemonitord?
Asks whether the government will closely monitor access to the Zvw-pgb, whether budget holders can be excluded from the macro-control instrument, and whether the AMvB text will be shared.
Questions whether insurers' additional criteria make the pgb practically inaccessible and asks why eligibility conditions are not in the statute.
Does this not make it very easy for insurers to make the pgb practically inaccessible?
Wordt het hiermee niet heel gemakkelijk voor verzekeraars om het pgb praktisch ontoegankelijk te maken?
Asks how criteria are applied, whether they are sufficiently measurable, and whether they give insurers too much discretion to deny a pgb.
Does this not give insurers too much freedom/power in deciding whether to grant a Zvw-pgb?
Geeft dit verzekeraars niet teveel vrijheid/macht in het al dan niet toekennen van een Zvw-pgb?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises sending the bill introducing a Zvw personal budget (Zvw-pgb) to parliament but raises concerns about its alignment with the Zvw system and the Wmg, particularly why a pgb is needed and why Wmg was not amended for maximum fees. The government's reply largely defends the choice of a pgb within the Zvw, adds a definition of Zvw-pgb, and declines to amend the Wmg, while adapting the wording on exclusions and the aging-process passage.
concerns: The Afdeling questions why a pgb is needed in the Zvw when existing private-law polis mechanisms could accommodate non-contracted care, and asks for justification in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling notes the Zvw-pgb, being in essence a restitution arrangement, deviates from other pgb regimes and asks why it is not more closely aligned with the Zvw restitution system.
The Afdeling advises amending the Wmg rather than the Zvw to allow the Nza to set maximum tariffs for care by non-professionals, which the government declines.
The Afdeling makes redactional comments, including adding a definition of Zvw-pgb and clarifying the normal aging-process passage, which the government adopts.

34251.s: The bill strengthens governance of education institutions across sectors by requiring that executive board members and internal supervisors be appointed on the basis of publicly announced profiles, and by giving works councils advisory rights over profiles and board appointments and dismissals. It also requires internal supervisors to consult councils at least twice yearly, obliges them to report risky developments to the Inspectorate of Education, and strengthens the dispute procedure for works councils, including binding decisions, enforceable penalties and a route to the court of appeal.
34251.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules on notifying the Inspectorate as allowing flexibility and responsiveness rather than a rigid statutory list, and notes that the Inspectorate's ordinary powers are insufficient for prospective supervision.
q: That offers more room for flexibility and responsiveness than a 'hard' statutory enumeration or definition of notification cases.
Dat biedt meer ruimte voor flexibiliteit en responsiviteit dan een «harde» wettelijke opsomming of duiding van meldingsgevallen.
d: Artikel IX (inwerkingtreding); Art. 25 WMS-wijziging rond 'algemene maatregel van bestuur' (art. 17c/24e1 etc.)
cases in which the internal supervisor must inform the Inspectorate
Artikel IV, onderdeel D (art. 9.1.4 lid 9 WEB); Artikel V onderdeel H (art. 9.51 lid 8 WHW)
cases requiring notification to the Inspectorate of supervisory activities
p: Artikel VI onderdeel J (art. 35 WMS) en onderdeel K (art. 36 WMS)
Strengthens works councils' ability to enforce compliance and to appeal decisions of the dispute commission, adding enforceable penalties and court routes.

parties: Not convinced of the reporting duty for supervisory boards and misses the government's ambition on governance strength.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill but are not convinced of the reporting obligation and miss the government's ambition on several points.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel, maar zijn niet overtuigd van de meldplicht en missen op een aantal punten de ambitie van de regering.
Wants more student and staff influence than advisory rights provide and asks how the Council of State's criticism of the reporting duty will be addressed.
That said, the members had expected more measures and wanted to go further to give students and teachers a strengthened position within an educational institution.
Wel is het zo dat de leden meer maatregelen hadden verwacht en verder hadden willen gaan om studenten en docenten te voorzien van een versterkte positie binnen een onderwijsinstelling.
Considers the measures cosmetic and asks why works councils get only advisory rather than consent rights over board appointments and pay.
These members consider the measures in this bill to be mainly cosmetic and wholly insufficient to change the major qualitative problems in (higher) education.

Deze leden beoordelen de in dit wetsvoorstel afgekondigde maatregelen als voornamelijk cosmetisch en volstrekt onvoldoende om de grote kwalitatieve problemen in het (hoger) onderwijs te kunnen veranderen.
Asks why the measures are needed in statute rather than the governance code and whether the reporting duty fits with the Council of State's objections.
These members find it very important that the works council is involved in this, but wonder whether this already happens at many educational institutions.
Deze leden vinden het van groot belang dat de medezeggenschapsraad hierbij betrokken is, maar vragen zich af of dit bij veel onderwijsinstellingen al niet gebeurt.
Disappointed by advisory rather than consent rights and the absence of a student assessor and broader information rights for works councils.
They see the bill as a missed opportunity to truly strengthen the governing capacity of educational institutions.
Zij zien het wetsvoorstel als een gemiste kans om de bestuurskracht van onderwijsinstellingen écht te versterken.
Doubts that more statutory regulation is the solution and questions the Council of State's objection that the reporting duty conflicts with institutional autonomy.
They doubt, however, whether more laws and regulations for all educational institutions is the solution to achieving a good governance culture in education.
Zij betwijfelen echter of meer wet- en regelgeving voor alle onderwijsinstellingen de oplossing is om tot een goede bestuurscultuur in het onderwijs te komen.
Worries that further legal formalisation of institutions may hinder flexibility and questions whether the reporting duty would have helped in past cases.
These members ask to what extent the government recognises the risk that further formalisation of relationships within legal persons through statutory rules could also hinder renewal and flexibility.

De leden vragen in hoeverre de regering het risico onderkent dat een verdere formalisering van de verhoudingen binnen rechtspersonen in wettelijke regels ook een belemmering kan zijn voor vernieuwing en flexibiliteit.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against sending the bill on strengthening governance in Dutch education institutions to parliament unless a proposed duty for internal supervisors to report reasonably suspected mismanagement to the Inspectie was dropped, arguing it misconceives internal supervisors' duty toward the institution and lacks a justified need. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the criticisms, reframes the duty as a flexible reporting obligation modeled on the Woningwet, and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling found no analysis showing why the reporting duty is needed or why existing instruments such as the continuity paragraph and Inspectie powers are insufficient; the government defended the duty's added value but conceded the justification should be strengthened.

The Afdeling said the proposed immediate reporting duty on any reasonable suspicion of mismanagement blurs responsibility and liability between internal and external supervisors; the government replaced it with a flexible, AMvB-based reporting duty.

The Afdeling objected that the premise that internal supervisors primarily serve the public interest conflicts with private-law corporate governance; the government disputed the view but accepted the public interest should be framed as one element of the institution's interest.
Redactional remarks, including a correction of the word 'gevolgd' to 'gevolg' in Artikel IV, were adopted.

34260.s: The bill amends the Telecommunications Act to implement EU directives 2014/30/EU (electromagnetic compatibility) and 2014/53/EU (radio equipment), updating definitions, obligations for manufacturers, importers and distributors, and market supervision. It adds ministerial and general administrative order delegation grounds for technical rules, conformity assessment, recalls and withdrawal of equipment, and a transitional regime for older equipment.
34260.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement EU directives and to set technical and conformity details, and the new powers as enforcement tools for market surveillance and product safety.
q: This article is implemented via a legal basis for the relevant obligation in the new article 10.9, subsection i, of the Act.
Dit artikel is geïmplementeerd via een grondslag voor de betreffende verplichting in het nieuwe artikel 10.9, onderdeel i, van de wet.
d: exceptions to prohibitions on placing equipment on the market
further rules on obligations of market operators
special measures on use of equipment and means to recall or withdraw products
rules implementing mutual recognition agreements with third countries
rules for TV reception and decryption equipment implementing EU decisions
rules on advertising of prohibited equipment
handling of complaints about electromagnetic interference
p: The Minister may issue binding instructions to holders or users of equipment causing unacceptable interference, even where the equipment meets the requirements.
Artikel I, L (art. 15.2, lid 1 onder b)
The Minister may order testing of radio equipment at the manufacturer's or importer's cost, in a manner and within a term set by the Minister.

The Minister may use means to stop, restrict, recall or withdraw equipment where there is a justified fear of risk to health, safety or general interests, with the means to be set by general administrative order.

parties: Asks whether other member states will implement the directives properly and whether the government will monitor and report them to the European Commission.
Is the government willing to keep an eye on implementation in other member states?
Is de regering bereid een oogje in het zijl te houden wat betreft de implementatie in andere lidstaten?
Asks who will supervise compliance with comprehensible language in instructions and why technical documents must be requested rather than already held by the supervisor.
Who will supervise the comprehensible language?
Wie toezicht houden op het begrijpelijke taalgebruik?
Asks the government to justify why a binding instruction in case of interference is desirable and what practical problems prompted it.
Could the government further explain why it expects these effects and what they are based on?
Zou de regering nader kunnen toelichten waarom ze deze gevolgen verwacht en waar deze gevolgen op zijn gebaseerd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised the Telecommunicatiewet amendment implementing EMC and radio equipment directives to proceed, but asked for better justification of the territorial reach of prohibitions, the need for the minister's binding instruction power, a more precise delegation, and the reason for phased entry into force. The minister's reply adjusted the explanatory memorandum on most points, but did not yet follow the advice on EEA-wide definitions.
concerns: The territorial scope of the prohibitions extending to the whole EU was questioned as overbroad and extraterritorial; the explanatory memorandum was adjusted, but the EEA-wide definitions of importer and authorised representative were not changed yet.

The necessity of the minister's binding instruction power under article 10.13 was not motivated, given that the directive provision was already implemented; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The delegation to the minister in article 10.1 was too general and needed more precise description; the explanatory memorandum was adjusted and the delegation in article 10.13 was removed.
Phased entry into force needed justification and the implementation dates of the two directives did not align; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
Several editorial and transposition table remarks were made and taken over in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

34300-X.s: This bill sets the 2016 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Defence and the budget statements for the agencies Defensie Telematica Organisatie and Paresto, in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes the budget structure, operational deployments, investment cash flows and oversight relationships, but the bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power or shift of power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2016, attached to this law, is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X)voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34305.s: The bill makes a package of technical and fiscal amendments for 2016, including changes to the income tax partner definition, a new mass-objection procedure and a preliminary-question procedure before the Supreme Court in tax matters, lijfsdwang (imprisonment for debt) for civil damages claims in tax collection, and a country-by-country reporting obligation for multinationals. It also suspends the effect of first-instance rulings on childcare/allowance cases pending appeal.
34305.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as technical maintenance and efficiency of tax administration, rule-of-law gains from a prejudicial procedure, and administrative simplification for the suspensive effect of appeals.
q: To guarantee this, the cabinet proposes several improvements to the mass-objection procedure and to introduce a preliminary-question procedure before the Supreme Court in tax matters.

Om dit te waarborgen, stelt het kabinet voor een aantal verbeteringen aan te brengen in de massaalbezwaarprocedure en om ook in belastingzaken een prejudiciële procedure bij de Hoge Raad in te voeren.
d: designating public benefits and transport facilities for labour-market positioning
data to be provided in the tax return on mortgage debt with non-designated lenders
form and content of country-by-country report and transfer pricing documentation
ARTIKEL XII, I (art. 70a Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag)
conditions and limits for refund of energy tax on natural gas used by vessels
designating mass-objection cases and collective decisions by the tax inspector
rules for deviating collection procedures with taxpayer consent
p: Extends the tax collector's power to apply imprisonment for debt to civil damages claims and to directors and de facto directors of entities, subject to court proceedings.
Allows the collector to depart from statutory collection rules in an experimental manner with taxpayer consent, with a report to parliament within five years.
Lets the inspector bind many objections to one collective decision that cannot be appealed, and allows the inspector to agree payment of costs and conditions with selected parties.
Introduces a preliminary-question procedure allowing tax judges to refer legal questions to the Supreme Court, strengthening judicial and legal-certainty checks.
Makes appeals against first-instance rulings in income-dependent scheme cases suspend their effect, which for benefit recipients means payments already ruled due may be withheld pending appeal.
Allows the Minister to waive tax on merger gains in municipal reorganisations on conditions set by the Minister, subject to appealable decisions.

parties: Asks about enforceability of the export scheme and the timing and reasons for introducing the prejudicial procedure in tax cases.
The VVD members think it is right that a prejudicial procedure is now also being introduced in tax cases.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden het terecht dat nu ook in belastingzaken een prejudiciële procedure wordt ingevoerd.
Supports simplification and anti-abuse measures but questions whether the mass-objection rules and anti-abuse wording are adequate and whether representative case selection is ensured.
They question whether this measure helps, as cooperation from the taxpayer is required.
Zij vragen zich daarbij wel af of dit middel daartoe helpt, enige medewerking van de belastingschuldige is vereist.
Challenges the mass-objection procedure over box 3 wealth tax, raising possible breaches of due-process principles and the taxpayer's legal protection after a late switch to the procedure.
Does this decision amount to a breach of the principles of good administration?
Is er met dit besluit sprake van schending van de beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur?

Objects to the removal of the Chamber's four-week review of mass-objection designations, to the consultation process for the prejudicial procedure, and to the Tax Authority's unequal position in appeals.
In the proposals the House of Representatives is deprived of this option and is only given a notification.
In de voorstellen wordt de Tweede Kamer deze mogelijkheid ontnomen en wordt nog slechts een kennisgeving verstrekt.
Asks whether tightening the requirement to actually file objection to join mass objection will create unnecessary paperwork.
Will this tightening not cause unnecessary paperwork at the Tax Authority?
Zal deze aanscherping geen onnodige papierstroom doen veroorzaken bij de Belastingdienst?

Questions why the procedure is in an omnibus bill rather than separate legislation, why the four-week parliamentary review is removed, and why no appeal lies against a court's decision to refer a prejudicial question.
These members note that under the current scheme an intention to designate mass objection is submitted to the House for four weeks and ask why the government wants to abandon this.

Deze leden constateren dat onder de huidige regeling een voornemen tot aanwijzing als massaal bezwaar vier weken wordt voorgelegd bij de Tweede Kamer en vragen zich af waarom de regering hier vanaf wil.
Asks about the rationale for suspensive effect of appeals in benefit cases and about the enforceability and sanctions of country-by-country reporting.
Can the government indicate how many appeal procedures are conducted per year?
Kan de regering aangeven hoeveel procedures in hoger beroep per jaar gevoerd worden?
Asks what hearing rights and legal protection a person with an opposing interest has in WOZ valuation objection proceedings.
What legal protection options does the person with an opposing interest have in that case and where are these regulated?
Welke mogelijkheden op rechtsbescherming heeft de persoon met een tegengesteld belang in dat geval en waar zijn die mogelijkheden geregeld?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the Overige fiscale maatregelen 2016 bill proceed to parliament but requested reasoning or adjustment on several parts, notably the new prejudicial procedure in tax cases, the experimentation clause, documentation duties and the extension of physical coercion powers. The Secretary of State largely rejected the objections on the prejudicial procedure and the experimentation clause, but followed the advice on the Monumenten and Natuurschoonwet extensions, practical feasibility, and the redactional comments.
concerns: The Afdeling found the need and opportunity of a prejudicial procedure in tax cases insufficiently shown and advised awaiting the civil evaluation; the government disagreed and kept the proposal.
The Afdeling advised placing the major change to tax procedure law in a separate bill rather than this omnibus bill; the government declined.
The experimentation clause in the Invorderingswet lacked sufficiently precise scope, purpose, and duration; the government added explanation to the memorie but kept the clause.
Extension of physical coercion (lijfsdwang) needed justification of necessity given ECHR Article 5; the explanatory memorandum was expanded.
Practical feasibility of the country-by-country documentation duties was not discussed; the explanatory memorandum now addresses it.

The Afdeling argued the tax-facility extension for monuments also touches free movement of capital and should cover third states with information exchange; the government argued a standstill clause applies to monuments but followed the advice for landgoederen.
Redactional comments on the wording of Article I, V and XVIII were largely adopted.

34314.s: The bill lets the Minister for Housing, at a municipal council's request, designate streets, complexes or areas where housing permits can be refused to applicants with a criminal or nuisance history, based on a certificate of conduct or a police-data investigation. It also gives municipal housing ordinances power to set conditions and enforcement, with objection and appeal open against refusals.
34314.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to tackle serious liveability and crime problems that existing tools cannot address, and as needed to give the current screening practice a formal legal basis.
q: Therefore it is proposed to give municipalities the option, as part of an integrated approach to liveability, to exclude housing applicants with a criminal or nuisance past in complexes, streets or areas designated by the Minister at the municipal council's request that face serious liveability problems.

Daarom wordt voorgesteld om aan gemeenten de mogelijkheid te bieden, in het kader van de integrale aanpak van de leefbaarheid, in door de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst op verzoek van de gemeenteraad aangewezen complexen, straten of gebieden, die kampen met ernstige leefbaarheidsproblemen, woningzoekenden met een crimineel of overlastgevend verleden te kunnen weren.
d: designation of streets, complexes or areas for selective allocation
municipal housing ordinance refusal rules and categories
rules on police-data investigation, processing and retention
mandate to officials for the investigation powers
p: Ministerial power to designate areas for refusing housing permits based on criminal or nuisance history, requiring necessity and proportionality review and periodic evaluation.
Municipal authorities may use police data on enumerated conduct over up to four years to refuse housing permits, with a hearing right and appeal available.

parties: Asks whether the four-year look-back and the choice between VOG and police screening are proportionate, and how statushouders and EU citizens can be screened effectively.
People who cause serious housing nuisance must be able to be excluded from certain neighbourhoods.
Mensen die ernstige woonoverlast veroorzaken moeten kunnen geweerd uit bepaalde buurten.
Questions whether the current use of police data without a statutory basis is lawful, and asks for the government's justification and the review of new police instruments.

These members attach great importance to effective measures to make residential neighbourhoods safer, but also note that the bill contains instruments that can deeply intrude on people's fundamental rights.

Deze leden hechten veel belang aan effectieve maatregelen om woonwijken veiliger en plezieriger te maken, maar constateren ook dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel instrumenten kent die diep in kunnen grijpen in iemands grondrechten.
Worries about discrimination against low-income tenants, privacy and freedom of settlement, possible disclosure of police data to landlords or other tenants, and the 20-year maximum period.
The proposed bill causes further disadvantage.
Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel zorgt voor een verdere achterstelling.
Asks for clearer motivation of proportionality and effectiveness, safeguarding of privacy in police-data screening, and attention to the Rotterdam evaluation.
On both aspects, proportionality and effectiveness, these members consider a concrete justification desirable.
Op beide aspecten, proportionaliteit én effectiviteit, is volgens deze leden een concrete motivering wenselijk.
Not convinced of necessity; worries that non-proven police reports could block allocation and that municipal officials' subjective assessment of police data needs safeguards.
These members are therefore not yet convinced of the necessity and desirability of this proposal and have some questions.
Deze leden zijn daarom nog niet overtuigd van de noodzaak en wenselijkheid van dit voorstel en hebben enkele vragen.
Questions proportionality, subsidiarity and effectiveness of police-data screening, notes the critical Raad van State advice, and asks why the ernst threshold cannot be specified in law.
For the application of this kind of far-reaching measure, weighty reasons of general interest must exist.
Voor de toepassing van dit soort ingrijpende maatregelen moeten zwaarwegende redenen van algemeen belang bestaan.
Welcomes the expanded municipal powers to exclude criminals and nuisance-causers and endorses VOG and police screening, while raising some further questions.
Member Van Vliet is pleased that municipalities are getting more options to exclude criminals or people causing nuisance from neighbourhoods, streets or complexes with serious liveability problems.

Het lid Van Vliet is verheugd dat gemeenten meer mogelijkheden krijgen om criminelen of mensen die overlast veroorzaken te weren uit wijken, straten of complexen waar sprake is van ernstige leefbaarheidsproblemen.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on a bill allowing municipalities to screen rental applicants via VOG or police data in designated areas to exclude those with criminal or nuisance records, finding the necessity, proportionality, effectiveness and rights safeguards insufficiently justified and advising reconsideration before submission to parliament. The minister's nader rapport responds point by point, largely defending the bill, adding justifications, and amending parts of the text and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Council doubts proportionality of the measure given existing instruments and the four-year duration without interim review; the government justifies the measure and clarifies duration and oversight, but does not add interim review.
The Council finds the necessity and effectiveness, including possible waterbed effects, insufficiently shown; the government disputes the evaluations and argues evidence supports effectiveness.

Use of police data for screening seriously infringes freedom of settlement and privacy and lacks a careful balancing against privacy; the government defends police data use and amends the explanatory memorandum.
The weighting criteria for police data should be set out in the bill itself, distinguishing criminal offences from other conduct; the government amended the bill accordingly.
Screening of later co-residents needs a statutory basis in the bill rather than only a municipal ordinance; the government amended the bill.
Legal protection gaps: appeals have no suspensive effect, so a rejected applicant may lose the home; the government explains the alternative-housing route without changing the bill.
The explanatory memorandum should address the consequences of the Wet raadgevend referendum for entry into force; the government added this.

34323.s: The bill amends the Dutch corporate income tax act's fiscal unity regime so that it complies with EU law, notably by allowing fiscal unities based on 95% (economic and legal) ownership through top and intermediate companies and foreign-established entities. It adds related rules on participation exemptions, loss deductions and the discontinuation of fiscal unities, and delegates detailed criteria for comparability of foreign entities and related conditions to general administrative orders (AMvB).
34323.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying general rules are needed to assess comparability of foreign entities and to handle cases where entities do not apply the same profit rules.
q: Rules may be given by or pursuant to a general administrative order for assessing whether a foreign-law entity is comparable in nature and structure to a Dutch-law entity.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gegeven voor de beoordeling of een naar buitenlands recht opgericht lichaam naar aard en inrichting vergelijkbaar is met een naar Nederlands recht opgericht lichaam.
d: rules on comparability of foreign entities and fiscal unity formation
rules on fiscal unity for entities with differing profit determination
conditions for non-resident taxpayers with a Dutch permanent establishment to join a fiscal unity
I-G (art. 15, veertiende lid, onderdelen c-d, k-l)
continuation of fiscal unity and related circumstances
p: I-G (art. 15, elfde lid, referring to voorhang)
Retains a voorhang procedure for delegated rule-making, keeping parliamentary involvement in the delegation.

parties: Questions whether the bill is necessary and worries it will invite new tax-avoidance structures and require frequent future revision; asks why the government did not await the Groupe Steria study.
The PvdA members fear this bill will provoke new creative structures whose sole purpose is tax avoidance.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vrezen dat dit wetsvoorstel nieuwe creatieve structuren zal uitlokken die als enig doel hebben belasting te ontwijken.
Asks what unforeseen abuse situations may arise, whether further CJEU rulings could overtake the bill, and how many fiscal unity decisions are issued.
The explanatory memorandum states that it is currently not possible to foresee which undesirable situations may arise and which measures will be needed to respond.
De memorie van toelichting meldt dat momenteel niet te overzien is welke ongewenste situaties zich kunnen voordoen en welke maatregelen moeten worden genomen om daarop te reageren.
Asks why the ownership requirement is tightened relative to the STAK ruling, why certain entities are excluded, and whether the rules satisfy EU law and avoid double loss deduction.
Why has this ownership requirement been tightened, ask the CDA members.
Waarom is deze bezitseis aangescherpt, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Asks about the philosophy, revenue loss and complexity of the regime, and whether the bill creates unequal treatment between domestic and foreign situations.
Has a trade-off been made between revenue loss and the fiscal investment climate, ask the PVV members.
Is er een afweging gemaakt in de mate waarin er sprake is van opbrengstderving en het fiscale vestigingsklimaat, zo vragen de leden van de fractie van de PVV.
Asks why the regime is limited to EU/EEA entities and why the ownership requirement departs from the STAK ruling, and seeks details on revenue offsets.
What is the government's reason for limiting the proposed fiscal unity regime to entities established in the EU/EEA?
Wat is de beweegreden van de regering om het voorgestelde fiscale eenheidsregime beperkt te houden tot in de EU/EER gevestigde entiteiten?
Asks how many companies will use the expanded regime, its practical effects, and why the bill is being submitted now.
How many companies will make use of this, ask the VVD members.
Hoeveel bedrijven zullen hier gebruik van maken, vragen de leden van de fractie van de VVD.
Asks the government to respond to the NOB letter on whether double taxation can arise and how the proposed solution is viewed.
Double taxation is in principle undesirable.
Dubbele heffing is in principe niet wenselijk.

Worries about the scope of the bill and future changes driven by European case law, and asks the state secretary to keep the House informed early about new circumstances; also objects to temporarily raising labour-related Awf premiums to cover the budget.
In what way will the State Secretary keep the House informed of new circumstances that may lead to further amendments?
Op welke manier gaat de Staatssecretaris de Kamer op de hoogte houden van nieuwe omstandigheden die mogelijk leiden tot verdere wijzigingen?
Question whether it is wise to legislate given the unclear budgetary and legal effects, and ask whether loss transfer opens room for unwanted tax planning.
These members ask the government whether it is desirable to introduce legislation now, given so much uncertainty.
Deze leden vragen de regering of het wel wenselijk is om op dit moment wetgeving in te voeren, waarover zoveel onduidelijkheid bestaat.
Asks how many fiscal unities involve a stichting administratiekantoor and how administrative consequences of starting or continuing sister fiscal unities will be handled.
Can the government indicate how many fiscal unities with a stichting administratiekantoor there are?
Kan de regering aangeven hoeveel fiscale eenheden met een stichting administratiekantoor er zijn?
Asks whether the government will reflect on the NOB suggestion to soften the ownership requirement via the Besluit, and asks which other measures will cover the budget.
These members ask whether the government is willing to reflect on the NOB's suggestion.
Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is te reflecteren op de suggestie van de NOB.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division gave no substantive remarks on the draft bill amending the Dutch corporate tax act on fiscal unity, only four drafting remarks and advised sending it to parliament. The State Secretary of Finance's reply in the nader rapport states that the first two remarks were not followed with reasons, that the third and fourth were followed, and that several additional technical changes were made.
concerns: Remark on drafting of the new article 15(8)(b) for readability was followed by splitting it into points and reformulating it.
Remark on the wording of the replacement text referring to a taxpayer under article 15(8) was followed by adjusting the reference and ending with a full stop.
Remark that the sister fiscal unity rules should explicitly cover more than two sisters was not followed, as the existing rule already covers this via the referenced fourth sentence.
Remark that the entity must be subject to profit tax as a subject was not followed, as this is already implied by the text.

34341.s: The bill amends the pending constitutional declaration law on Caribbean public bodies (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) so that a separate electoral college for the Dutch Senate is created in those bodies, alongside the island councils. It sets out that elections for this college are held under the same rules as provincial elections, with details to be set by a future statute in formal sense.
34341.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to meet the constitutional and international obligation to give Caribbean residents voting rights for the Senate before the May 2019 elections, and notes the detailed arrangements will be fixed by formal law.
q: By law in the formal sense it will have to be determined whether one joint electoral college or several electoral colleges are established for the Caribbean public bodies.
Bij wet in formele zin zal bepaald moeten worden of voor de Caribische openbare lichamen één gezamenlijk kiescollege dan wel meerdere kiescolleges worden ingesteld.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B, onder 2 (artikel 132a, derde lid Grondwet)
establishment and organisation of electoral college for Senate in Caribbean bodies

parties: Supports a separate college composed only of Dutch nationals and awaits the government's decision on one or several colleges.
The VVD members therefore agree to establish the proposed separate electoral college, composed exclusively of persons with Dutch nationality.
De leden van de VVD-fractie stemmen dan ook in met het instellen van het voorgestelde aparte kiescollege, dat uitsluitend wordt samengesteld door personen met de Nederlandse nationaliteit.
Welcomes voting rights for Caribbean residents for the Eerste Kamer and asks for the islands' reactions quickly.
They consider it important that residents of Caribbean Netherlands receive voting rights for the Eerste Kamer.
Zij vinden het belangrijk dat de bewoners van Caribisch Nederland stemrecht krijgen voor de Eerste Kamer.
Endorses the principled solution of separate colleges so non-Dutch nationals do not influence the Eerste Kamer.
These members therefore endorse the government's chosen principled solution of forming separate electoral colleges for the Eerste Kamer.
Deze leden onder-schrijven dan ook de door de regering gekozen principiële oplossing door de vorming van afzonderlijke kiescolleges voor de Eerste Kamer.
Supports reconciling the Eerste Kamer's principles and wants the college in place for 2019, without prejudging the structural evaluation.
They attach importance to reconciling the principles formulated by the Eerste Kamer.
Zij hechten aan het verenigen van de uitgangspunten die door de Eerste Kamer zijn geformuleerd.
Questions the constitutional propriety and legal purity of using a novelle on a declaratory act and asks why an open provision was chosen.
Furthermore, they have important reservations about the route chosen for this bill of a novelle on a declaratory act and its constitutional purity and sustainability.
Voorts hebben zij belangrijke bedenkingen bij de voor dit wetsvoorstel gekozen route van een novelle op een verklaringswet en de staatsrechtelijke zuiverheid en houdbaarheid daarvan.
Asks whether the citation, title and considerans already imply one college and whether greater clarity on the constitutional design should come first.
Would it indeed not generally be better to first have more clarity on the precise constitutional design?
Zou het inderdaad in het algemeen niet beter zijn om eerst meer duidelijkheid te hebben over de precieze staatkundige vormgeving?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the draft bill creating separate electoral colleges for the Caribbean public bodies for the Eerste Kamer be sent to parliament with changes, notably reconsidering fixing the number of colleges in the Constitution itself and clarifying the feasibility of the timetable for 2019. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted the first point by allowing one college for several bodies by law, and addressed the timetable by explaining the urgency and the expected parliamentary process.
concerns: The Afdeling advised reconsidering whether fixing one electoral college per public body must be done in the Constitution itself, given the constitutional immaturity of the Caribbean bodies; the government followed this by allowing the law to set colleges for several bodies jointly.

The Afdeling asked whether the bill and the Verklaringswet can be handled and published in time for Caribbean Dutch voters to vote in the 2019 Eerste Kamer elections; the government stressed urgency and the importance of timely completion but did not give a firm assurance of feasibility.

34350-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Dutch States General (IIA), the second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations for the Eerste and Tweede Kamer and related items. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 1 December 2015.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2015;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2015;

34404.s: The bill amends the Judiciary Organisation Act and the Judicial Officers Legal Status Act to allow at most one member of the College of Procurators-General to be a non-judicial officer with financial and business-management expertise. That member would be a full, collegially responsible procurator-general appointed, suspended and dismissed by royal decree on the Minister's proposal, but would not chair the College and would not act as a deputy advocate-general or deputy public prosecutor.
34404.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the need for financial and business-management expertise in steering the Public Prosecution Service, given its ambitious and fundamental tasks.
q: For good governance of the Public Prosecution Service it is therefore desirable to be able to attract expertise within the College in the field of finance and business management.
Voor een goede besturing van het OM is het dan ook wenselijk om binnen het College expertise te kunnen aantrekken op het gebied van financiën en bedrijfsvoering.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 130 lid 5 Wet RO)
The Minister of Security and Justice becomes the competent employer, exercising appointment, suspension and dismissal powers over the non-judicial procurator-general under the Civil Servants Act.

parties: Asks whether the Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht had consent rights under article 51 of the civil service status act and whether it approved the bill, and asks about the precedent for other legal professions.
Did the Sectorcommissie approve this bill, or was that not necessary in this case?
Heeft de Sectorcommissie ingestemd met dit wetsvoorstel, of was dat in dit geval niet nodig?

Asks the government to specify the operational problems in steering the Public Prosecution Service that justify the change and how collective versus individual responsibility of the new member would work.

Must these members infer from the explanatory memorandum that the non-legally trained member of the College is administratively responsible within the College, or is the whole College administratively responsible and accountable?

Moeten deze leden uit de toelichting opmaken dat het niet juridisch geschoolde lid van het College bestuurlijk verantwoordelijk is binnen het College of is het gehele College bestuurlijk verantwoordelijk en aanspreekbaar omdat:

Supports the bill for adding expertise but asks whether the government's own budget cuts caused the need for stronger steering, whether future flexibility is needed, and whether the principled objections of the OM and the Dutch judiciary association should weigh more heavily.
