v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie to allow one non-judge member on the College van procureurs-generaal, recommending that this member's position toward the Minister be regulated comparably to the other procureurs-generaal. The government's nader rapport rejects that the position is insufficiently comparable, stating the member has equal decision-making powers and full ministerial responsibility, and notes the redactional remarks were addressed.
concerns: The Afdeling held that the new procureur-generaal's legal position toward the Minister, governed by general civil service rules, is not comparable to that of the other procureurs-generaal, who enjoy greater independence, and advised adapting the bill.

The Afdeling noted that the considerans and explanatory memorandum state the diversification goal of financial and management expertise but the bill text does not reflect it, and advised aligning them.

34413.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 910/2014 (eIDAS) in Dutch law by removing national certification rules now governed directly by the regulation, amending the Telecommunications Act to make the Minister of Economic Affairs the supervisory body for trust service providers, and adjusting Civil Code, General Administrative Law Act and other statutes. It also creates a trust list, data-breach notification coordination, and cross-border cooperation powers for supervisors.
34413.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary for proper implementation of the directly applicable EU regulation and for technical detail.
d: technical requirements for trust service providers and signature devices
data to be provided in breach notifications
information to be provided by designated bodies to the Minister
rules on preparing and publishing the trust list
additional documents required with qualified-status applications
Authority for Consumers and Markets ends or changes registration
p: Supervisory officials may exercise investigative powers for mutual assistance and joint investigations with foreign supervisors, subject to confidentiality conditions.
Extends the supervisory and enforcement scope of the Minister and officials to trust services and breach notification.}],

parties: Asks whether the audit instrument by conformity assessment bodies is sufficiently defined and whether the supervisor keeps its own final judgment, referring to the Fyra enquiry.
These members can agree that the final judgement is formed by the supervisor and that this cannot and may not replace its own judgement formation.
Deze leden kunnen zich goed vinden in het feit dat het eindoordeel wordt gevormd door de toezichthouder en dat dit de eigen oordeelsvorming niet kan en mag vervangen.
Asks about burden of proof rules for qualified trust service providers and how the bill relates to other reversal of burden of proof provisions.
The PvdA members ask whether it is correct that a reversal of the burden of proof applies to qualified providers of trust services.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of het klopt dat voor gekwalificeerde verleners van vertrouwensdiensten een omkering van de bewijslast geldt.
Asks about risks of low-assurance foreign eID means, safeguards for personal data if a private party operates the node, and protocols for identity theft.
These members are curious about the precautionary measures the government will take to safeguard personal data protection in case management by a private party is chosen.

Deze leden zijn benieuwd naar de voorzorgsmaatregelen die de regering zal nemen om de bescherming van persoonsgegevens te waarborgen in het geval gekozen gaat worden voor beheer door een private partij.
Asks how privacy is safeguarded, whether Privacy Impact Assessments will be sent to parliament, and about enforcement, sanctions and administrative burden.
These members also ask whether the government is willing to send the announced additional Privacy Impact Assessments to the House after they have been carried out.
Ook vragen deze leden of regering bereid is om de aangekondigde aanvullende Privacy Impact Assessments naar de Kamer te sturen nadat deze is uitgevoerd.
Distrusts foreign eID systems and fears misuse of Dutch social benefits and privacy loss, asking for controls on who accesses citizens' eID and whether citizens can revoke access.
Can the government indicate how a Dutch citizen can check who has access to his or her electronic identification?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe een Nederlandse burger straks kan controleren wie er toegang heeft tot zijn of haar elektronische identificatie?

Welcomes simplification of certificate issuance but asks for definition of 'significant' incidents, protocols for public notification, and clarity on the role of multiple supervisory bodies and the Cbp advice.
Although these members welcome that this obligation exists, they would like to know more concretely when consequences are 'significant'.
Hoewel deze leden het goed vinden dat deze verplichting er is, zouden zij graag concreter willen weten wanneer gevolgen «aanzienlijk» zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill implementing the EU eIDAS regulation proceed, but that the paragraph applying article 12 of the Wet raadgevend referendum to its entry into force be deleted because the bill is not referendable and no urgency exists. The government's reply accepted the advice, deleted the provision, and made technical clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Article 12 Wrr should not be applied to the bill's entry into force since no necessity exists and the bill merely implements an EU regulation, so the provision must be deleted.

The explanatory memorandum lacked justification for the second paragraph of article XII, and the provision anticipating amendments outside the mandatory implementation scope was unnecessary and undesirable.

34422.s: The bill amends the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) to add a guarantee for bridge financing to the Single Resolution Board's Single Resolution Fund, with an amount of 4,163,500 thousand euros. It also sets the entry-into-force date as 1 January 2016, with retroactive effect if published later.
34422.j: The memorandum justifies the guarantee as needed for effective and credible resolution by the Single Resolution Board, and says the loan agreement will be signed only with ex ante approval from parliament, with the Tweede Kamer informed confidentially of any call on the guarantee.
q: the Netherlands has indicated its intention to sign the loan agreement with commitment fee and one-time ex ante approval of parliament.
Nederland aangegeven voornemens te zijn de leenovereenkomst met bereidstellingsprovisie en eenmalige ex ante goedkeuring van het parlement, te ondertekenen.

34485-J.s: The bill amends the 2016 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, the Dutch delta fund for flood protection and water management, by adopting a first supplementary budget with changed commitments, expenditure and receipts per article. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2016, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2016.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2016.

34503.s: The bill approves for the European and Caribbean parts of the Netherlands the 2015 tax treaty with Zambia on avoiding double taxation and preventing fiscal evasion on income taxes. It sets the date of entry into force as the first day of the third calendar month after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: Asks about the distributional effects of the treaty, why the 183-day service PE rule was accepted despite opposing it, and why selective choices were made from the OECD and UN model treaties.
Why was it nevertheless agreed to?
Waarom is er dan toch mee ingestemd.
Supports the treaty as helping developing countries collect taxes, but questions tax holidays, the absence of a switch-over clause and why Zambia preferred a main purpose test over an LOB clause.
The PvdA members therefore agree to the treaty, but still have some questions.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie stemmen dan ook in met het verdrag, maar hebben nog enkele vragen.
Questions whether the BES islands' administrations were sufficiently involved in the treaty and asks about anti-abuse provisions covering only dividends, interest and royalties.
They ask the government to respond to these remarks.
Zij vragen de regering op deze opmerkingen te reageren.
Asks whether the treaty is balanced and takes account of Dutch citizens' and businesses' interests, and whether information exchange is automatic or on request.
Furthermore, the CDA members ask the government to further justify why it considers the present treaty balanced and taking into account the interests of Dutch citizens and businesses.

Verder vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering nader te motiveren waarom zij meent dat het voorliggende verdrag als evenwichtig kan worden beschouwd en rekening houdt met de belangen van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven.
Asks whether the treaty meets the BEPS minimum with a main purpose test rather than a principal purpose test, and what consultation between states requires before the anti-abuse clause applies.
Does the Treaty with Zambia meet this minimum with the main purposes test, the members of the D66 faction ask.
Voldoet het Verdrag met Zambia aan dit minimum met de main purposes test, zo vragen de leden van de D66-fractie.
Asks about the effectiveness and monitoring of the main purpose test, the budgetary effects for Zambia, and the involvement of the Zambian parliament and NGOs.
Furthermore, these members are curious for an explanation of the included Main Purpose Test, its expected effectiveness, and whether the Netherlands also makes efforts to promote its use.
Verder zijn deze leden benieuwd naar een toelichting over de opgenomen Main Purpose Test, de verwachte effectiviteit daarvan, en of Nederland zich ook inspant om gebruik hiervan te bevorderen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised that the bill approving the 2015 Zambia double taxation treaty may go to parliament, but asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify whether and how the Caribbean public bodies (BES islands) were consulted under the consultation duty. The government replied that the explanatory memorandum on the Kingdom position was supplemented accordingly and that the advisory remarks were incorporated.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum does not show whether, and how, the BES island public bodies were consulted on the treaty, as required by the consultation duty in the Wet openbare lichamen BES.

34512.s: The bill simplifies the formation of samenwerkingsscholen (combined public-private schools) in primary and secondary education by replacing the strict continuity test with a norm tied to the opheffingsnorm and creating an identity committee at school level instead of an external supervisory body. It also adds transitional rules for informal combined schools and removes some administrative conditions on fusions.
34512.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by arguing the existing rules are too burdensome for school boards and that the constitution allows a more flexible regulatory framework.
q: School boards experience the current legislation as too intrusive.
Besturen ervaren huidige wetgeving als te ingrijpend
d: continuity test thresholds for combined schools
p: Replaces the external supervisory body for the private identity with an internal identity committee and requires municipal council consent only for statute changes concerning the public character of the school.

parties: Asks why the samenwerkingsschool is still an exception and whether municipal opheffingsnorm and fusion-test changes are adequately reviewed; asks about evaluation.
The VVD members have taken note with interest of the bill to simplify the establishment of joint schools.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel om de totstandkoming van samenwerkingsscholen te vereenvoudigen.
Supports the bill as implementing earlier proposals; asks about distance and school-size conditions and procedures for proving continuity risk.
The PvdA members support the initiative for the bill 'stronger together through simplification of the joint school'.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie ondersteunen het initiatief voor de wet «samen sterker door vereenvoudiging samenwerkingsschool».
Questions the identity commission's powers, who oversees it, and the independence of dispute resolution; worries about very large joint schools.
The SP members ask what powers the identity commission may be granted on behalf of the competent authority.
De leden vragen welke bevoegdheden de identiteitscommissie toegekend kan krijgen namens het bevoegd gezag.

Argues the bill conflicts with the Constitution's dual system and the exceptional status of joint schools; questions removal of the fusion test and transitional safeguards and the public-body involvement.
The CDA members agree with the Council of State that this bill conflicts with the constitutional provisions on the dual system in the Netherlands.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn met de Raad van State van mening dat dit wetsvoorstel strijdig is met de grondwettelijke bepalingen rondom het duale stelsel in Nederland.
Asks about governance rules, the municipality's role versus the identity commission, dispute resolution, and whether continuity criteria are justified beyond shrinking areas.
Can the government indicate what kind of 'dispute settler' it has in mind if a dispute unexpectedly arises between the identity commission and the competent authority.
Kan de regering aangeven aan wat voor soort «geschillenbeslechter» zij denkt wanneer er een onverhoopt een geschil ontstaat tussen identiteitscommissie en bevoegd gezag.
Questions whether the samenwerkingsschool remains a constitutional exception, the general applicability of the new norm including cities, and state intrusion via a mandatory identity commission.
They ask whether the constitutional exceptional position for joint schools still exists, now that more and more schools fall under the exception.
Zij vragen of nog sprake is van de grondwettelijke uitzonderingspositie voor samenwerkingsscholen, nu steeds meer scholen onder de uitzondering komen te vallen.

Argues identity safeguards are weakened and parity between public and denominational education is lacking; questions whether the continuity criterion really signals a threat and whether mandatory safeguards are adequate.
These members ask why the government wants to allow a joint school also in situations where a threat to continuity is not real.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering een samenwerkingsschool ook mogelijk wil maken in situaties waarin een bedreiging van de continuïteit niet reëel is.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against submitting the bill on merging schools into cooperative schools, arguing the broadened continuity criterion, the abolished fusion test and the foundation-run model conflict with Article 23 of the Constitution, and recommended reconsidering or a constitutional amendment. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely rejects the constitutional objection, accepts some points by adapting the continuity criterion, the advisory identity committee and transitional law, but keeps the core proposal.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that the broadened continuity criterion turns the cooperative school into a regular variant contrary to Article 23 of the Constitution, requiring a constitutional amendment; the government disagrees and considers the amendment within constitutional limits.

The Afdeling considers a public foundation as competent authority for a cooperative school incompatible with the Constitution, given neutrality and appointability requirements; the government rejects this view.

The Afdeling objects to the transitional provision legalising existing informal cooperative schools without testing them against the continuity criterion; the government now requires that criterion to be met.

The Afdeling advises a narrower bandwidth above the lowest closure norm for small schools in sparsely populated areas instead of a generic +60 margin; the government adjusted the criterion to a declining margin with a maximum of 200.

The Afdeling advises against abolishing the fusion test for mergers forming cooperative schools and boards, since it safeguards variety of education; the government argues the procedural burden is reduced without losing protection.

The Afdeling finds the identity committee too weak to safeguard public and denominational character and advises external municipal supervision; the government adds a dispute-resolution provision in the statutes but otherwise keeps the committee.
The Afdeling notes the explanatory memorandum inadequately addresses the advice of the Onderwijsraad and NCOR; the government supplemented the memorandum accordingly.

34611.s: The bill implements Directive 2014/41/EU on the European Investigation Order in criminal matters into the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, setting out how Dutch authorities recognise, execute and issue such orders. It regulates grounds for refusal, time limits, the role of the public prosecutor and investigating judge, and specific investigative measures such as video hearings, transfer of detainees, telecommunications interception and controlled delivery.
34611.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and the set-aside of Dutch proportionality review by the mutual recognition principle and the need for swift execution under the Directive.
q: This follows from the principle of mutual recognition on which the Directive is based, and more generally the principle of trust that governs how legal assistance is provided.
Dit vloeit voort uit het beginsel van wederzijdse erkenning waarop de richtlijn is gebaseerd, en meer in het algemeen het vertrouwensbeginsel dat de wijze waarop rechtshulp wordt verleend bepaalt
d: detailed rules on issuing, recognising and executing European investigation orders
rules on collecting and providing data on execution of the title's provisions
p: Allows the public prosecutor to apply a different investigative power than requested and sets aside Dutch proportionality and investigative-interest requirements when executing foreign orders.
Allows evidence to be provisionally transferred to the issuing authority before a complaint is decided, with a judicial complaint procedure as safeguard.
Lets the public prosecutor postpone execution of an order on investigative-interest grounds, with notice to the issuing authority.

parties: Asks how far the duty of judicial authorities to check whether the order meets conditions and grounds for refusal extends, and whether the directive's shift to mutual recognition removes discretion.
Worries that the executing state's prosecutor can only ask for clarification and cannot review proportionality, so evidently disproportionate orders must still be executed.

Do these members understand correctly that the public prosecutor can at most ask for clarification, but that even in case of evident disproportionality in his view, the EIO must still be complied with?

Begrijpen deze leden het goed dat de officier van justitie hooguit om opheldering kan vragen, maar dat ook bij naar zijn mening gebleken evidente disproportionaliteit toch gevolg moet worden gegeven aan het EOB?

Criticises the absence of a prior judicial authorisation procedure and of proportionality as a refusal ground, questioning whether the short deadlines outweigh legal protection and whether mutual trust holds given rule-of-law concerns in some member states.
Then is the deadline not simply set far too tightly?
Is dan de termijn niet gewoon veel te krap vastgesteld?

Objects to the mandatory wording of refusal grounds where the directive allows discretion, the proposed notification and complaint procedure replacing the authorisation procedure, and doubts about trust in authorities of some member states.
Together with the College of Procurators-General, these members are of the view that choosing the 'may' provision is most obvious for all the listed refusal grounds.
Met het college van procureurs-generaal zijn deze leden van mening dat een keuze voor de «kan»-bepaling het meest voor de hand ligt bij alle genoemde weigeringsgronden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill implementing the EU Directive on the European Investigation Order in criminal matters, raising concerns about dropping the judicial leave procedure, provisional transfer of evidence, proportionality review, and several drafting points. The government's nader rapport responds to each point, largely adopting the advice on provisional transfer and the criteria for investigative measures while defending dropping the leave procedure and the proportionality approach.
concerns: Dropping the judicial leave procedure weakens legal protection where notification is withheld for secrecy, which the government defends by pointing to mutual trust and the availability of remedies under Article 13 ECHR.

Provisional transfer of evidence needed clearer criteria and a clearer rule on use as evidence, which the government adopted by adding the directive's wording and an explicit ban where serious irreversible harm would result.

The Afdeling questioned the primacy of proportionality review in the issuing state and its link to Dutch police-data rules, which the government rejected as the directive deliberately places proportionality with the issuing authority.
Several wording, terminology and transposition-table corrections were requested and largely adopted in the redactional annex.

34620-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statement of the States General (Staten-Generaal, Part IIA) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations in thousands of euros and setting an effective date of 1 December 2016. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2016
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2016

34710.s: The bill implements the 2007 Nairobi International Convention on the Removal of Wrecks in Dutch Caribbean public law by amending the Wet maritiem beheer BES and Book 8 of the Civil Code BES, and repeals the Wet opruiming van schepen en wrakken BES. It gives the minister and the harbour manager new powers to locate, mark and remove wrecks, order owners to remove them, and recover costs, with the minister empowered to set conditions and step in directly.
34710.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement the Nairobi Convention, which obliges coastal states to ensure prompt and adequate wreck removal and to act against hazardous ships.
q: This convention improves the possibilities for coastal states to ensure that wrecks of sea-going ships are removed quickly and adequately.
Dit verdrag verbetert de mogelijkheden voor kuststaten om te bewerkstelligen dat wrakken van zeeschepen snel en adequaat worden verwijderd.
d: content and manner of wreck incident reporting
removal conditions set by minister by decision for owner
harbour manager may sell salvaged property if claimants fail to pay
p: Harbour manager may move a ship to a designated place at the owner's cost, bypassing owner consent except after a written order and failure to comply, or in urgent cases or unknown owner situations.
Harbour manager may impose binding measures on the master or ship operator to prevent or end danger, damage or nuisance.
Harbour manager may remove wrecks and other objects in territorial waters without liability to interested parties for resulting damage, and may sell salvaged goods after a deadline.

Minister may declare a wreck hazardous, set removal deadlines, step in and remove the wreck at owner's expense, including immediate action without prior notice to the registered owner where urgency requires.
ARTIKEL I, U/V (art. 80, 81) and ARTIKEL I, Q (art. 51a)
Enforcement powers of supervisory officials are extended to the new wreck removal measures and penalty ceilings are raised.
Removes the words on the possibility of objecting against a detention or holding order, narrowing a remedy against enforcement measures.

parties: Asks whether ILT enforcement capacity on the BES islands is sufficient and how the reporting, wreck-removal and insurance obligations will be enforced, and asks the government to clarify cost-recovery and the liability position when owners are dead, untraceable or uninsured.
Can the government address the capacity of supervision and enforcement on the BES islands? Is it sufficient?
Kan de regering ingaan op de capaciteit van toezicht- en handhaving op de BES-eilanden? Is deze voldoende?
Welcomes the bill and has no further questions or comments.
They have no further questions or comments.
Zij hebben geen nadere vragen of opmerkingen.

34800.s: The bill amends Article 11 of the Wet strategische diensten so that breaches of several articles of the amended EU anti-torture regulation 1236/2005 are criminal offences. It implements the 2016 EU amendment that extends controls to intermediary services, technical assistance and certain advertising sales.
q: Article 11 It is prohibited to act in breach of the articles: a. 3(1) and 4(1) of regulation 1236/2005 insofar as it concerns providing technical assistance
Artikel 11 Het is verboden te handelen in strijd met de artikelen: a. 3, eerste lid, en 4, eerste lid, van verordening 1236/2005 voor zover het betreft het verlenen van technische bijstand

parties: Asks whether the brokering ban could lead to insufficient information to justify a ban and whether a licensing requirement would have been more careful.

asks the government whether and to what extent the ban on brokering services for goods in Annex II could lead to a situation where insufficient information is available to justify a ban, and whether a licensing requirement might have been more careful.

vragen de regering of en in hoeverre het verbod op tussenhandeldiensten voor goederen in bijlage II kan leiden tot een situatie waarin onvoldoende informatie voorhanden is om een verbod te rechtvaardigen
Asks how enforcement of the brokering controls, the training ban and the technical assistance licensing will work, and whether the Dutch licensing system must be adjusted.
asks the government how this ban will be enforced.
vragen aan de regering hoe dit verbod gecontroleerd zal worden.
Asks why the anaesthetic products in Annex III bis were not covered by the execution-related ban and whether internal company documentation is sufficient to enforce global licences.
According to the government, is recording internal company documents of work processes a sufficient instrument for enforcing compliance with the global licence?
Is volgens de regering het vastleggen van bedrijfsinterne documenten van werkprocessen een voldoende instrument ter handhaving van de naleving van de globale vergunning?
Supports the broad reach of the regulation but asks who enforces it, what penalties apply, how licence holders are monitored, and why ancillary services are excluded.
However, the SP members ask who carries out the control and what penalties apply to a violation.
Wel vragen de leden van de SP-fractie zich af door wie de controle wordt uitgevoerd en welke straffen er staan op een overtreding.

34845-J.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund), the second supplementary budget, changing appropriations and expenditures across articles for water safety, freshwater supply, maintenance and experiments. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force rules.
34845-J.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reallocations flowing from the coalition agreement, not by any delegation of power.
q: This follows from the policy reallocations arising from the coalition agreement.
Dit naar aanleiding van de beleidsherverkavelingen die voortvloeien uit het Regeerakkoord.

35007.s: The bill changes the interest-rate benchmark for student loans: the rate on the levenlanglerenkrediet is set annually by the Minister as the average effective yield on a five-year Dutch state bond, with a floor at zero, and the lending period is extended from 5 to 10 years. A transitional clause keeps the old rules for students already enrolled.
35007.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the change by the goal of improving the sustainability of public finances and notes the government deliberately encourages borrowing.
q: The goal is to improve the sustainability of public finances.
Het doel is de verbetering van de houdbaarheid van de overheidsfinanciën.
p: The Minister sets the annual interest rate on student loans using a formula fixed in the statute, leaving the resulting rate to ministerial determination within a defined benchmark.

parties: Asks for quantified estimates of the current and expected interest subsidy and of how many students will lack capacity to repay.
The VVD members ask whether the government can provide a quantified basis for the current interest subsidy to students and the expected interest subsidy under the proposed bill.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering een cijfermatige onderbouwing kan geven van de huidige rentesubsidie van de overheid aan de student en de verwachte rentesubsidie zoals in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld.
Recognises the coalition agreement commitment and asks about how students can learn current interest rates and about the handling of debts of foreign students.
They recognise in the bill the agreement from the coalition agreement and have a few further questions.
Zij herkennen in het wetsvoorstel de afspraak uit het regeerakkoord en hebben nog enkele vragen.
Questions the justification of the 5-year versus 10-year rate and the accuracy of linking student loans to the overall national debt, asking for clearer rationale and scenarios.
These members read that when the interest benchmark changes, the rate is fixed for 5 years in the year after graduation based on the rate of government bonds with a remaining term of 10 years.

Genoemde leden lezen dat bij wijziging van de rentemaatstaf in het jaar na afstuderen het rentepercentage wordt vastgezet voor 5 jaar op basis van het rentepercentage van staatsobligaties met een resterende looptijd van 10 jaar.
Questions the claimed fiscal unsustainability and asks for independent substantiation, projections of revenues and the effect on students with limited means.
That raises the question of whether the government can explain how the current interest benchmark makes the student finance system financially unsustainable.
Dat roept de vraag op of de regering kan toelichten hoe de huidige rentemaatstaf het studiefinancieringsstelsel financieel onhoudbaar maakt.
Argues the change may violate legal certainty (rechtszekerheidsbeginsel) for students already in debt, especially mbo students moving to hbo, and asks for a response.
The members believe that in that case there is a violation of the legal certainty principle and, further, point in this context to rulings of the Supreme Court in the Harmonisation Act (1986).

De leden menen dat er in dat geval sprake is van schending van het rechtszekerheidsbeginsel, en wijzen ten overvloede in dit kader op uitspraken hierover van de Hoge Raad in het kader van de Harmonisatiewet (1986).
Argues the rate change undermines trust and the earlier tuition discount, calls for reconsideration and asks why the government did not use the year to drop the plan.
These members ask why this government did not use the year to listen to the comments and objections to this plan and to refrain from it.
Deze leden vragen zich af waarom deze regering het jaar niet gebruikt heeft om te luisteren naar de commentaren en bezwaren tegen dit voornemen en om hiervan af te zien.
Understands the measure but worries about long-lasting debt impact on young people and asks for a debt-prevention approach, involvement of student organisations and monitoring.
These members consider it very important that the effect of the proposed measure be monitored.
Deze leden vinden het van groot belang dat gemonitord wordt wat het effect van de voorgestelde maatregel is.
Opposes the higher rate as making higher education less accessible and contrary to debt reduction, and wants the loan system abolished.
Studying becomes less attractive because of this government proposal, especially for people with a limited budget.
Studeren wordt door dit voorstel van de regering minder aantrekkelijk, zeker voor mensen met een beperkt budget.
Sees the package of student finance measures as contradictory and asks why the complex exercise is undertaken and whether a 4 percent rate would be acceptable.
What is given with one hand is immediately taken back with the other.
Wat met de ene hand is gegeven, wordt met de andere hand meteen weer genomen.
Asks for clarification of how interest costs on student debt can be determined given the government does not distinguish debt types, and for historical rate data and worked examples.
Furthermore, these members ask whether one can speak of an interest subsidy at all if it is not exactly clear at which rates the government itself borrows the costs of providing student loans.

Voorts vragen deze leden zich af of er überhaupt wel gesproken kan worden van rentesubsidie als niet exact duidelijk is tegen welke rentes de overheid de kosten voor het verstrekken van studieleningen zelf leent.

35016.s: The bill creates a one-off legal mechanism to allocate additional European Parliament seats to the Netherlands if the UK leaves the EU during the 2019–2024 term, specifying how the central electoral board assigns those seats to lists and candidates. It also excludes appeal against the central board's allocation decision and lapses on 1 September 2024.
35016.j: The memorandum justifies the exclusion of appeal by analogy with existing Kieswet rules that already bar appeal against similar electoral determinations.
q: Article 8:4(4)(a) of the General Administrative Law Act provides that no appeal is possible against a large number of decisions under the Electoral Act.
In artikel 8:4, vierde lid, aanhef en onderdeel a, van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht is bepaald dat geen beroep mogelijk is tegen een groot aantal besluiten op grond van de Kieswet
d: determination of date and allocation of extra seats by central electoral board
entry into force date set by royal decree, varying by article
p: Excludes administrative appeal against the central electoral board's determination of which lists and candidates receive the extra seats, limiting citizens' legal protection.

parties: Asks the government to justify the choice of how the extra seats are allocated, given that the quota differs from the 2009 approach.
The VVD members ask the government to further justify the choice for the allocation of the extra seats.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering de keuze voor de verdeling van de extra zetels nader te motiveren.
Asks how a list can reach the old quota but not the new one, given that the new quota is lower when seats increase.
How can a list in the same election reach the old quota but not the new one, these members ask?
Hoe kan een lijst bij dezelfde verkiezing de oude kiesdeler wel halen en de nieuwe niet, zo vragen deze leden.
Supports the method but stresses that voters, candidates, parties and the central polling board need certainty about the rules before election day, and asks whether the rule gives enough certainty.
The members believe that voters, candidates, parties and the central polling board must have clarity about the rules of the electoral process before election day.
De leden vinden dat de kiezer, de kandidaten, de partijen en het centraal stembureau voorafgaand aan de dag van de stemming duidelijkheid moeten hebben over de spelregels van het verkiezingsproces.

Asks whether there is a final date in the term after which extra seats would no longer be allocated, how vacancies are handled, and why a separate law rather than an entry in the Kieswet is used, since seat changes may recur.

Given the nature of this arrangement, the VVD members consider this a good choice.; GroenLinks asks why a separate law was chosen rather than including the rule in the Kieswet, since changes in seat numbers may happen again.; (see GroenLinks question on separate law)
Gelet op het karakter van deze regeling achten de leden van de VVD-fractie dat een goede keuze.
Asks whether a full recalculation on the basis of 29 seats would better reflect the election result and whether the largest-remainder method could deny a seat that a recalculation would give.
Would such a calculation not do the most justice to the proportionality of the result, with all seats distributed in exactly the same way among the parties?
Zou een dergelijke berekening niet het meest recht doen aan de evenredigheid van de uitslag, waarbij álle zetels op precies dezelfde manier worden verdeeld over de partijen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the bill on possible extra European Parliament seats for the Netherlands, but asked for clarification on refunding the deposit when a list falls below 75% of the recalculated quota. The government's reply accepted the point, amended article 3 and the explanatory memorandum so the deposit is refunded unless the list stays below 75% of the new quota.
concerns: The bill and explanatory memorandum did not address whether a forfeited deposit must be refunded to a list that exceeds 75% only under the new quota, creating legal uncertainty.

35043.s: The bill replaces the Dutch Medical Devices Act to implement EU Regulations 2017/745 and 2017/746 and amends the Medical-Scientific Research with Humans Act and related laws. It grants the Minister for Medical Care rule-making, designation, emergency-measure and sanction powers, with the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth as supervisor.
35043.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and emergency powers by the need to implement the EU regulations and protect public health, and argues the Inspectorate should not receive attributed powers because of constitutional rules on ministerial organisation.
q: To implement these obligations, Article 3(1) provides that rules will be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
Om uitvoering te geven aan deze verplichtingen, is in artikel 3, eerste lid, opgenomen dat bij algemene maatregel van bestuur hieromtrent regels worden gesteld.
d: rules on implanted device information under EU Regulation 2017/745
restrictions on use of specific device types
temporary rules in urgent public health situations, lapsing after one year
language in which documents must be drafted
administrative rules implementing EU provisions on custom-made devices and UDI
further rules on reprocessing single-use devices
amounts of fees for supervisory activities
designation of competent authorities for notified bodies
emergency measures to restrict, withdraw or recall devices posing health risks
temporary basis for in-vitro diagnostics decree until 2022
p: The Minister may take emergency measures banning, restricting, withdrawing or recalling devices posing unacceptable health risks, with the regulation's conditions applying.
The Minister may impose periodic penalty payments (last onder dwangsom) to enforce a broad list of regulation and act provisions.
The Minister may impose administrative fines up to the sixth category or 10% of turnover for breaches of many provisions.
Prohibition of benefits to healthcare professionals with exceptions specified in the act.

parties: Asks whether the regulation can prevent repetition of the PIP implant scandal and how it balances safety with speedy access to innovative devices, including accreditation of notified bodies.
The balance between safety and innovation is of great importance to the members of the VVD faction.
De balans tussen veiligheid en innovatie is voor de leden van de VVD-fractie van groot belang.

Asks about the functioning, accreditation and inspection regime of notified bodies, post-market surveillance and the IGJ's directive powers, questioning the constitutional basis for attributing orders to the IGJ rather than the Minister.
The CDA members ask what motivation the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) gave in its advice to attribute the power to impose an order directly to the IGJ rather than the Minister.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen welke motivatie de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft gegeven bij haar advies om de bevoegdheid van het opleggen van een bevel direct te attribueren aan de IGJ en niet aan de Minister.
Asks whether notified bodies have sufficient independent, qualified staff, whether the current designation system was evaluated, and how clinical evidence and manufacturer liability are monitored.
They ask whether the current procedure has been evaluated and whether the tightening stems from such an evaluation.
Zij vragen of de huidige werkwijze geëvalueerd is en of de aanscherpingen voortkomen uit een dergelijke evaluatie?

Questions the independence and expertise requirements for notified bodies and expert panels, the gap in oversight before competent authorities are designated, and whether protections for trial participants are weakened, and calls for removal of exceptions to the gift ban.
How is it guaranteed that sufficient supervision is maintained so that no unsafe devices enter the market in the period before the Minister for Medical Care has designated the competent authorities?

Hoe wordt gegarandeerd dat voldoende toezicht wordt gehouden dat er geen onveilige hulpmiddelen op de markt komen in de periode dat de Minister voor Medische Zorg de bevoegde autoriteiten nog niet heeft aangewezen?
Asks whether the government can direct notified bodies to prioritise assessments in shortage situations and what emergency tools it has over their procedures.
Does the government have the possibility to give notified bodies a directive to prioritise, for example in case of insufficient assessment capacity, according to requirements set by the government?

Heeft de regering de mogelijkheid om aangemelde instanties een aanwijzing te geven om, bijvoorbeeld in het geval van onvoldoende beoordelingscapaciteit, te prioriteren volgens door de regering vastgestelde eisen
Asks how the IGJ supervises notified bodies and worries that modified products could be re-registered without adequate control.
Concerned about whether notified bodies have enough qualified staff and whether capacity shortages could stall innovation.
Are there enough notified bodies and do these bodies have sufficient qualified staff?
Zijn er voldoende aangemelde instanties en beschikken deze instanties over voldoende gekwalificeerd personeel?
Asks why the system was tightened rather than replaced by a College for assessing medical devices, and about conflicts of interest in expert panels and traceability of implants.
What arguments were there to tighten within this system instead of arriving at a College for the Assessment of Medical Devices?
Welke argumenten waren er om binnen dit systeem aan te scherpen in plaats van te komen tot een College ter Beoordeling van Medische Hulpmiddelen?

Objects that conformity assessment bodies fall outside the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, leaving government without control or accountability, and proposes an independent College for implants.
These members consider it a bad development that the government has no say over the policy conformity assessment bodies pursue and the supervision of it.
Genoemde leden vinden het een slechte ontwikkeling dat de regering geen zeggenschap heeft over het beleid dat conformiteitsbeoordelingsinstanties voeren en het toezicht daarop.
Asks whether IGJ capacity is sufficient to safeguard device quality after approval and whether citizens can easily access Eudamed data.
The 50PLUS members ask whether the capacity of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) is sufficient to safeguard the quality of medical devices after they have been approved.
De leden van de 50PLUS-fractie vragen of de capaciteit van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) voldoende is om de kwaliteit van medische hulpmiddelen te borgen nadat ze zijn toegelaten.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advises submitting the Medical Devices Act implementing EU Regulations 2017/745 and 2017/746, but asks the government to explain in the explanatory memorandum how it will handle reprocessed single-use devices imported from other member states with a milder regime, and flags incomplete transposition tables. The government's nader rapport confirms the explanatory memorandum was amended in response to the advice.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must address the risk that reprocessed devices from milder-regime member states undermine the Dutch strict regime, and discuss the national measures under Article 17(9) of the Regulation.
The transposition tables are incomplete and must indicate for all articles of the regulations whether they require implementation and how.
The sanctioning choice (criminal versus administrative) should no longer be motivated by the open and closed context criterion, in line with earlier government advice.

35061.s: The bill amends Dutch Civil Code Book 8, its Caribbean counterpart and the Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen so that liability for wreck removal claims can no longer be capped under the LLMC limitation regime. It also updates ministry names and adds transitional provisions applying the change only to maritime accidents occurring after entry into force.
35061.j: The memorandum justifies removing the liability cap on the grounds that it removes an important obstacle to recovering wreck removal costs, and it notes that the Wrakopruimingsverdrag supports public-law recovery claims by the manager.
q: However, the introduction of full liability removes an important obstacle to being able to recover more.
Wel wordt met de invoering van volledige aansprakelijkheid een belangrijke belemmering weggenomen om meer te kunnen verhalen.
d: entry into force date by royal decree

parties: The CDA asks whether Belgian reform will change the picture and whether the status quo on flag neutrality and competitiveness will be monitored and reported to parliament, without raising a check concern.
They would like to know whether that status quo will be monitored and whether changes will be reported to the Chamber.
Graag vernemen zij of die status quo wordt gemonitord en of wijzigingen aan de Kamer worden gemeld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised sending the bill limiting shipowner liability for wreck removal to parliament, but asked the explanatory memorandum to address that the Protocol to the London Convention has not been ratified for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, though the need for full owner liability is the same there. The government's reply supplemented the explanatory memorandum, noting those countries have not ratified the Protocol and must decide themselves whether to legislate.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum on the non-ratification of the Protocol by Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten was to be supplemented, and the government did so.
The need for full owner liability for wreck removal applies equally to the Caribbean countries, which the government acknowledged but left to them to legislate on.

35070.s: The bill centralises sign-language and interpreter provision for people with hearing impairments under the UWV, moves the youth and Wmo listening lines and independent youth advocacy (vertrouwenswerk) to the Minister of VWS, and amends several related laws. It creates new delegation bases for general administrative orders and ministerial regulations on interpreter scope, conditions, quality and fees, and gives UWV enforcement and fining powers.
35070.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to general administrative orders as keeping rights fixed in statute while allowing flexibility in implementation, and assigns UWV because of its expertise and regulation-bound administration.
q: This means there is clarity and stability about the rights of people with hearing impairments because these rights are laid down at statutory level, while flexibility in implementation is maintained by regulating this by or under a general administrative order.

Dit betekent dat er duidelijkheid en bestendigheid is over de rechten van auditief beperkten doordat deze rechten zijn vastgelegd op wetsniveau, maar dat flexibiliteit in de uitvoering behouden blijft door dit bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen.
d: scope, content, conditions and quality of interpreter provision
rules on interpreter allowance, scope and quality
Jeugdwet Art. 2.5 lid 2 and 4.1.9 lid 2 (amvb delegation to set obligations for vertrouwenspersonen)
obligations of municipalities and providers toward youth advocates
rules on Veilig Thuis obligations toward advocates
p: Participatiewet Art. 10g lid 5 and Wmo 2015 Art. 3a.1 lid 5
UWV may refuse interpreter allowances after prior decisions on incorrect information, non-compliance or misuse, and may refuse where other schemes cover the need.
UWV-appointed officials gain inspection powers over records and UWV may impose orders under administrative coercion or penalty payments to enforce rules on interpreter provision.
Participatiewet Art. 10g lid 4 and Wmo 2015 Art. 3a.1 lid 4
Title 4.2 of the Awb (general administrative procedure chapter) is disapplied for interpreter provision, though several Wajong/WIA rules are applied by reference and UWV decisions remain appealable.
Inspectorate supervision of the Minister's listening-line and youth advocacy tasks is excluded to avoid the minister supervising his own performance.
Wmo 2015 Art. 4.2.6 and Jeugdwet Art. 1a.1 and 1a.2
Youth advocacy and related data processing, including health and criminal data without consent, are authorised for advocates in support of clients.

parties: Asks when and by whom invoices for interpreter services are checked and how misuse and fraud are prevented.
These members ask the government when and by whom checks take place on submitted invoices.
Deze leden vragen de regering wanneer en door wie controle plaatsvindt van de ingediende factuur.
Asks how the national scheme relates to local Wmo ordinances and decisions and whether the UWV's knowledge gap is a problem.
These members ask how this national scheme will relate to local Wmo ordinances and Wmo decisions.
Genoemde leden vragen hoe deze landelijke regeling zich zal gaan verhouden tot de lokale Wmo-verordeningen en Wmo-besluiten.
Supports centralisation but asks how the government will mediate if UWV does not properly handle improvement proposals from interest groups.
Asks whether the government will align the four different laws and application processes now that one body executes them.
They ask the government whether it, or the UWV, intends to take steps to align the laws and application processes.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering of zij – dan wel het UWV – voornemens is om hier stappen in te zetten.
Criticises UWV's structural shortcomings, asks whether lower regulation (AMvB) will be submitted to the House, and questions reliance on commercial external providers.
Will the elaboration of lower-level regulation be submitted to the House in due course?
Wordt de uitwerking van lagere regelgeving te zijner tijd aan de Kamer voorgelegd?

35124.s: The bill amends the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg to create a register of quality standards and measurement instruments held by the Zorginstituut, and to give the Minister of Health power to withhold consent before a quality standard with substantial financial consequences for collective care spending is entered in the register. It also limits professional standards with such consequences from binding providers unless they are formalised as quality standards, and makes related changes to the Zorgverzekeringswet, Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg, Algemene wet bestuursrecht and Burgerlijk Wetboek.
35124.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial consent power as necessary for financial control of collective care spending, to prevent unwanted cost increases and crowding out of other public expenditure.
q: From the perspective of financial control, it is therefore desirable to introduce a power for the Minister of VWS to grant or withhold consent to the Zorginstituut to decide to include a quality standard with substantial financial consequences for collective (care) spending in the Register.

Vanuit het oogpunt van financiële beheersing is het daarom gewenst een bevoegdheid voor de Minister van VWS te introduceren om het Zorginstituut al dan niet toestemming te geven om te besluiten een kwaliteitsstandaard met substantiële financiële gevolgen voor de collectieve (zorg)uitgaven op te nemen in het Register.
d: further rules on applying the financial-consequences criteria for professional standards
p: The Minister may refuse consent to enter a quality standard with expected cost increases in the register, a decision explained as a political weighing outside professional judgement, with only a Kamer control reference as safeguard.
The Minister may, within three months, annul a register entry the Zorginstituut made without submitting it, with appeal to the Raad van State available.
Professional standards with substantial financial consequences cease to bind providers unless formalised, and the Inspectie will not enforce them, reducing patients' ability to enforce them.

parties: Asks how the ministerial power relates to insurers' existing role and whether the Minister of Finance has a role, and requests the draft general administrative order be shared with parliament.
Does the Minister of Finance also have a role in defining and assessing the substantial financial consequences of a quality standard?
Heeft de Minister van Financiën ook een rol in het definiëren en beoordelen van substantiële financiële gevolgen van een kwaliteitsstandaard?
Worries the Minister gains too much power to decide on care quality alone and that parliament cannot influence the decision.
Does the Minister of VWS not get far too much power with this new authority?
Krijgt de Minister van VWS met deze nieuwe bevoegdheid niet veel te veel macht in handen?
Questions the criteria and the lack of a financial threshold, the Minister's weighing method, and why parliament only receives information rather than a prior consultation.
Why was it not chosen to submit the intended cabinet decision to the House beforehand (a voorhang)?
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen het voorgenomen besluit van de ministerraad aan de Kamer voor te leggen (een voorhang)?
Supports parliament and the minister being able to weigh in on costs, but wants safeguards so professional medical autonomy is not restricted by ministerial influence.
These members believe financial faits accomplis such as occurred after the entry of the Quality Standard for Nursing Home Care in the Register must be prevented in future.

Genoemde leden zijn van mening dat financiële fait accomplis zoals die zich voordeden na het opnemen in het Register van de Kwaliteitsstandaard Verpleeghuiszorg in de toekomst voorkomen moeten worden.
Objects to ministerial influence on professional standards, notably over staffing norms, and questions the composition of the Adviescommissie Kwaliteit and the Zorginstituut's override power.
Asks how the parliament's supervisory role relates to its budget right given that parliament had no role in allocating the 2.1 billion for nursing home care.
These members ask the government to explain further how this role of parliament relates to the House's budget right.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering nader in te gaan hoe deze rol van het parlement zich verhoudt tot het budgetrecht van de Kamer.

Supports the goal of political influence over rising costs but asks whether the power is proportional, what the difference is between financial and substantive review, and what parliament's precise role is.
These members wonder what the principled difference is between a financial and a substantive review.
Genoemde leden vragen zich af wat het principiële verschil is tussen een financiële en een inhoudelijke toetsing.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill letting the Minister of VWS financially review proposed quality standards in healthcare, supporting cost control but raising concerns about alternatives, the role of Zorginstituut, curative care, medical freedom and oversight. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adapting the bill (e.g., narrowed risk criteria, clarified Zvw scope, legal basis for pseudonymised data) but keeps the Zvw inclusion.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that alternative cost-control measures and their consequences be weighed and that the Staten-Generaal be informed; the government adds clarifications but argues budgeting instruments offer no real alternative.

The Afdeling asks that the objective criteria for referral to the Minister be tightened so that only exceptional standards reach the Minister; the government narrows the criteria to ingrijpende financial investments but keeps them largely as they were.

The Afdeling advises reconsidering application of the bill to curative care under the Zvw because it shifts responsibility from sector parties to the Minister; the government disagrees and keeps the Zvw scope.
The Afdeling asks that the effect of the financial review on freedom of medical practice be explained; the government adds explanation to the memorie van toelichting.
The Afdeling asks for consequences for the private sector to be reconsidered; the government clarifies that private-only standards are outside the scope and amends the text accordingly.
The Afdeling asks to clarify the meaning of zorgaanbieder and the scope of responsibilities; the government explains the distinction and clarifies the text.
The Afdeling asks for an explicit legal basis for processing pseudonymised personal data by the Zorginstituut; the government adds a new article.

35133.s: The bill adds rules on expropriation, a pre-emptive right (voorkeursrecht), land consolidation (landinrichting) and cost recovery to the Environment and Planning Act (Omgevingswet). It shifts expropriation decisions from the Crown to municipal councils, water boards, provincial states and ministers, while adding a court confirmation procedure and a civil-court compensation process.
35133.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded powers by the need to pursue environmental and spatial goals, the constitutional allowance for expropriation in the public interest, and the principle that whoever has a task should have the powers to carry it out.
q: For the expropriation instrument, municipal councils, water board general boards, provincial states and the responsible ministers are given by this bill the power to decide on expropriation themselves.

Bij het instrument onteigening krijgen gemeenteraden, algemeen besturen van waterschappen, provinciale staten en de verantwoordelijke ministers met dit wetsvoorstel de bevoegdheid om zelf tot onteigening te besluiten.
d: rules on land consolidation activities and rules on fixing land-allocation content
detailed rules on kavels and rights in land-consolidation ruling and equal quality/use function
further rules on equal quality and use function of allocated land
p: Expropriation decisions move from the Crown to municipal councils, water boards, provincial states and ministers, with criteria of provincial/national interest or expedience.
Municipalities, provinces and the state may establish pre-emptive rights restricting sale of property tied to designated functions, limited in duration.
Owners must tolerate entry, surveys, excavation and construction work for land consolidation and expropriation preparation.
Expropriation requires court confirmation and compensation determined by civil court, and reversal rights apply if the purpose is not realized.

parties: Asks whether the expropriation and pre-emption regime, including the new grounds and the 12-month expropriation timing, keeps legal protection of owners at least equal to the current law.
The VVD members ask the government, mindful of the Veldman and Ronnes motion, to again address the level of protection in expropriation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering, indachtig de motie Veldman en Ronnes, nog eens in te gaan op het beschermingsniveau bij onteigening.

Worries that allowing the self-realisation exception to pre-emption rights undermines municipalities' regulatory role and enables speculation; questions the appeal routes and the expropriation notification gap.
The CDA members believe that in this way municipalities are deprived of an instrument to speed up housing construction and act against owners acting against the public interest.
Deze leden menen dat op die wijze de gemeenten een instrument uit handen wordt genomen om woningbouw te versnellen en op te treden tegen eigenaren die handelen tegen het maatschappelijk belang.
Welcomes the broader administrative room for manoeuvre and faster decision-making, while asking whether public cost-sharing and compulsory land development can be arranged.
The D66 members also note with satisfaction that this supplementary act aims to increase administrative discretion and speed up decision-making in the physical living environment.

Daarnaast constateren deze leden tevreden dat er met deze aanvullingswet toe wordt gezien op het vergroten van bestuurlijke afwegingsruimte en het versnellen van besluitvorming in de fysieke leefomgeving.

Concerned that market parties capture rising land value and that municipalities lack counterweights; criticises the self-realisation exception and asks for sanctions or a development obligation and value capture.
The PvdA members are very concerned that market parties are increasingly capturing a growing share of land value increases, while it becomes ever harder for municipalities to counterbalance this.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie maken zich grote zorgen over de ontwikkeling dat marktpartijen een steeds groter deel van de waardestijging van grond naar zich toe weten te trekken, terwijl het voor gemeenten steeds lastiger wordt om daar tegenwicht aan te bieden.
Asks about the lack of sanctions when owners invoke self-realisation without building, the cost-recovery afrekening timing, and legal protection in cost-recovery disputes.
Asks why the Raad van State's advice on single-instance review and full judicial review of expropriation decisions was not adopted, stressing that property is a fundamental right.
These members also wish to point out that the expropriating public bodies may also be parties on the land market and hold land positions.
Deze leden willen er ook op wijzen dat de onteigenende overheidsorganen ook partijen op de grondmarkt kunnen zijn en grondposities hebben.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Aanvullingswet grondeigendom Omgevingswet, raising major objections to two-instance review of expropriation decisions, the absence of a legal test standard and of derdenbenoeming in expropriation, the decentralised cost-recovery calculation system, and the absence of an independent evaluation clause. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the points on evaluation, landinrichting, and wording, partly adapts cost recovery with added safeguards, and rejects the call to fix the judicial test standard in law and rejects the reinstatement of derdenbenoeming while accepting the Afdeling's concern on single-instance review as reconsidered and kept in two instances.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that expropriation without the owner's knowledge is unacceptable given the fundamental nature of property rights and asked to reinstate service of the summons and derdenbenoeming; the government kept the absence of service on in-person judgments but accepted the principle and defended it as exceptional.
The Afdeling advised fixing in law the intensified judicial test of expropriation decisions; the government declined to codify the test standard, leaving it to the court.
The Afdeling advised reconsidering two-instance review against expropriation decisions; the government reconsidered and kept two-instance review.

The Afdeling found the decentralised cost-recovery calculation system insufficiently justified and burdensome for municipalities; the government reworked the scheme with statutory safeguards and a split between integral and organic area development.
The Afdeling asked that the defence ministry's consent requirement for landinrichting be retained; the government amended the provision accordingly.
The Afdeling asked that the scope of persons able to file objections against an expropriation decision be defined expressly; the government clarified article 16.97.

The Afdeling requested an independent evaluation clause with specific evaluation questions; the government referred to the Omgevingswet-wide evaluation approach and extended the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling raised redactional points; most were adopted, while a few suggestions were not adopted with reasons given.

35151.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (supplementary budget, IV) by changing appropriations for rule of law, socio-economic structure, debt management and loans, reconstruction of the Windward Islands, and administration. It effects the budget changes in thousands of euros and enters into force on 26 February 2019 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of Kingdom Relations for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35160.s: The bill amends article 323a of the Dutch Criminal Code to extend the limitation period from three to four years, implementing EU Directive 2017/1371 on criminal law protection of the Union's financial interests. The memorandum explains that the directive also requires extending jurisdiction under the active personality principle without double criminality, to be done later by general administrative order.
35160.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as required implementation of the EU directive and the European Public Prosecutor's competence, not as a new executive power.
q: In article 323a of the Criminal Code, 'three years' is replaced by 'four years'.
In artikel 323a van het Wetboek van Strafrecht wordt «drie jaren» vervangen door «vier jaren».
d: entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks whether convictions under Article 323a Sr have occurred and what sentences were imposed, with no check-related concern raised.
Have convictions been handed down in the Netherlands under Article 323a of the Criminal Code, the article being amended by the bill?
Zijn in Nederland veroordelingen uitgesproken op grond van artikel 323a Wetboek van Strafrecht (Sr), het artikel dat met het wetsvoorstel wordt gewijzigd?
Satisfied that Dutch law complies with the directive and has no further questions.
These members are satisfied that Dutch legislation complies with the directive and therefore have no further questions about this bill.
Deze leden zijn tevreden met het voldoen van de Nederlandse wetgeving aan de richtlijn en hebben dan ook verder geen vragen over onderhavig wetsvoorstel.
Asks for controlled delegation so parliament can review the amendment to the extraterritorial jurisdiction decree before it is adopted, avoiding irreversible steps.
Is the government further willing, before adopting this amendment, to submit it to the House of Representatives through controlled delegation and to take no irreversible steps beforehand?
Is de regering voorts bereid, alvorens deze wijziging vast te stellen, deze door middel van gecontroleerde delegatie te overleggen aan de Tweede Kamer en voordien geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen?
Asks whether dropping dual criminality could oblige the Netherlands to cooperate in prosecutions for conduct not criminal in the Netherlands, and how this fits the legality principle.
Can dropping the dual criminality requirement mean the Netherlands will have to cooperate in prosecutions for conduct not made criminal in the Netherlands?
Kan het loslaten van het vereiste van dubbele strafbaarheid ertoe leiden dat Nederland zal moeten meewerken aan strafprocedures voor gedragingen die niet in Nederland strafbaar zijn gesteld?

35200-X.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence and the budget statements for the defence agencies DTO and Paresto, adjusting appropriations and realised figures to the final accounts. It contains technical and bookkeeping adjustments and sets the amounts in thousands of euros, taking effect the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December 2018.
q: This bill contains technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

35223.s: The bill slows the planned stepwise increase of the AOW (state old-age pension) age so that it reaches 67 only in 2024, fixing the intermediate ages by law. It makes consequential amendments to the wage tax act, the pension-age act, the 2015 amending act and the wage-domain compensation act.
35223.j: The memorandum justifies the temporised schedule as a reasonable transition period given early publication, and notes the change does not impose a disproportionate individual burden, so no special transitional rules are needed.
q: Therefore the aim is a reasonable transition period through timely publication.
Daarom wordt ingezet op een redelijke overgangstermijn door middel van een tijdige bekendmaking.

parties: Questions the government on when the investment programme for sustainable employability will be made concrete, following the Council of State's criticism.
By what time does the government expect to give a more concrete form to the investment programme?
Op welke termijn verwacht de regering een concretere invulling te geven aan het investeringsprogramma?
Questions the rationale, scope and financing of the bill and asks why a structural solution was not chosen, challenging the government's justification.
Welcomes the bill but asks how people disadvantaged by the earlier AOW age and the timing of notification by the SVB can protect their position and whether measures will mitigate harm.
Has the government considered taking measures for this group to limit the disadvantage?
Heeft de regering overwogen om maatregelen te nemen voor deze groep om het nadeel te beperken?
Asks the government to respond to the Council of State's advice that policy on sustainable employability is at an early stage and that its success is not assured.
These members ask how the government views the Council of State's remark that the stated intentions are still largely in their infancy and that their success is not assured in advance.
Deze leden vragen hoe de regering kijkt naar de opmerking van de Raad van State dat de genoemde voornemens nog veelal in de kinderschoenen staan en dat succes daarvan niet bij voorbaat verzekerd is.
Asks whether the government accepts the Council of State's view that it must take responsibility for sustainable employability and what concrete steps it will take if social partners fail.
Does the government share the Council of State's analysis that it must take responsibility?
Deelt de regering de analyse van de Raad van State dat zij verantwoordelijkheid moet nemen?
Criticises the choice of a two-year freeze instead of freezing at 66 and asks why the act does not provide for a lower AOW age if life expectancy falls.
Why does the act not provide that when life expectancy falls, the AOW age also falls?
Waarom is er in de wet niet geregeld dat wanneer de levensverwachting daalt, de AOW-leeftijd ook daalt?
Asks how large the group disadvantaged by the bill is and how large the financial harm is, questioning the claim that no disproportionate burden arises.
Can the government indicate how large the group is that is disadvantaged by the bill and how large (in financial terms) this disadvantage is?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe groot de groep is die door het wetsvoorstel wordt benadeeld en hoe groot (in financiële zin) deze benadeling is?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill temporarily freezing and slowing the AOW pension age increase for 2020-2024, as part of a broader pensions agreement, raising concerns about the broad scope of collective spending, the risk of the measure becoming structural, the lack of concrete sustainable employability policy, and incomplete financing. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the need for sustainable employability policy, adds a 800 million euro budget and 10 million per year programme, supplements the explanatory memorandum on transition periods, and completes the financing picture.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that announced sustainable employability measures will effectively prevent the temporary measure from becoming structural, and asks for more concrete policy; the government adds an investment programme and budget but largely relies on agreements with social partners.

The Afdeling notes that the measure may disadvantage some groups and that the explanatory memorandum does not address the risk of renewed feelings of being overtaken, including under the property protection clause; the government adds information on transition periods and individual notification.

The Afdeling asks for quantitative and qualitative insight into the group facing problems reaching the AOW age and the budgetary impact; the government supplements the explanatory memorandum on these points.
The Afdeling asks for full insight into the financing of the measure; the government adds the financing breakdown, including the split between burdens on citizens and businesses.

35241.s: The bill amends the Dutch corporate income tax act, income tax act and dividend tax act to implement EU Directive 2017/952 on hybrid mismatches with third countries, adding anti-hybrid rules, reverse hybrid treatment and documentation obligations. It also makes consequential numbering changes to the income tax and dividend tax acts and sets effective dates of 1 January 2020 and 1 January 2022.
35241.j: The memorandum justifies the documentation obligation and the ministerial-regulation delegation as needed for the Tax Authority's effective supervision and for practical guidance if the implementation practice requires it.
q: Finally, it is proposed that further rules on the documentation obligation may be set by ministerial regulation.
Tot slot wordt voorgesteld dat bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels kunnen worden gesteld ten aanzien van de documentatieverplichting.
d: Artikel I, C (art. 12ag, lid 3 Wet Vpb 1969)
further rules on documentation of hybrid mismatch cases
p: The inspector may ask taxpayers to demonstrate that the anti-hybrid rules do not apply, shifting the burden of proof onto taxpayers, and further documentation rules may be set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Worries the bill is too complex, its effects uncertain and disproportionate for business and SMEs, and asks why no proportionate counter-evidence rule is included.
The bill has major consequences for tens of thousands of jobs and leads to disproportionate burdens for business, especially SMEs.
Het wetsvoorstel heeft grote gevolgen voor tienduizenden banen, leidt tot te grote niet proportionele lasten voor het bedrijfsleven en met name het mkb.

Supports ending the constructions but objects that the documentation obligation covers all foreign transactions and imposes a near-impossible burden of proof on almost all firms, including small ones.
These members are worried about the documentation obligation, which covers all foreign transactions and places an almost impossible burden of proof on nearly all companies, including small ones.

Deze leden maken zich wel zorgen over de documentatieverplichting die Nederland naast het implementeren van de richtlijn invoert, aangezien deze alle buitenlandse transacties omvat en een haast onmogelijke bewijslast bij bijna alle bedrijven, waaronder ook kleine bedrijven, neerlegt.
Supports tackling avoidance but asks about other Member States' implementation, future-proofing, and whether the government will evaluate the bill.
The D66 members ask whether the government intends to evaluate this bill.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de regering voornemens is om dit wetsvoorstel te evalueren.

Asks about the government's goals, whether it would address root causes such as differences between tax systems, and whether it would pursue international harmonisation, and notes the bill leaves gaps and possible revenue leakage.
Is the government willing to address not only the consequences of hybrid mismatches but also the cause, namely differences between tax systems?
Is de regering bereid om niet alleen de gevolgen van hybride mismatches aan te pakken maar ook de oorzaak, namelijk verschillen tussen belastingstelsels?
Welcomes the directive and the documentation obligation but asks about the effects of the earlier ATAD1 measure on housing corporations and why partnerships become taxable only later.
The SP members are satisfied with the documentation obligation introduced to check whether payments abroad involve a hybrid mismatch.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn tevreden met de documentatieverplichting die wordt ingevoerd om te kijken of er bij betalingen aan het buitenland sprake is van een hybride mismatch.
Strongly supports the bill as an important step against tax avoidance and urges the government to keep closing avoidance routes quickly.
The PvdA members therefore ask the government to remain sharply focused on this and to close those routes as quickly as possible where necessary.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering dan ook hier scherp op te blijven, en waar nodig zo snel mogelijk die routes dicht te schroeien.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill implementing the second EU anti-tax avoidance directive (ATAD2) on hybrid mismatches with third countries, raising concerns about the government's unexplained choice not to use the optional exemption for bank instruments and about the summary treatment of internet consultation responses. The Staatssecretaris of Finance replied in a nader rapport, adding the requested motivation and expanding the consultation chapter, with several changes made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.
