concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification for not using the ATAD2 option to exempt certain bank intragroup instruments that avoid unintended results; the government added the motivation to the explanatory memorandum and nader rapport.

The Afdeling asked for a more extensive account of internet consultation responses and their effects on the bill; the government expanded the consultation chapter and made changes such as adding a collective investment vehicle exemption and a statutory ranking rule.
The Afdeling made redactional comments, including a missing second paragraph in the proposed article 12ac, which the government addressed.

35250.s: The bill establishes the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen, an independent administrative body that assesses and pays compensation for earthquake-related subsidence damage from Groningen gas extraction and the Norg gas storage, with the state taking over claims against the operator. It is funded by a levy on the operator, routes appeals to the Rechtbank Noord-Nederland, and allows prejudicial questions to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak.
35250.j: The memorandum justifies the new independent body by the failure of earlier arrangements, the operator's unequal position, the need for a statutory basis, and the goal of faster and more consistent case handling.
q: The Instituut performs its tasks and powers independently.
Het Instituut vervult zijn taken en bevoegdheden in onafhankelijkheid.
d: additional tasks assigned to the Instituut
rules on form of information exchange between Instituut and operator
procedure for appointment, suspension and dismissal of members
additional requirements for the annual report
height of the levy on the operator
p: Claims are moved from the civil courts to an administrative body under ministerial responsibility, with appeal to the administrative courts and an independence guarantee for the Instituut.
Members are appointed, suspended and dismissed by royal decree on the minister's proposal, departing from the normal framework law for independent bodies.
The minister's power to annul Instituut decisions and to issue policy rules on its tasks is excluded, leaving individual decisions to the courts.
The district court may refer legal questions to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak in a prejudicial procedure, with stays of pending cases.

parties: Asks whether exceptions for claims filed earlier with CVW could create legal inequality and whether a hardship clause is possible for unique cases.
Does the government share the concern that this could create a form of legal inequality between damage claims filed with different bodies?
Deelt de regering de zorg dat er op deze manier een vorm van rechtsongelijkheid kan ontstaan tussen schademeldingen die zijn gedaan bij verschillende instanties?
Asks whether a hardship clause should be added to the bill so that previously rejected damage claims can be reassessed.
The CDA members believe there may be reasons justifying a reassessment of damage claims rejected in the past.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn van mening dat er zich redenen kunnen voordoen die het rechtvaardigen om een herbeoordeling van in het verleden afgewezen schades te doen.
Questions the shift to the administrative judge and how the legal protection of citizens is safeguarded, and asks about public accountability and advisory bodies.
How does the government assess this decision to close off the civil law route? How is the person seeking justice protected?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering dit besluit om de civielrechtelijke weg af te sluiten? Op welke wijze wordt de rechtszoekende beschermt?
Objects that preliminary questions can only go to the Raad van State, not the Hoge Raad, and asks for a hardship clause and avoidance of duplicated questions.
Civil law questions should be able to be posed to the Supreme Court, administrative law questions to the Council of State.
Civielrechtelijke vragen moeten kunnen worden gesteld aan de Hoge Raad, bestuursrechtelijke vragen aan de Raad van State.
Criticizes exclusion of past claims without examination, asks for a hardship clause and for judges to be able to choose the Hoge Raad for preliminary questions.
With this law it becomes impossible for these people ever to get their damage compensated.
Met deze wet wordt het voor deze mensen onmogelijk gemaakt ooit nog hun schade vergoed te krijgen.
Asks why the hardship clause from the earlier Besluit was not carried over into the bill, given tragic cases of past rejections.
Is the government willing to still include this hardship clause?
Is de regering bereid alsnog deze hardheidsclausule op te nemen?
Asks how often the law will be evaluated and on what basis the measures remain necessary.
How often will there be an evaluation?
Om de hoeveel jaar wordt er geëvalueerd?
Asks the government to explain the temporary nature and reflect on reinstating the exemption of article 6:178 for the operator.
These members would like a comprehensive reflection from the government on this choice and its possible legal implications.
Graag ontvangen deze leden een uitgebreide reflectie van de regering op deze keuze en op de mogelijke (juridische) implicaties hiervan.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Groningen Mining Damage Institute Act, raising concerns about the state taking over damage settlement, exclusivity of the Institute, legal unity, the levy, appeal against preliminary-question and stay decisions, and transitional law. The government's reply accepts most points, adding a temporary character, removing exclusivity and the civil-court inadmissibility rule, making the levy a binding power, and tightening appeal and transitional provisions.
concerns: Advised removing exclusive jurisdiction of the Institute and the rule that civil courts must declare damage claims inadmissible, given Article 112 of the Constitution; the government removed both.
Advised giving the exceptional state-takeover of damage settlement a temporary character; the government added temporary framing to the title and revised the evaluation clause.
Advised specifying how legal unity between the Administrative Jurisdiction Division and the Supreme Court is guaranteed; the government added a section on this.
Objected to the discretionary levy power and broad delegation of levy rules; the levy became a binding power and the delegation to set rules by general administrative order was removed.
Advised that interim rulings on preliminary questions be appealable together with the final judgment, which was adopted.
Advised that appeal against stay decisions be excluded; the government limited appeal to the affected party, while rejecting an express ministerial ban on individual instructions.
Advised aligning the transitional provision with the explanatory memorandum and making several redactional corrections, which were adopted.

35304.s: The bill amends the income tax, wage tax, transfer tax, excise, car and motor vehicle taxes, environmental taxes and the renewable energy levy to phase out fiscal support for car ownership and to raise carbon-related taxes as part of the climate agreement. It sets stepwise schedules for rates and deductions through 2028 and includes a 'hand on the tap' mechanism allowing the cabinet to adjust emission-free car incentives when sales deviate from the projected path.
35304.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary adjustment mechanism by the inherent uncertainty in the development of emission-free driving and the need to respond to deviations from the intended path.
q: The Climate Agreement therefore provides for a 'hand on the tap' system that makes it possible to intervene if developments deviate from the intended growth path.
In het Klimaatakkoord is daarom voorzien in een «hand aan de kraan»-systematiek die het mogelijk maakt om in te grijpen als er sprake is van een ontwikkeling die afwijkt van het beoogde ingroeipad
d: adjustment of car tax incentives via noodrem mechanism
p: Introduces a 'hand on the tap' systematic allowing the cabinet to propose adjustments to emission-free vehicle tax incentives in either direction when sales deviate from the projected path, with an annual review and evaluation.

parties: Asks how the 'hand aan de kraan' systematic adjustment mechanism is anchored and when adjustments occur if overstimulation is found.
How can we firmly anchor the hand-on-the-tap system?
Op welke manier kunnen we de hand aan-de-kraan-systematiek stevig verankeren?
Asks why fiscal measures are legislated now rather than in the car tax letter, requests the baseline path for electric car sales and questions the reliability of the CARbonTAX model.
The CDA members request that the government include the baseline path for electric car sales.
De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering het basispad van verkoop van elektrische auto's op te nemen.
Asks how the government monitors PHEV stimulation and the 'hand aan de kraan' principle and seeks CO2 effect assessments.
The D66 members ask the government to explain in more detail how the principle of keeping a hand on the tap is applied.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering om nader te lichten hoe het principe om «de hand aan de kraan te houden» wordt ingevuld.
Criticises the absence of CO2 effect analysis, which the Raad van State also criticised, and questions the lack of justification for energy tax differences between households and large consumers.
The GroenLinks members share the criticism of the Raad van State and would have liked insight into the CO2 effects of this bill before the written input.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks delen de kritiek van de Raad van State en hadden graag voorafgaand aan de schriftelijke inbreng inzicht gehad in de CO 2 -effecten van dit wetsvoorstel.
Disputes that the promised relief will materialise for households, questions the assumed average consumption and the distributional effects on low and middle incomes.
The SP members have received this proposal with disappointment.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met teleurstelling kennisgenomen van voorliggend voorstel.
Supports the climate aims and the shift towards households but worries about tenants and elderly who cannot adapt homes, and asks for monitoring of incentive levels.
They do worry about people who are unable to adapt their homes.
Zij maken zich wel zorgen over mensen die niet in de gelegenheid zijn om hun huis aan te passen.
Asks the government to make the measured and expected effects on emissions transparent and to define when the proposed policy counts as successful.
When does the government consider the proposed fiscal policy successful; in other words, what is the relationship between goals and means?
Wanneer acht de regering het voorgestelde fiscale beleid succesvol; met andere woorden: wat is de relatie tussen doelen en middelen?
Asks for budgetary figures on diesel excise and the effect of stopping subsidies on car bonus rates.
The PVV members want to know by what percentage the car benefit for diesel and petrol cars can be reduced.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten met hoeveel procent de bijtelling voor diesel- en benzineauto's omlaag kan.
Asks whether provinces, which depend on the motor vehicle tax, will be compensated for lower revenues and requests expected revenue overviews.
Is it correct that the proposed changes will reduce the revenue of provinces?
Klopt het dat door de voorgestelde wijzigingen de inkomsten van provincies minder zullen bedragen?
Urges faster climate measures and criticises the degressive energy tax structure as contrary to fiscal greening.
These members call on the government to hurry with the proposals.
Deze leden roepen de regering op om haast te maken met de voorstellen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet fiscale maatregelen Klimaatakkoord, criticising the absence of analysis of the emission-reduction contribution of the tax measures and questioning the choice of raising the transfer tax for non-residential property by 1 percentage point as budgetary cover, advising revision. The government's nader rapport accepts the need for timely analysis, commits to a separate PBL report before the 28 October 2019 committee meeting, and defends the transfer tax choice as burdening business while noting the administrative impact, adding the requested clarifications.
concerns: The Afdeling argues that the emission-reduction effects of the climate tax measures and the Urgenda measure must be analysed in time for a proper parliamentary assessment, and the government committed to a separate PBL report before the committee meeting.

The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum justify the increase in transfer tax for non-residential property and consider alternatives with equal revenue and positive environmental effects; the government defends the choice as burdening business and adds clarifications but does not adopt alternatives.

The Afdeling flags that the residential/non-residential distinction creates demarcation problems and a Tax Authority workload increase, which the government acknowledges and covers with 3.5 fte additional capacity.
The Afdeling raises the need for better alignment of planning timelines between PBL analysis and the tax package, which the government says it will discuss with PBL and CPB.

35412.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) through a supplementary budget for an emergency package on jobs and the economy, with a net reduction of €18 million in obligations and €18 million in expenditure and a €165 million reduction in the budget, effective from 18 March 2020. The explanatory memorandum notes that the Tax Administration temporarily grants payment deferrals and suspends collection for three months, reducing collection-cost revenue.
35412.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by the temporary payment deferral and suspension of collection measures for taxpayers, with no delegation of power given.
q: Because the Tax Administration temporarily – for three months – grants many taxpayers deferral of payment and suspends collection, part of the revenue lapses
Omdat de Belastingdienst tijdelijk – gedurende drie maanden – aan veel belastingplichtigen uitstel van betaling verleent en de invordering opschort, vervalt een deel van de ontvangsten

35421.s: The bill amends the Telecommunications Act to replace the opt-out telemarketing regime with an opt-in system for communications to natural persons, with exceptions for existing customer relationships and business contacts. It also repeals the bel-me-niet register decree and reverses the burden of proof onto senders, while allowing an AMvB to set time limits on use of customer contact data.
35421.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB powers by saying a time limit on customer-relationship telemarketing may be needed if self-regulation proves insufficient, and that rules on objection rights may address problems that arise.
q: In addition to the opt-in system, it is proposed to include the possibility of setting by general administrative order (AMvB) a time limit on how long a customer relationship may serve as the basis for telemarketing calls.

Daarnaast wordt voorgesteld om in aanvulling op het opt-in-systeem de mogelijkheid op te nemen om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) een termijn te stellen aan de tijd dat de klantrelatie als basis kan dienen voor telemarketinggesprekken.
d: detailed rules on use of contact details and right of objection
time limit for use of customer contact data for telemarketing
p: The AMvB powers to set time limits and rules on objection rights give the executive discretion over consumer telemarketing protections without parliamentary involvement.
The reversal of the burden of proof shifts enforcement burdens onto senders, strengthening consumer protection and ACM enforcement capacity.</description_en>

parties: Asks how the scope of the ePrivacy directive, the criteria for a possible AMvB time limit, and the enforcement burden are defined.
On the basis of which concrete and objective criteria will it be weighed whether establishing such an AMvB is proportionate?
Op basis van welke concrete en objectieve criteria zal worden afgewogen of het instellen van een dergelijke amvb proportioneel is?
Welcomes the opt-in but worries about the impact on charities and asks for a broader definition of customer relationship.
They find it, like most people, annoying that people are unwantedly bothered by phone with all sorts of offers.](https://example.com)
Zij vinden het namelijk, net als de meeste mensen, ergerlijk dat men ongewenst via de telefoon wordt lastig gevallen met allerhande aanbiedingen.
Asks how the criteria for judging whether self-regulation is sufficient will be set and whether they will be drawn up with the sector.
Which criteria does the State Secretary use to determine whether self-regulation delivers sufficient or insufficient improvement?
Welke criteria hanteert de Staatssecretaris om te bepalen of de zelfregulering voldoende of onvoldoende verbetering oplevert?
Welcomes regulation of energy-contract sales and asks how enforcement and protection of vulnerable consumers will be ensured.
Regulation appears to be urgently needed, after countless examples of people being misleadingly sold contracts.
Regulering blijkt hard nodig te zijn, na talloze voorbeelden waarbij mensen op misleidende wijze contracten werden aangesmeerd.
Criticises the existing-customer exception and the reliance on sector self-regulation for the maximum contact period, arguing consumer protection should be fixed in law.
What is the government's trust in the self-regulatory capacity of the sector, which in this case has an opposing interest to the consumer, based on?
Waar is vertrouwen van de regering in het zelfregulerend vermogen van de sector, dat in dit geval een tegengesteld belang heeft aan de consument, op gestoeld?
Supports the opt-in principle but asks the government to explain its balancing of philanthropy against privacy and to clarify whether statistical research calls are exempt.
The members of the ChristenUnie group request that this weighing be made explicit and further explained.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie verzoeken deze weging te expliciteren en nader toe te lichten.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill introducing an opt-in system for unsolicited telemarketing to natural persons, raising a concern about leaving the retention period for customer contact data to self-regulation rather than fixing it by law. The government's reply (nader rapport) explains that the sector will regulate the period through a tightened Telemarketing Code, with a statutory power in reserve if self-regulation proves insufficient, and that the explanatory memorandum has been adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether self-regulation of the retention period for customer contact data is appropriate for consumer protection, given that the ACM cannot enforce the sector's code and consumers are irritated by the open-ended period.
The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum explain the limits set by the ePrivacy Directive and the GDPR on using contact data obtained within a customer relationship.

35430.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) by a supplementary budget of EUR 175 million in spending commitments and expenditure, with the changes shown in an annexed table. It takes effect from 2 April 2020 with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
35430.j: The memorandum justifies the reservation of EUR 450 million for NOW implementation costs by reference to the government's temporary emergency wage-bridging measure, and defers a detailed breakdown of costs to a later moment.
q: At a later moment a more detailed breakdown of the implementation costs over the relevant years will be made.
Op een later moment wordt een nadere uitsplitsing van de uitvoeringskosten gedaan over de betreffende jaren.

35502.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 2019/452 on screening foreign direct investment in the Netherlands, designating ministers as responsible for cooperation decisions and data processing. It lets the responsible minister collect information from public bodies, the Chamber of Commerce, and bankruptcy trustees, enforce information requests through administrative enforcement orders and economic-offence sanctions, and report on effectiveness to parliament within five years.
35502.j: The memorandum justifies the information-gathering powers as necessary to meet obligations under the EU regulation while keeping administrative burden low by using the direct request power only as a last resort.
q: The responsible minister, to collect the information referred to in Article 9(1) and (3) of Regulation 2019/452, uses data from registers and public sources where this information has not already been collected under a screening mechanism.

Onze verantwoordelijke Minister maakt ten behoeve van het verzamelen van de informatie, bedoeld in artikel 9, eerste en derde lid, van verordening 2019/452, voor zover deze informatie nog niet in het kader van een screeningsmechanisme is verzameld, gebruik van gegevens
d: allocation of responsibility for cooperation decisions among ministers
additional bodies designated to supply information to the responsible minister
designation of officials charged with supervision
p: The responsible minister may collect information from tax, trade, competition, and intelligence services and from registries, and may request it from intelligence services, reducing privacy protections for investors and firms.
The minister may impose administrative enforcement orders on investors or firms that fail to supply requested information, subject to general administrative law review.

parties: Asks how the government handles urgent cases exempt from screening deadlines, what consequences rejected investors face, and whether rejected investors can invest elsewhere.
When does the government speak of an emergency? How does the government ensure that screening in these cases still meets the criteria?
Wanneer spreekt de regering van een spoedgeval? Hoe houdt de regering er oog op dat de screening in deze gevallen wel voldoet aan de criteria?

Asks whether the Commission's opinions and member-state comments are binding, what happens if they are ignored, whether states may refuse information, and whether ministerial appointment of supervising officials ensures independence.
What if a Commission opinion is ignored, for example because national interests are at stake, or a member state refuses to provide additional information?
Wat als een advies van de Europese Commissie wordt genegeerd, omdat bijvoorbeeld nationale belangen in het geding zijn, of een lidstaat weigert aanvullende informatie te verstrekken?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it has no substantive remarks on the draft Dutch implementing act for the EU FDI screening regulation, only redactional remarks, and recommends submitting it to the House of Representatives. The minister's nader rapport accepts the redactional remarks, adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, and amends article 7 of the Handelsregisterwet 2007 to include the responsible minister in the list of data sorted by natural persons.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify how the responsible minister will exercise processing responsibility when other ministers process personal data for the act; the government added clarification in paragraphs 3.2 and 5.2.

The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify whether the necessary investments for the Dutch contact point to be operational and connected to the European network by 11 October 2020 have been or will timely be made.

35520.s: The bill changes the AOW pension age formula so that it rises with life expectancy at a two-thirds coupling, with the increase set annually by formula and the pension age in the Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 also adjusted by general administrative order. It sets the AOW age for 2026 and later years and provides for publication at least a year in advance.
35520.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by stating that the pension age must be raised annually in steps of one year by general administrative order, announced at least a year ahead, to keep it aligned with life expectancy.
q: This adjustment takes place by general administrative order in steps of one year.
Deze aanpassing vindt bij algemene maatregel van bestuur plaats in stappen van één jaar.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel 3 (artikel 7a, tweede lid AOW)
annual calculation and publication of AOW pension age increase by formula
Artikel II (artikel 18a, achtste lid Wet LB 1964)
change of statutory pension target age by general administrative order using formula
p: Artikel II (artikel 18a, achtste lid Wet LB 1964)

The statutory pension target age can be raised by general administrative order using a fixed formula, with a one-year advance publication requirement, reducing parliament's direct role in setting the age.

parties: Calls forced age-based dismissal at AOW age under collective agreements a form of injustice and asks whether the government will ban or void such clauses.
These members see age-based dismissal at AOW age imposed through collective agreements as a form of injustice.
Deze leden zien het bij cao opgelegde leeftijdsontslag op AOW-leeftijd als een vorm van onrecht.
Supports the bill as making the AOW more balanced and future-proof, while asking about workers in heavy jobs and those wishing to keep working.
The aforementioned members agree with this proposal because it brings the AOW more into balance and makes it more future-proof.
Voornoemde leden stemmen in met dit voorstel, omdat dit de AOW meer in balans brengt en meer toekomstbestendig maakt.
Asks whether the government obtained external advice on its position under Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR concerning people who moved to the Netherlands after age 17.
These members ask whether the government obtained external advice on its position regarding Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR.

Deze leden vragen of de regering met betrekking tot haar standpunt over artikel 1 van het Eerste Protocol (EP) bij het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM) advies heeft ingewonnen bij een externe partij.
Asks which additional measures and SMART targets will reduce socio-economic health inequalities and how the remaining budget coverage was found.
Which additional measures will the government take to reduce these persistent socio-economic health inequalities?
Welke aanvullende maatregelen gaat de regering nemen om deze hardnekkige sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen te verkleinen?

Wants the AOW age lowered to 65 and questions why the bill does not automatically lower the age if life expectancy falls, and why benefits are not paid automatically; also raises rights risks under Article 1 of the First Protocol.
What are the risks of interference with rights protected by Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR?
Wat zijn de risico’s bij de inmenging in door artikel 1 EP bij het EVRM beschermde rechten?
Asks why the AOW age cannot be adjusted downward when life expectancy falls and what the COVID-19 effect on life expectancy is.
Is it not possible to adjust the AOW age downward when life expectancy falls and announce this at least five years in advance?
Is het niet een mogelijkheid om, bij een dalende levensverwachting, de AOW-leeftijd neerwaarts bij te stellen en dit minimaal vijf jaar van te voren aan te kondigen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raises no formal objection to the bill moderating the link between the AOW age and life expectancy, but advises pausing submission to parliament because the fiscal and pension consequences of the COVID-19 crisis are unclear. The government's reply (nader rapport) explains that it intends to keep course, citing legal certainty and the need for timely clarity for citizens and social partners, while noting that the crisis effects on life expectancy are likely temporary and that the bill keeps its existing methodology.
concerns: The Afdeling advises pausing the bill until it is clearer what the COVID-19 crisis means for public finances and supplementary pensions, since the bill's consequences cannot currently be judged as responsibly bearable.
The government stresses that early submission gives citizens and social partners certainty about the AOW date, though it does not accept delay.

35610.s: The bill amends the Childcare Act to formally recognise parent-participation childcare centres (ouderparticipatiecrèches), defining their features and exempting them from two quality requirements (staff training and fixed-staff criterion). It sets a two-year start-up period with mandatory inspections and extends existing supervision and enforcement provisions to these centres.
35610.j: The memorandum justifies the formalisation by the long existence of these centres and the need to end a tolerated grey area, and it relies on existing supervision and enforcement powers.
q: Ending the tolerated situation will give both parents of parent-participation centres and supervisors guidance, because the bill sets out a framework with conditions.
Het beëindigen van de gedoogsituatie zal zowel voor ouders van opc's als voor toezicht houvast bieden omdat met het wetsvoorstel een kader met voorwaarden wordt vastgelegd.
d: rules on demonstrating that alternative provisions comply with paragraphs 2 and 4
I.F (art. 1.50, tweede en derde lid, via art. 1.49)
quality requirements for childcare including recognisability of persons and participating parents
p: Parent-participation centres are exempted from two statutory quality requirements during a two-year start-up period, with mandatory inspections as a counterweight.

parties: Asks how the supervisor assesses new centres during the start-up period and what criteria apply, and how the tax authority is kept from issuing the LRK number too early.
Can the government further specify on what criteria the supervisor assesses whether a new opc meets the desired quality level during and after the start-up period.
Kan de regering nader invullen op basis van welke criteria de toezichthouder toetst of een nieuwe opc gedurende en na afloop van de aanloopperiode voldoet aan het gewenste kwaliteitsniveau.
Supports the bill but questions why a two-year start-up period is needed, since it would make new initiatives practically impossible.
After all, a start-up period of two years makes new initiatives practically impossible.
Een aanloopperiode van twee jaar maakt immers nieuwe initiatieven feitelijk onmogelijk.
Asks what the bill means for the responsibility and liability of the parents involved in these centres.
These members further ask what this law means for the responsibility and liability of the parents involved.
Voorts vragen deze leden wat deze wet betekent voor de verantwoordelijkheid en de aansprakelijkheid van de betrokken ouders.
Worries that the two-year start-up period without allowance will exclude less wealthy parents and create inequality of access.
For many parents it is financially not possible to bear the cost of childcare for these two years themselves.
Voor veel ouders is het financieel gezien niet mogelijk om de kosten van kinderopvang voor deze twee jaar zelf te borgen.
Asks how continuity of the centres will be secured and warns of Belastingdienst complexity if the number of centres grows sharply.

Does the government consider it conceivable that this law will cause the number of parent-participation childcare centres to increase sharply in the near future, making the complexity for the Tax Authority too great, the members ask.

Acht de regering het denkbaar dat met deze wet het aantal ouderparticipatiecrèches binnen afzienbare tijd fors zal toenemen, waarna de complexiteit voor de Belastingdienst te groot wordt, zo vragen de leden.
Asks what remains of specific legal requirements for informal playgroups once the legal framework has lapsed, and whether the start-up period makes new centres impossible.
How does the government ensure that the start-up period does not effectively make it impossible to start a new opc in the future, these members ask.
Hoe zorgt de regering ervoor dat het voor de aanlooptermijn niet feitelijk onmogelijk wordt gemaakt om een nieuwe opc te starten in de toekomst, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Wet kinderopvang to add rules for parent-participation day-care centres, raising no substantive objections and only editorial remarks. The government reply states that the editorial remarks have been incorporated and asks that the bill and explanatory memorandum be sent to the Tweede Kamer.
concerns: The Afdeling made editorial remarks in an annex, which the government states have been incorporated.

35925-J.s: This bill formally sets the 2022 Deltafonds budget statement (in thousands of euros), covering expenditure, commitments and receipts for flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance and water quality. It enters into force on 1 January 2022 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The budget statement for the Deltafonds, referred to in article 7.22a of the Water Act, is established for the year 2022.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het Deltafonds, genoemd in artikel 7.22a van de Waterwet, voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no substantive remarks on the 2022 Deltafonds budget bill and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer, with only a redactional correction to article 3 ('Beheer' to 'Exploitatie'). The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, accompanies the advice with a nader rapport stating that the government does not object to the advice and that changes in several budgets are needed, referring to appendices.
concerns: The redactional annex advises replacing 'Beheer, onderhoud en vernieuwing' with 'Exploitatie, onderhoud en vernieuwing' in article 3 so that the bill matches the explanatory memorandum.

36006.s: The bill amends the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren to move many detailed employment conditions of judicial officials from statute to general administrative orders (AMvB), while adding a general delegation basis and a regime for the Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht and the agreement requirement. It keeps appointment, dismissal, suspension and disciplinary rules in statute and makes conforming changes to the Beroepswet, Wet bestuursrechtspraak bedrijfsorganisatie and Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie.
36006.j: The memorandum justifies the shift by saying the agreement requirement with staff representatives fits better at AMvB level, that this secures collective negotiation rights under international law, and that most provisions do not need statutory protection for judicial independence.
q: These rules on consultation and agreement on employment conditions, it has turned out, fit better at the level of a general administrative order.
Deze regels over overleg en overeenstemming over arbeidsvoorwaarden passen, zo is gebleken, beter op het niveau van een algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: employment conditions of judicial officials (appointment, salary, leave, dismissal, reorganisation, etc.)
consultation and agreement procedure with Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht, arbitration and commission composition
form for the oath or promise on taking office
further rules on rechtspositionele matters previously in art. 7
salary of chairs and judicial members of administrative and council bodies
p: Many employment conditions previously fixed by statute can now be set by general administrative order, reducing the role of parliament, subject to a duty to respect judicial independence and to the agreement requirement with the Sectorcommissie.
The statutory agreement requirement with the Sectorcommissie is moved to AMvB level, so that parliamentary amendments to these conditions are no longer bound by that statutory requirement.

parties: Asks whether the consent requirement limits the Tweede Kamer's constitutional amendment right and why the financial-interest disclosure issue was moved to a later bill.
Can the government confirm that it shares the Council of State's reading that the consent requirement does not stand in the way of accepting or implementing amendments?

Kan de regering bevestigen dat zij de lezing van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State deelt, dat het overeenstemmingsvereiste niet aan aanvaarding dan wel uitvoering van amendementen in de weg staat?

Supports the goals but stresses constitutional guarantees of judicial independence and questions whether delegating pay rules to lower regulation fits Article 117(4) of the Constitution and international standards.
Can the government explain whether the proposed arrangement on salary and financial working conditions is in line with international guidelines on the independence of the judiciary?

Kan de regering toelichten of de voorgestelde regeling omtrent het salaris en de financiële arbeidsvoorwaarden in lijn is met internationale richtlijnen inzake de onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht

Welcomes better representation of judicial staff but asks about discipline options and the handling of judges' financial interests and secondary positions, which relate to oversight of judicial officials.
Is there enough room to respond in a differentiated way to judicial officials who overstep, or are there known signals to the contrary?
Is er voldoende ruimte om gedifferentieerd om te gaan met rechterlijke ambtenaren die over de schreef gaan of zijn er signalen bekend van het tegendeel?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no substantive remarks on the draft bill amending the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren regarding the consent requirement for legal position rules affecting individual judicial officials, and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply (nader rapport) confirms the bill is forwarded without changes.

36024.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by reallocating funds for the maatschappelijke diensttijd, a support package for the cultural and creative sector, and debt forgiveness for childcare-benefit victims. It adjusts appropriations and receipts across several policy articles, effective from 4 February 2022.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36042.s: The bill approves under Article 58 Tijdelijke wet maatregelen covid-19 the royal decree extending the validity of certain provisions of the temporary COVID-19 measures act for the fifth time. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36042.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to implement Article VIII(4) of the Twm and notes that parliament retains control over maintaining the Twm provisions via approval and the voorhang-type procedure.
q: Those safeguards include parliamentary involvement in adopting measures by ministerial regulation, where the House of Representatives may decide not to consent to a laid-before ministerial regulation.
Tot die waarborgen behoort de parlementaire betrokkenheid bij het nemen van maatregelen bij ministeriële regeling
d: fifth extension of validity of Twm provisions by royal decree

parties: Asks about enforcement of the remaining ventilation obligation in hospitality, the use of municipal enforcement funds, and the timeline for the Twm and the Wpg amendment.
Welke overwegingen liggen hieraan ten grondslag?
Supports the extension but asks why the Twm should remain in force, whether it could be ended before 1 June, and when the long-term strategy will be sent to parliament.
These members ask the government what the arguments are now, after the relaxations, for keeping the Twm in force.
Deze leden vragen de regering wat op dit moment, na de gedane versoepelingen, de argumenten zijn om de Twm nog in stand te houden.
Opposes the extension, doubts the law is still temporary, and asks for the effectiveness of each measure and when extension will no longer be needed.
These members are not in favour of extending this 'temporary' law and now doubt its temporary nature.
Genoemde leden zijn niet voor verlenging van deze «tijdelijke» wet en betwijfelen inmiddels de tijdelijkheid van deze wet.
Accepts the extension for now but says the point at which the temporary law can no longer be extended is approaching, and asks when parliament will be informed about a permanent legal framework.
They therefore ask when the House will be informed about the scope, content and planning of a permanent legal framework.
Zij vragen daarom wanneer de Kamer geïnformeerd wordt over de reikwijdte, de inhoud en de planning van een permanent wettelijk kader.
Argues for improving the Wpg instead of relying on an emergency law, notes the Motion De Boer was not implemented, and questions the proportionality of the COVID pass provisions.
Asks how the adopted De Boer motion was implemented, what legal and financial consequences rejecting the extension would have, and when the long-term approach letter will come.

Accepts a legal basis is needed while COVID is not endemic, asks for separate proportionality and subsidiarity assessment of each measure, especially the COVID pass in art. 58ra, and welcomes the Council of State's review of the extension.
They ask this in particular with regard to art. 58ra and the scope of that provision.
Zij vragen dit in het bijzonder ten aanzien van art. 58ra en de reikwijdte van deze bepaling.
Argues the crisis is over and the 'direct threat' is used to keep emergency powers alive, asks for clear hard criteria for the end of the epidemic, and calls the extension absurd.
Finds periodic extension of far-reaching legislation undesirable, asks when a 'direct threat' still exists, whether a sixth extension is possible, and whether parts of the Twm can be dropped.
They ask the government to state whether the Twm (intended as a temporary law!) could reasonably be extended a sixth time.
Zij vragen de regering om aan te geven of de Twm (bedoeld als tijdelijke wet!) redelijkerwijs voor een zesde keer verlengd zou kunnen worden.
Welcomes that this is the last extension via the nahang procedure, asks for hard criteria for when the pandemic is endemic, and asks for a debate on the long-term approach.
The member asks for hard criteria determining when the pandemic has become endemic and the rigorous measures disappear from the toolbox.
Het lid vraagt om harde criteria die bepalen wanneer de pandemie endemisch is geworden en de rigoureuze maatregelen uit de gereedschapskist verdwijnen.
Argues the powers should be used more strongly to protect public health, criticises the government's framing of omicron as mild, and asks the government to protect high-risk groups.
Is surprised by the re-extension of an emergency law, asks for a new law that better guarantees democracy and human rights, and questions the A-status of COVID.
The member invites the government to make a new law in which democracy and human rights are better safeguarded.
Het lid nodigt de regering uit om een nieuwe wet te maken waarin democratie en mensenrechten beter geborgd zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises that, given continued uncertainty and no alternative legal basis, extending the temporary COVID-19 act (Twm) is understandable, but urges clarity on the scope, content and timing of a permanent legal framework for handling a large-scale pandemic and on when the advisory role applies under the new pre-hanging procedure. The minister's reply accepts that clarity is needed, commits to sharing a long-term strategy with parliament in early March, and agrees that the draft extension decree should be submitted to the Afdeling before pre-hanging.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for more clarity on the scope, content and planning of a permanent legal framework for pandemic control, given that the temporary Twm cannot be extended indefinitely.
The Afdeling notes that the continued need for measures is uncertain and that the 'directe dreiging' clause may no longer justify extension of much of the Twm as the epidemic recedes.
The Afdeling advises that the procedure for parliamentary involvement in extensions, now reverted to pre-hanging, must be clarified, including the moment at which the Afdeling advises.

The Afdeling advises that a permanent pandemic law be considered together with the broader revision of state emergency and crisis law, as fundamental rights and parliamentary involvement are at stake.

36100-X.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the 2021 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Defence and of the Paresto agency, recording final realisation figures against the adopted and supplementary budgets. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to executive powers or checks.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36105.s: The bill implements the EU regulation on recovery and resolution of central counterparties in Dutch law, amending the Wft, Bankwet 1998, Faillissementswet, Awb and Burgerlijk Wetboek. It gives De Nederlandsche Bank resolution powers over central counterparties, including bypassing shareholder consent and ordinary appeal routes, with a 10-day deadline and single-instance review before the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
36105.j: The memorandum justifies the restricted appeal procedure by the need for swift, final judicial certainty to protect financial stability, and the powers by the EU regulation's resolution objectives.
q: To provide certainty that central counterparties can continue performing their critical functions for the financial system, a swift and final court ruling is desired in these cases.

Om de zekerheid te bieden dat centrale tegenpartijen hun kritieke functies voor het financiële stelsel kunnen blijven uitvoeren is een spoedig en onherroepelijk rechterlijk oordeel in deze gevallen gewenst
d: suspension of trading in financial instruments by DNB instruction
resolution powers not restricted by statute, articles or contracts
p: Resolution decisions by DNB are exempt from shareholder approval requirements and from notification or procedural rules in other legislation, except those in the regulation itself.

Appeal against resolution measures is limited to a 10-day filing period, single-instance review with a 14-day ruling deadline, no suspensive effect, and a presumption that suspension is contrary to the public interest.
Courts must maintain legal effects of annulled resolution decisions where third parties in good faith acquired rights.
DNB alone may petition the Amsterdam court for bankruptcy of a central counterparty, and courts may only reject the petition if DNB could not reasonably reach its view.

parties: Asks which third countries host the parent companies of Dutch CCPs beyond DNB's reach and what alternative enforcement DNB will explore.
DNB points out that most parent companies of Dutch central counterparties are established in third countries where DNB has no powers.
DNB vestigt daarbij de aandacht op het feit dat de meeste moederondernemingen van Nederlandse centrale tegenpartijen in derde landen gevestigd zijn, waar DNB geen bevoegdheden heeft.
Asks about regulatory burden and calls for EU-level cooperation, possibly via ESMA, so supervisors need not build relations with each third-country supervisor individually.
These members ask on the one hand to what extent the CCPs in which Dutch financial institutions are clearing members are located outside the European Union.
Deze leden vragen enerzijds naar de mate waarin centrale tegenpartijen waarin Nederlandse financiële instellingen clearinglid zijn zich buiten de Europese Unie bevinden.
Asks about the risks of limited enforcement over extraterritorial parties and whether agreements with third countries are needed.
The CDA members read in DNB's implementation assessment that a caveat is made regarding enforcement of the regulation insofar as involved (extraterritorial) parties fall outside DNB's powers.

De leden van de CDA-fractie lezen in de uitvoeringstoets door DNB dat een kanttekening wordt gemaakt bij de handhaving van de verordening voor zover betrokken (extraterritoriale) partijen buiten de bevoegdheden van DNB vallen.
These members have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State made no substantive objections to the draft Dutch implementing act for the EU regulation on recovery and resolution of central counterparties, offering only editorial remarks. The Minister of Finance's reply reports that the editorial remarks and several technical improvements were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clarification of how Article 3(6) of the regulation is implemented and for corrections in the transposition table, including the implementation of Article 90 via Article I, part F.
The Afdeling advised adding to Article 3A:2 Wft that the chapter does not apply to legal persons also licensed under Article 14 of EMIR, in line with Article 93 of the regulation.

36120-V.s: The bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by a first supplementary budget, raising expenditure and commitments across policy articles and the Apparaat. It sets budget figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2022.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2022

36123.s: The bill removes two provisions from a pending bill (Kamerstukken 35 348) that amends the Code of Civil Procedure and the Civil Code, namely article I part B and article IIIA. It also makes this bill take effect at the same time as that pending bill.
36123.j: The memorandum justifies removing the provisions by noting that the pending article 30j Rv is no longer expected to enter into force and that the oral-hearing rules were broadened by a 2019 law.

parties: The VVD asks the government to explain why it dropped the increased maximum sentence and the Raad voor de Rechtspraak's alternative options, and to report on other measures against forced marriage.
Can the government explain why it nonetheless chose not to retain this element?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom zij ervoor gekozen heeft dit element desondanks niet in stand te laten?
D66 supports removing the Van Wijngaarden amendment because criminalising partners in religious marriages could undermine victims' position, while stressing the need to combat forced marriage.
They endorse the choice to remove the Van Wijngaarden amendment from the proposal.
Zij onderschrijven de keuze die is gemaakt het amendement Van Wijngaarden uit het voorstel te schrappen.
The CDA supports the change without further comment, noting no burden for citizens or implementing bodies and a positive Raad van State advice.
These members therefore support this change without further comments.
Deze leden steunen daarom deze wijziging zonder nadere opmerkingen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on a bill amending the Dutch Civil Procedure Code, Civil Code and other laws, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport explains that the government also deleted article I, part B, on oral hearings in family-law cases, since article 30j Rv is no longer expected to enter into force.

36132.s: The bill converts the experimental educatieve module (a 30-credit teacher-training module for university bachelor or master graduates) into a permanent statutory arrangement in the WHW and WVO 2020, including a teaching qualification and a transitional provision. It also extends a study-finance extra year for hbo teacher training, allows verklaringen of subjects and competence for further subjects, and lets a ministerial regulation set the subject-equivalence table for the module.
36132.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to the ministerial regulation by the need to give legal certainty to students, schools and institutions on which pre-education leads to which teaching competence.
q: By ministerial regulation, rules are set on which certificates from bachelor programmes, and which verklaringen and certificates, confer the competence to teach the subjects designated therein.

Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld over welke getuigschriften van de bacheloropleidingen, bedoeld in het eerste lid, en over welke verklaringen en certificaten, bedoeld in het tweede lid, de bevoegdheid verlenen tot het geven van de daarbij aan te wijzen vakken.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel H (art. 18.100 WHW) / Artikel III, B (art. 7.12, derde lid WVO 2020)
which certificates and verklaringen grant teaching competence for which subjects (verwantschapstabel)
entry requirements set by the institutional board for the educatieve module

parties: Asks how the government can ensure quality of teachers with limited second-degree qualifications and how it monitors quality without an independent NVAO assessment.
These members do not really understand how the government has insight into quality if it has not been independently assessed.
Deze leden begrijpen niet goed hoe de regering zicht heeft op de kwaliteit als die niet zelfstandig beoordeeld is.
Welcomes the bill to fight teacher shortages but asks how legal certainty for students is guaranteed given the hardship-clause approach for student finance.
How does the government guarantee legal certainty for students?
Hoe waarborgt de regering de rechtszekerheid voor studenten?
Supports anchoring the module and equalising student finance given the teacher shortage, while asking about transcripts and why vmbo is excluded.
Given the growing teacher shortage, these members support the proposal to legally anchor the educational module.
Gezien het oplopende lerarentekort steunen deze leden het voorstel om de educatieve module wettelijk te verankeren.
Fears the bill lowers the threshold to become a teacher and endangers education quality, asking whether the module should lead to a full qualification.
These members believe this bill lowers the threshold to become a teacher and they oppose it.
Deze leden menen dat met dit wetsvoorstel de drempel om leraar te worden wordt verlaagd en zij verzetten zich hiertegen.
Supports tackling the shortage but worries about reduced start competence and asks the government to respond to the Raad van State and AOb suggestions for time limits.
These members also want to emphasise that the quality of education must not suffer from the teacher shortage.
Deze leden willen tegelijkertijd benadrukken dat de kwaliteit van het onderwijs niet mag lijden onder het lerarentekort.
Worries that lower quality requirements may be accepted, and asks why school concerns were not addressed in the bill before structural anchoring.
For these members it is important that such concerns about declining education quality from flexibilising teacher training are sufficiently addressed before structural anchoring.

Voor deze leden is het belangrijk dat dergelijke zorgen over de afname van het onderwijskwaliteit door de flexibilisering van de lerarenopleidingen voldoende worden weggenomen alvorens er wordt overgegaan tot een structurele verankering.
Asks whether the relationship table risks case-by-case individual tailoring and whether a more generic regime would better serve legal certainty.
It strikes the members of the SGP faction that major programmes such as law do not appear in the relationship table.
Het valt de leden van de SGP-fractie op dat in de verwantschapstabel grote opleidingen als rechtsgeleerdheid niet voorkomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill to make the educatieve module (teaching module) permanent, raising concerns about teacher pedagogical and didactic competence, the removal of the subject-relatedness table, the knowledge-based admission route, and the use of the hardship clause for loan calculation. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted several points, amended the bill to keep the verwantschapstabel and admission rules, added a non-diploma admission route limited to equivalent foreign diplomas, and declined to change the competence duration or loan rules now, instead committing to review them later.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the limited second-degree competence from the educatieve module ensures pedagogical and didactic competence; the government explained competence requirements and will review the competence duration later without changing the bill.

The Afdeling argued that abolishing the verwantschapstabel removes legal certainty on which prior degrees give subject competence; the government reinstated the regulatory basis and extended it to certificates, and added an admission-requirements power for universities.

The Afdeling objected that admission based on knowledge, insight and skills at bachelor level is not explained or motivated; the government removed the admission-test route and limited it to equivalent foreign diplomas.

The Afdeling noted the hardship clause cannot solve the loan-calculation mismatch; the government kept the bill unchanged, applied the clause case by case, and committed to a structural solution later.

36150.s: The bill inserts a new chapter into the Kieswet placing responsibility for the vote-counting software (uitslagprogrammatuur) with the Kiesraad as its manager, covering availability, security, transparency, testing, connection and usage rules, and a limited instruction power. It also requires use of such software in results determination, adds controls and publication duties, and makes unauthorised intrusion a criminal offence.
36150.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and suspension powers by the need for a reliable, secure and efficient vote count and the operational need to act quickly in exceptional situations.
d: rules on making vote-counting software available to users
details on software design, reliability, security and central facilities
topics and timing of connection and usage rules
rules on municipal verification and declaration
consequences of suspending use of the software
Kiesraad connection and usage regulations (aansluit- and gebruiksvoorschriften)
cooperation protocol between Kiesraad and local bodies
p: The Kiesraad as manager may issue binding instructions to municipalities and water boards and suspend use of the software, subject to proportionality and a deadline.
The Kiesraad may and in some cases must publish a report on the reliability and security of the software after an election.

parties: Asks whether the Kiesraad's binding management instruction covers both central and decentral software, when 'extreme cases' apply, and why post-election reporting is optional rather than mandatory.
The VVD members ask why a 'may' provision was chosen.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom er is gekozen voor een «kan»-bepaling.
Wants efficiency gains kept while specific requirements guarantee reliable determination of results, and asks whether technical vulnerabilities of the new system are adequately addressed.
These members want the efficiency benefits of digital tools preserved while specific requirements are laid down to guarantee a reliable determination of the election result.

Deze leden hechten eraan dat de efficiëntievoordelen van digitale hulpmiddelen behouden blijven, terwijl de specifieke eisen worden vastgelegd die nodig zijn om een betrouwbare vaststelling van de verkiezingsuitslag te waarborgen.
Has noted the bill and has no further questions.
has no further additional questions about it.
heeft hier geen verder aanvullende vragen over.
Asks whether technical safeguards should be fixed in the statute rather than an AMvB, asks about feasibility for the Kiesraad, and suggests a pilot to assess real costs.

These members ask the government whether, for digital security, it is indeed desirable to guarantee the foundation of the technical requirements in the bill rather than in a general administrative order.

Deze leden vragen aan de regering of in het kader van de digitale veiligheid het juist wenselijk is om het fundament van de technische voorschriften te waarborgen in het wetsvoorstel in plaats van in een algemene maatregel van bestuur.
Accepts automation to ease the process but insists that the process never be fully automated so that human oversight and control always remain possible.
They therefore ask whether the government can clearly state that the process or parts of it will never be fully automated, so that human supervision and control is always possible.

Zij vragen daarom of de regering duidelijk kan aangeven dat het proces of onderdelen daarvan nooit geheel geautomatiseerd zullen plaatsvinden zodat er altijd menselijk toezicht is en controle kan plaatsvinden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet programmatuur verkiezingsuitslagen, which centralises election results software, makes its use mandatory and assigns the Kiesraad as manager, raising concerns about statutory basic requirements, delegation scope, fallback options, criminal law and internal separation of functions. The minister's reply accepts most points: basic requirements are now in the bill (Ea 3), delegation grounds are removed or justified, a new offence (Z 2a) is added and a functional separation is committed to.
concerns: Delegation of matters to amvb and ministerial regulation was too broad and needed justification, and was narrowed and partly moved into the statute.
Article 59 of the Constitution requires essential election software requirements to be set in the formal statute, and basic requirements were added as Ea 3.
Fallback options for software failure should be elaborated and users prepared, including manual counting, which the government only partly accepted by committing to an instruction.
Criminal liability for tampering with the software was insufficiently covered, and a specific offence with a six-year maximum was added.
Kiesraad's dual role as manager of the software and central polling board requires organisational separation of functions, which the government committed to.

36204.s: The bill amends the Income Tax Act 2001 to recalculate the deemed return on savings and investments in box 3 following the Supreme Court's 2021 ruling, introducing new rate formulas for bank deposits, other assets and debts. It adds an arbitrage rule for reference-date manipulation and lets the Minister set annual flat-rate percentages and rules for applying that arbitrage provision by ministerial regulation.
36204.j: The memorandum justifies the arbitrage delegation as a precaution and the annual percentage delegation by saying the final rate is only known after the calendar year ends, with formulas fixed in statute.
q: Article 5.24(3) of the Income Tax Act 2001 provides that rules on applying the arbitrage provision may be set by ministerial regulation.
In het voorgestelde artikel 5.24, derde lid, Wet IB 2001 wordt geregeld dat bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels kunnen worden gesteld omtrent toepassing van de genoemde arbitragebepaling.
d: rules on applying the reference-date arbitrage provisions
Artikel 10.6ter, tweede, vierde en vijfde lid (Wet IB 2001)
annual flat-rate percentages for bank deposits, debts and other assets, set retroactively
p: Allows the Minister to set rules on applying reference-date arbitrage, while taxpayers may rebut the arbitrage by showing business reasons.
Lets the Minister replace statutory flat-rate return percentages each year, retroactively, by ministerial regulation, within formulas fixed in the Act.

parties: Asks whether lumping bonds with equities and real estate into one forfait is legally defensible under the Christmas ruling, which requires the forfait to approximate actual returns.
The VVD members ask whether the government considers it (legally) defensible that bonds of risk-averse investors are included in the same category as equities and real estate.</evidence_en>
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering het (juridisch) houdbaar acht dat obligaties van risicomijdende beleggers in het voorstel in dezelfde categorie zijn opgenomen
Asks whether the Christmas ruling was considered in timing, expects litigation over the transitional regime, and questions the choice of debt and forfait reference rates.
These members ask whether the government expects litigation over the regime applying from 2023 through 2025.</evidence_en>
Deze leden vragen of de regering verwacht dat ook geprocedeerd gaat worden over het stelsel dat van toepassing zal zijn van 2023 tot en met 2025.
Asks whether the forfait approximates reality, whether the law will survive court review, and whether legal advice will be shared with the House.
These members also ask whether the government will share all relevant legal advice on the bill with the House.</evidence_en>
Deze leden vragen tevens of de regering alle relevante juridische adviezen ten aanzien van het ingediende wetsvoorstel met de Kamer wil delen
Questions whether the wealth category 'other assets' is too broad and whether anti-arbitrage protection works given that taxpayers must prove business reasons.
The SP members ask the government whether this offers adequate protection against peildatum arbitrage.</evidence_en>
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of dit wel een afdoende bescherming biedt tegen peildatumarbitrage.
Asks how non-objectors can obtain review, how the mass objection procedure will be improved, and whether the 'business reason' exception is too vague to enforce.
The concept of a business consideration is rather abstract, broadly interpretable and easy to invoke.</evidence_en>
Het begrip zakelijke overweging is tamelijk abstract, breed uitlegbaar en makkelijk inroepbaar.
Raises legal certainty concerns from the Raad van State about ex post forfait determination and whether the averaged forfait is consistent with the Christmas ruling.
By partly setting the forfait return percentages ex post, legal certainty is undermined.</evidence_en>
Door de forfaitaire rendementspercentages deels achteraf vast te stellen wordt afbreuk gedaan aan het rechtszekerheidsbeginsel
Asks why the temporary progressive wealth tax alternative was not chosen and about revenue shortfalls and FTE needs of the bridging law.
The GroenLinks members note that the government says it considered several alternatives.</evidence_en>
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie constateren dat de regering aangeeft enkele alternatieven overwogen te hebben.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Overbruggingswet box 3, a temporary scheme for 2023-2025 bringing box 3 taxation in line with the Hoge Raad Kerstarrest, raising concerns about retrospective setting of yield percentages (legal certainty) and the peildatumarbitrage rule (reversed burden of proof, unclear start and end of the three-month period). The government's reply added justification for the ex post percentages without changing the bill, and on peildatumarbitrage clarified the anti-arbitrage rule and the three-month period, but did not adopt an alternative for the percentages.
concerns: The Afdeling questions retrospective determination of yield percentages for banktegoeden and schulden, suggesting basing them on the current year's yields instead; the government justified the method without changing the bill.

The Afdeling doubts the peildatumarbitrage rule, which reverses the burden of proof and has an unclear start and end of the three-month period; the government clarified the period and explained the choice over fraus legis but did not fundamentally change the rule.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of first experiences with the herstel operation, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling made a redactional remark on the consistency of the explanatory memorandum and the implementation test, which the government adopted.

36213.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality by a third incidental supplementary budget, covering implementation costs of the Transition Fund for rural areas and nature. It sets budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 26 September 2022 with retroactive effect where publication comes later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV), voor het jaar 2022

36222.s: The bill replaces the Dutch sexual offences title (Titel XIV) with a modernised 'Seksuele misdrijven' title, introducing graded offences of negligent and intentional sexual assault and rape based on absence of will, and criminalises sexual intimidation and public drunkenness as public-order offences. It also makes consequential amendments to the Code of Criminal Procedure and a range of other statutes.
36222.j: The memorandum justifies the new offences by reference to international obligations (Istanbul Convention, EU directive 2011/93/EU), the legality principle, and gaps exposed by municipal sexual-intimidation rules struck down by the court.
q: The appeal court ruled that such an infringement on freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution can only be made by a formal law.
Het gerechtshof oordeelde dat uitsluitend bij wet in formele zin een dergelijke inbreuk op de vrijheid van meningsuiting bedoeld in artikel 7 van de Grondwet kan worden gemaakt.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel J (artikel 151f) and Artikel I, onderdeel K (artikel 244)

Broadens prosecutorial and judicial discretion by introducing absence-of-will standards assessed from circumstances, which gives authorities more latitude in charging and proof, though the criteria are defined in the bill.
Artikel I, onderdeel N (artikel 429ter) and Artikel I, onderdeel O (artikel 430b)
Creates new public-order offences for sexual intimidation and public drunkenness, expanding the range of conduct that officers and municipal enforcers may act on, with moderate penalties.

parties: Asks why 16-18 year old victims are not treated separately, whether the bill will align actual sentences with other countries, and how the OM and courts' non-binding sentencing guidelines will be made consistent.

These members point out that with regard to demanded and imposed sentences a degree of legal inequality and arbitrariness has arisen, because the OM and the judiciary already do not follow the guidelines they themselves set.

Deze leden wijzen erop dat wat betreft de geëiste en opgelegde straffen er een mate van rechtsongelijkheid en willekeur is ontstaan, doordat het OM en de Rechtspraak zich nu al niet houden aan de door henzelf opgestelde richtlijnen.

Supports the consent norm but doubts whether the negligence variants add value beside broadened intent offences, asks for clear boundaries and warns the bill will not make proof easier, requesting examples and a justification of the new maximum penalties.
As the Afdeling states, the question arises 'whether introducing the new negligence offences adds value beside the already substantially broadened intent offences.'
Zoals de Afdeling stelt, rijst de vraag «of introductie van de nieuwe schulddelicten toegevoegde waarde heeft naast de al substantieel verruimde opzetdelicten.»

Asks how negligence and intent variants can be distinguished in evidence, when sexual contact for expensive gifts or money is consensual, when the sentencing ban on community service applies, and whether client liability for sex with minors is strengthened.
The dividing line between these two variants appears thin, according to these members.
De scheidslijn tussen deze twee varianten lijkt dun, volgens deze leden.

Warns that the bill will still lead to few convictions because proof remains difficult where a suspect denies and no witnesses exist, questions the vagueness of the sexual intimidation offence, and asks why a community-service ban and an online age-verification duty are absent.
Can the government refute that this forms the Achilles heel of this proposal because in practice it will still lead to few convictions?
Kan de regering weerleggen dat dit de achilleshiel vormt van dit voorstel omdat het in de praktijk alsnog tot weinig veroordelingen zal leiden?

Asks how the boundary between negligence and intent can be proven in practice, whether the wording of sexual intimidation is subjective and hard to enforce on the spot, and how the OM's doubt about easier evidence gathering is addressed.
That does not alter the fact that in evidentiary practice it will be difficult to draw that distinction between negligence and intent.
Dat neemt echter niet weg dat in de praktijk van bewijsvoering het moeilijk zal kunnen zijn om dat onderscheid tussen schuld en opzet te maken.

Welcomes a clear consent norm but asks for justification of abandoning the morals title, questions the limitation period for negligence rape, asks about compensation for victims, and notes enforcement of street intimidation will be difficult.
These members also see that enforcement of this proposal will not be simple.
Deze leden zien ook dat handhaving op voorliggend voorstel niet eenvoudig zal zijn.

Fears the lower reporting threshold will not make evidence easier, so proceedings will not necessarily lead to convictions, and questions the inconsistent limitation rules and the risk that tiered entry into force steers cases to lighter variants.
These members however fear that the provability of assault and rape remains difficult even with this bill.
Deze leden vrezen echter dat de bewijsbaarheid van aanranding en verkrachting ook met dit wetsvoorstel lastig blijft.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises that the Dutch sexual offences bill (modernising Title XIV of the Criminal Code) needs revision, especially on the scope of the intentional and negligence variants of rape and assault, the proposed penalty increases, enforceability of sexual intimidation, and the sexting exemption. The government's nader rapport accepts many points, adjusts the bill on capacity, the negligence offences, penalty maxima, aggravating grounds and sexting, and rejects the call to align gender-neutral wording with the rest of the Criminal Code.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for clearer delimitation between intentional and negligence variants of assault and rape, and the government clarifies the distinction in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling finds the proposed increases in maximum penalties for child sexual offences insufficiently justified; the government lowers the child rape maxima to fifteen and eighteen years and caps the aggravation.
The Afdeling doubts the enforceability of the sexual intimidation offence in public space and the government adds explanation on camera surveillance and enforcement routes.
The Afdeling asks to reconsider the aggravating grounds in article 254, and the government rewrites them as fixed three-year increases.
The Afdeling notes that the sexting exemptions conflict with the child pornography directive, and the government removes them in favour of a prosecution policy.
The Afdeling asks what concrete measures ensure police and prosecution capacity before entry into force, and the government adds these in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks for explicit justification of the criminal liability for consensual sexual contact within hierarchical relationships, and the government clarifies the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks that the gender-neutral normadressaat wording align with the rest of the Criminal Code; the government declines, citing the scope of the bill.

36231.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act (Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968) to implement EU Directive 2020/284 by requiring payment service providers to keep detailed registers of cross-border payments to beneficiaries and make them available to tax authorities. It sets administrative fines for failing these obligations, with the amount and limitation period defined in the bill.
36231.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new information obligations by the growing difficulty tax authorities face in checking VAT compliance for cross-border online sales.
q: This bill therefore extends the control options for VAT payment by using payment data from cross-border payments.
Dit wetsvoorstel breidt daarom de controlemogelijkheden op het afdragen van btw uit, door gebruik te maken van betalingsgegevens van grensoverschrijdende betalingen.
p: The tax inspector may impose administrative fines up to the sixth category on payment service providers for intentional or grossly negligent non-compliance, with a five-year limitation period.
Payment service providers must keep and supply detailed transaction registers to tax authorities, with the inspector entitled to receive them on their own initiative.

parties: Asks about the scale of VAT fraud, the chosen retention periods, possible use of the data for other taxes, and consistency with GDPR purpose limitation.
These members ask whether the government can respond to these comments and indicate to what extent the suggestions led to amendment or clarification.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan ingaan op deze commentaren en daarbij aangeven in hoeverre deze suggesties tot aanpassing of verduidelijking hebben geleid?

Worried about an EU-wide central database of cross-border payments, access by the European Commission and other authorities, possible secondary use for other enforcement, and safeguards against abuse and blacklisting of consumers.

The PVV members ask the government to clarify whether the Central Electronic System of Payment (CESOP) will create a European central database of all cross-border payments to which, among others, the European Commission has access.

De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering om nader toe te lichten of er met de Central Electronic System of Payment (CESOP) een Europese centrale database van alle grensoverschrijdende betalingen wordt samengesteld waar, onder andere, de Europese Commissie toegang toe heeft.
