Questions the proportionality of the expanded control powers with respect to payment service users' privacy, and asks about the policy freedom in implementation and the enforcement cost-benefit balance.
How does the government reflect on the proportionality with respect to the right to privacy of payment service users?
Hoe reflecteert de regering op de proportionaliteit met betrekking tot het recht op privacy van betalingsdienstgebruikers.

Supports the goal of combating e-commerce VAT fraud but asks about the division of powers between the tax authority and CESOP, the analysis method, and the Commission's attention to VAT fraud at EU level.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill and support the aim of better detecting VAT fraud in e-commerce.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en steunen de doelstelling van het beter kunnen opsporen van btw-fraude bij e-commerce.
Asks how powers are transferred to CESOP, how effective the controls on payment providers are and how they will be monitored, and how consumers' financial data are protected in European collection.
These members further ask the government in what way powers will be transferred to CESOP.
Deze leden vragen de regering verder op welke wijze er bevoegdheden zullen worden overgedragen aan de CESOP.
Asks about the impact of targeted tax-authority access to international payment data on citizens' privacy and how the government weighed a possible restriction of privacy.

The ChristenUnie members ask about the impact of targeted access for tax authorities to international payment data on citizens' privacy and how the government weighed a possible limitation of privacy in light of this bill.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen naar de impact van de gerichte toegang voor belastingdiensten tot internationale betalingsgegevens op de privacy van burgers en hoe de regering een mogelijke beperking van privacy gewogen heeft in het licht van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill implementing the EU Payment Service Providers Directive for VAT fraud control, raising concerns about the implementation timeline, data protection and unnecessary registration, the fine maximum, and dynamic references to EU law. The government's reply accepts the core points, explains the temporary and future data platform arrangements, justifies the sixth-category fine as proportionate, and defends dynamic referencing.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to state when the future data platform will be ready and what fraud-fighting use the data will have during the temporary arrangement; the government explained the plateau 1 and 2 phasing and a mid-2023 review.

The Afdeling asked how registration of data below the 25-payment threshold complies with data minimisation and storage limitation, and for a data protection impact assessment; the government pointed to the EDPS opinion, pledged a separate assessment for the later pilot, and said providers may not report below-threshold data.

The Afdeling asked for reasoned justification of the sixth-category maximum fine, which departs from earlier VAT implementations; the government justified it with the Boetewijzer and the word 'ten hoogste' stressing proportionality, but did not change the amount.
The Afdeling recommended deleting article 41(3) of the Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968 and completing the transposition table; the government made these redactional changes.

The Afdeling asked for a weighing of advantages and disadvantages of dynamic referencing to EU definitions given the earlier PSD2 implementation; the government explained the benefits and that the approaches do not create confusion.

36312.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 to implement EU Directive 2020/285 on the small enterprise scheme, restructuring the Dutch small business exemption with new registration rules and a threshold of EUR 20,000 for Dutch enterprises and EUR 100,000 EU-wide. It also allows Dutch businesses to use the scheme in other member states via a centralised notification to the inspector.
36312.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and discretionary powers as necessary to implement the EU directive and reduce administrative burdens on small businesses, and to prevent tax abuse.
q: The inspector may decide by appealable decision that the entrepreneur is not eligible for the exemption if it is likely the conditions will not be met.

De inspecteur kan bij voor bezwaar vatbare beschikking beslissen dat de ondernemer niet in aanmerking komt voor toepassing van de vrijstelling, indien aannemelijk is dat niet zal worden voldaan aan de voorwaarden voor de toepassing van de vrijstelling.
d: VAT registration threshold amount for exemption without notification
prescribed manner of notification to the inspector
prescribed manner of pre-notification and updates for cross-border scheme
p: Allows the inspector to extend the decision period in special cases to prevent tax evasion or avoidance, limited to cases where more time is needed for necessary checks.
Lets the inspector refuse the exemption by appealable decision where it is likely conditions will not be met.

parties: Asks about threshold indexation, inflation, cross-border competitiveness, the Raad van State's point on the missing 15-day identification procedure, and implementation risks.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how cross-border thresholds will be enforced and whether the scheme invites abuse, and whether the evaluation should be postponed.
It seems difficult to enforce this for these members, so they ask whether this does not open the door to abuse of the scheme.
Het lijkt deze leden lastig om hierop te handhaven, zij vragen daarom of dit niet de deur openzet tot misbruik van de regeling.
Requests data on cross-border entrepreneurs, country overviews of thresholds, and the budgetary impact and IV-portfolio consequences.
The PVV members ask the government to indicate how many Dutch entrepreneurs under the small business scheme also perform services internationally.
De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering om aan te geven hoeveel Nederlandse ondernemers, die onder de kleineondernemersregeling vallen, tevens internationaal prestaties verrichten.
Worries about the implementation burden on an already overheated VAT portfolio, cites the Uitvoeringstoets's warning, and asks why an unfeasible bill is deemed executable.
They find it very risky that implementation can only be done in line with the directive if the work processes are almost fully automated.
Zij vinden het zeer risicovol dat implementatie alleen richtlijnconform kan gebeuren als de werkprocessen bijna volledig worden geautomatiseerd.
Asks why existing schemes are outdated, why administrative burdens are not reduced enough, and which burdens entrepreneurs still face.
The SP members ask the government to explain why the current schemes are outdated and do not sufficiently limit administrative burdens.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven waarom de huidige regelingen verouderd zijn en de administratieve lasten niet genoeg beperken.
Asks whether the 20,000 euro threshold should be indexed given real-terms erosion through inflation, and the budgetary cost of raising it.
These members ask whether the government has considered indexing this amount.
Deze leden vragen of de regering heeft overwogen om dit bedrag te indexeren.
Asks how a contestable decision reaches a foreign entrepreneur, the legal status of silence from authorities, and how the thresholds were set and are evaluated.
The BBB member asks the government to explain how an appealable decision reaches the entrepreneur established in the other member state.
Het lid van de BBB-fractie vraagt de regering om toe te lichten op welke wijze een voor bezwaar vatbare beschikking de in de andere lidstaat gevestigde ondernemer bereikt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the Dutch bill implementing the EU small business scheme (kleineondernemersregeling) raised remarks on the motivation of the EUR 1,800 registration threshold, the enforceability by the Tax Authority, and legal protection of entrepreneurs, notably the unclear legal status of inspector actions. The government's reply accepted the need to justify the threshold, moved it to EUR 2,200 by ministerial regulation, added explanation on implementability and the updated feasibility test, and largely declined to codify the threshold earlier while clarifying objection routes in the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum justify the EUR 1,800 threshold and the distinction between small and very small entrepreneurs; the government added explanation and raised the threshold to EUR 2,200 by ministerial regulation.

The Afdeling advised statutory codification of the earlier policy exemption for very small entrepreneurs rather than waiting until 2025; the government declined to split the bill and kept it in the implementing act.

The Afdeling asked that uncertainties in the Tax Authority's implementation feasibility be explained and the transitional law addressed; the government explained the primary causes and reported that the January 2023 re-assessment brought no substantial changes.

The Afdeling asked that the legal status of key inspector actions (notification, reply, withdrawal, deactivation, time-limit extension) be clarified so entrepreneurs' legal remedies are assured; the government explained objection routes for registration refusals and cross-border cases but did not amend the bill text.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on consistency between the bill text and explanatory note, the transposition table, and the article III explanation; the government adopted these corrections.

36410-IIB.s: This bill establishes the 2024 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the other Hoge Colleges van Staat, the governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council, in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or new executive powers.
q: The budget statement attached to this law for the year 2024 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion dated 11 September 2023 on the draft 2024 budget act for the other High Councils of State, Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB), raising no remarks. The Minister of Finance's reply of 18 September 2023 forwards the advice and advises submission to the Tweede Kamer.

36420.s: The bill amends several Dutch tax laws for fiscal year 2024, including the income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, dividend tax, motor vehicle taxes, customs law and the debt collection act, mainly as technical repairs and codifications. It also introduces administrative fines and new penalty provisions for customs declarations and information duties, and makes electronic filing mandatory for certain investment deductions.
36420.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers mainly as technical corrections to earlier legislation and to align with Supreme Court rulings and RDW vehicle classification.
q: These are purely technical amendments that have no consequences for the compliance capacity of citizens or businesses.
Het betreft louter technische aanpassingen die geen gevolgen hebben voor het doenvermogen van burgers of bedrijven.
d: ARTIKEL V, onderdeel A (art. 4 Wet BPM 1992)
equating other motor vehicles with motorcycles (trikes, quads)
equating other motor vehicles with motorcycles (trikes, quads)
ARTIKEL XXXA, A, art. 3.36 Wet IB 2001 (nieuw eerste lid)
electronic filing of willekeurige afschrijving via RVO
p: ARTIKEL VII, A (art. 9:1a en 9:1b Algemene douanewet)

Customs inspectors may impose administrative fines for incorrect or late declarations and information duties, shifting such sanctioning from criminal to administrative procedure with appeal available.
Criminal liability is extended to intentional incorrect declarations and information failures that reduce duties, with a custodial penalty up to six years.
ARTIKEL IX, A (art. 6.11 Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen)
Bailiffs may disclose debtor personal data and debt details to the Tax Authority/Toeslagen to enable contact about debts.

parties: Asks whether the Belastingdienst is adequately equipped to combat dividend stripping and whether the measure is monitored and evaluated.
These members ask whether the tax authority/inspector is sufficiently equipped under the proposed bill to combat dividend stripping adequately.
Deze leden vragen of de Belastingdienst/inspecteur met het voorliggende wetsvoorstel voldoende is uitgerust om dividendstripping adequaat te bestrijden.
Finds it notable that the dividend stripping approach has no budgetary consequences and asks for an explanation.
They nonetheless continue to find it striking that this approach has no budgetary consequences.
Wel blijven zij het opvallend vinden dat deze aanpak geen budgettaire gevolgen geeft.
Asks whether the 1,000 euro efficiency margin in the new burden-of-proof rule will be indexed so the heightened burden does not fall on more taxpayers over time.
These members ask whether this amount will be indexed in some way, so that over the years the heightened burden of proof does not fall on more and more taxpayers.
Deze leden vragen of dit bedrag op een bepaalde wijze geïndexeerd wordt, zodat voorkomen wordt dat in de loop der jaren op steeds meer belastingplichtigen de versterkte bewijslast komt te liggen.
Questions why stronger measures generating tax revenue, as used in neighbouring countries, were not adopted.
Why has the government not chosen stronger measures that also generate tax revenue, since research shows the Netherlands is relatively the most affected by these fraudulent actions?

Waarom heeft de regering niet voor sterkere maatregelen gekozen die ook belastingopbrengsten genereren, omdat uit onderzoek juist blijkt dat Nederland relatief het zwaarst getroffen is door deze frauduleuze acties.
Asks whether the proposed strengthening is sufficient to stop dividend stripping, whether more measures are needed, and how the efficiency margin was set and whether it creates loopholes.
Does the existence of an efficiency margin offer opportunities for new constructions to make dividend stripping possible after all?
Biedt het bestaan van een doelmatigheidsmarge mogelijkheden tot nieuwe constructies om dividendstripping toch mogelijk te maken?
Asks how far the concept of ultimate beneficial owner limits room for avoidance structures and why ex post rather than ex ante measures were chosen.
To what extent does the concept of ultimate beneficial owner, according to the government, offer sufficient relief to limit room for avoidance constructions?
In welke mate biedt het begrip «uiteindelijk gerechtigde» volgens de regering voldoende soelaas om de ruimte voor ontwijkende constructies te beperken?
On the customs sanctions shift to administrative law, asks whether administrative fines match the old criminal fines and whether they rise or fall for taxpayers.
These members ask to what extent the amount of an administrative fine in the new situation corresponds to a criminal fine in the old situation.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre de hoogte van een bestuurlijke boete in de nieuwe situatie overeenkomt met een strafrechtelijke geldboete in de oude situatie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Overige Fiscale Maatregelen 2024 bill amending several tax laws, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply notes only minor redactional changes were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36510.s: The bill replaces the term 'hetero- or homosexual orientation' with 'sexual orientation' in the General Equal Treatment Act and the Dutch Criminal Code, and extends the discrimination grounds of 'sex' to cover sex characteristics, gender identity and gender expression in several criminal provisions. It also adds a definition of sexual orientation and includes transgender and intersex persons explicitly in anti-discrimination protection.
36510.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to the increased visibility and recognition of diverse sexual orientations, alignment with national and international terminology, and the need to protect transgender and intersex persons against discrimination, without delegating new powers.
q: The proposal does not aim to reassess the existing relationship between fundamental rights, including non-discrimination and freedom of expression.
Het voorstel beoogt in zoverre geen hernieuwde beoordeling van de vigerende onderlinge verhouding van de grondrechten.

parties: Questions the maturity of gender concepts for legislation, warns against conflation of sex and gender identity, and asks the government to pause and commission evidence on effectiveness.
These members believe that for this part of the amendment it would be prudent at least to pause until a broad, substantial and balanced scientific and public debate has taken place.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat het wat dit deel van de wetswijziging prudent zou zijn om in ieder geval pas op de plaats te maken tot er een breed, substantieel en evenwichtig wetenschappelijk en maatschappelijk debat over deze materie is gevoerd.
Supports the amendment and seeks clarification on the scope of 'seksuele gerichtheid' and its application to the BES islands.
Agencies, experts and international human rights organisations endorse the need for this amendment.
Instanties, deskundigen en internationale mensenrechtenorganisaties onderschrijven de noodzaak van deze wijziging.
Supports the protection against discrimination and the wording limiting the term to consensual, equal relations, asking mainly factual questions on prosecution practice.
These members can agree with the chosen wording of the statutory article and welcome the explicit statement in the text that it concerns only sexual orientation based on consent and equality.

Deze leden kunnen instemmen met de gekozen formulering in het wetsartikel en vinden het goed dat is gekozen om expliciet in de wettekst te benadrukken dat het uitsluitend gaat om seksuele gerichtheid op basis van consensus en gelijkwaardigheid.
Supports the bill but asks whether the consent-and-equality limit is clear enough to prevent overinclusion and legal uncertainty.
According to these members it is not entirely clear which orientations fall outside the scope through this phrase.
Het is volgens deze leden niet geheel duidelijk welke gerichtheden door deze zinsnede buiten het bereik vallen.
Welcomes the replacement term as expanding recognition and asks how legal protection will materially improve and how understanding will be promoted.
Replacing 'hetero- or homosexual orientation' with 'sexual orientation' does justice to all people whose sexual orientation cannot be described as hetero- or homosexual.

Het vervangen van de term «hetero- of homoseksuele gerichtheid» door «seksuele gerichtheid» doet recht aan alle mensen wiens seksuele gerichtheid niet als hetero- of homoseksueel kan worden omschreven.
Doubts the added value and necessity of new legislation, questions international terminology as justification, and asks whether speech that refuses preferred pronouns could become criminal.
Can the government guarantee that this legislation will not make such, and comparable, expressions of opinion punishable?
Kan de regering garanderen dat deze wetgeving zulke, en vergelijkbare, uitingen van een mening niet strafbaar stelt?
Asks what concrete protection the bill adds in practice and urges an evaluation clause per the science review's recommendation.
The SP members note that there is practically nothing in the law regarding evaluation.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat er op het gebied van evaluatie nagenoeg niets in de wet staat opgenomen.

Argues the government gives insufficient account of fundamental trade-offs, including freedom of expression and the effect on groups defined by sex, and questions the blurring of sexual orientation and gender identity.
These members find it worrying that the government hardly accounts for the fundamental trade-offs that may arise as a result of this bill.
Deze leden vinden het zorgelijk dat de regering nauwelijks rekenschap geeft van de fundamentele afwegingen die als gevolg van dit wetsvoorstel aan de orde (kunnen) zijn.
Asks why the bill goes beyond the motion, whether criminalisation is proportionate as ultimum remedium, and how vague gender identity terms can give citizens legal certainty.
These members ask the government to explain further why a new criminal offence was chosen with the aim of increasing the visibility of this group.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten waarom gekozen is voor een nieuwe strafbaarstelling met als doel de zichtbaarheid van deze groep personen te versterken.
Supports the bill but asks for stronger evidential underpinning, awareness campaigns, and broader coverage of the criminal provisions for sex characteristics and gender identity.

Is the government willing to amend article 90 quater of the Criminal Code so that sex in all intended offences has the broad meaning, including sex characteristics, gender identity and gender expression?
Is de regering bereid om art. 90 quater WvSr zo aan te passen dat geslacht in alle bedoelde delicten de brede betekenis, inclusief geslachtskenmerken, genderidentiteit en genderexpressie, krijgt?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill's draft explanatory memorandum should explain why the narrower definition of 'seksuele gerichtheid' is not written into the statute itself, and it raised a point on the Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten door intermediairs. The government reply adopts the advice by adding a definition of seksuele gerichtheid to the Algemene wet gelijke behandeling and the Wetboek van Strafrecht, and explains that the intermediaries law change will be taken up in a future legislative trajectory.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that the narrower meaning of 'seksuele gerichtheid' should be clarified, and the government now writes the definition into the statute in both the AWGB and the Criminal Code.

The Afdeling advised clarifying in Article II that gender-related grounds apply to all offences in articles 137c and 137d; the government did not change the text, explaining that the amended article 90quater already covers this.

The Afdeling suggested clarifying whether the term 'hetero- of homoseksuele gerichtheid' in the Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten door intermediairs should also be replaced; the government says this will be addressed in a future legislative trajectory.

36600-IIA.s: This bill sets the 2025 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Staten-Generaal (IIA), in thousands of euros, with total expenditure of 266,739 and receipts of 3,865. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget articles for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer, and joint interparliamentary activities, without delegating rule-making power.
q: Article 1 The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2025 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft 2025 budget bill for the Staten-Generaal (IIA) and raised no remarks, so it can be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) of 16 September 2024 notes that some budgets need amendment, which are set out in annexes not included in the text.

36625-L.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the National Growth Fund by increasing the expenditure on research, development and innovation by 1.8 million euros (in thousands). It is a second supplementary budget and takes retroactive effect from 1 December 2024.
q: The budget statement of the National Growth Fund (L) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifionds (L) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36725-K.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue across materiel, infrastructure and IT lines, in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2025.
q: The first supplementary budget gives a total overview of financial deviations from the draft budget of the DMF.
De eerste suppletoire begroting geeft een totaaloverzicht van financiële afwijkingen ten opzichte van de ontwerpbegroting van het DMF.

36725-XXIII.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (Article XXIII) and the budget for its agencies, adjusting spending and commitments mainly under the energy and climate policy article. It also sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 June 2025.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (XXIII) for 2025 is amended.
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (XXIII) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd

36915-J.s: The bill amends the 2026 departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund (first supplementary budget), reallocating expenditure and revenue across articles on flood safety, freshwater supply, operations and maintenance, and water quality. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to executive oversight.
q: The budget statement of the Delta Fund (J) for the year 2026 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2026 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
